records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the nighttime dream and divine warning through light and Abimelech’s expression; the verse does not describe the room or the appearance of the dream.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowned man raises open hands in appeal in a palace courtyard, while a woman stands apart and a settlement lies beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Abimelech appealing to the unseen Lord, with the woman at a distance and a settlement suggesting the nation he mentions. The setting and poses are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit palace courtyard, a robed man holds out his open hands as a man and woman stand together listening.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates the speaker’s appeal to the couple’s words and his claim of innocent intent; the setting and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man sleeps in a richly furnished room beneath golden light, while a woman stands apart in an open doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the dream and the separation described in the verse; its setting and appearance are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit palace courtyard, a crowned ruler gestures toward a woman walking toward a bearded man with his hands raised in prayer, while members of the household watch.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined courtyard scene brings together the verse’s command to restore the woman and the prophet’s promised prayer; it does not claim to show the literal moment described.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit courtyard, a seated Abimelech speaks to gathered servants whose faces and gestures show alarm.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Abimelech speaking to his servants in the morning and their fear; the setting, clothing, and individual expressions are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowned Abimelech gestures toward Abraham in a sunlit royal courtyard, with attendants and a town in the background.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Abimelech questioning Abraham; the courtyard, clothing, attendants, and town are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older woman gestures toward a concerned mother and son as she speaks to a thoughtful Abraham in a tented pastoral encampment; another child stands beside the speaker.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the moment of the woman’s request. The setting, gestures, expressions, and presence of the children are artistic choices rather than details specified by the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A troubled Abraham sits outside a tent, looking toward a young son standing nearby in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene expresses Abraham's distress concerning his son; the verse does not describe their poses or setting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Abraham listens thoughtfully as Sarah gestures beside Isaac outside a tent; a woman and a boy stand together in the sunlit encampment beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family scene evokes God's reassurance to Abraham and his instruction to listen to Sarah; the verse does not describe the pictured setting or gestures.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman stands with a boy beside a seated man on a sunny hillside, overlooking families, flocks, tents and a distant settlement.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the promised future nation through the populated landscape; the verse itself states a promise rather than describing this gathering.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Hagar carries a water skin and a bundle as she walks with a boy through a sunlit, rocky wilderness; Abraham stands near tents in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene brings together Hagar and the boy's departure and wandering; the setting, gestures and appearance are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman kneels beside a boy lying beneath a leafy desert bush, with a slack waterskin nearby in a dry, rocky landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the exhausted water supply and the boy placed beneath a bush; the figures and landscape are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A tearful woman sits among rocks beneath a tree, holding a cloth to her face. Across the dry, open landscape, a boy rests beneath a distant shrub.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts her grief and separation from the boy; the landscape, clothing, and poses are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Hagar looks toward sunlight breaking through clouds as a distressed boy lies nearby in a rocky wilderness.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests Hagar hearing the call from heaven and the boy whose voice God hears; the landscape and appearance of the figures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman supports a boy by the hand and shoulder as he rises among rocks in a sunlit, arid landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the instruction to lift and hold the boy; the setting, appearance, and expressions are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman gives a boy water from a leather skin beside a stone well in a sunlit, dry landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the woman giving the boy water near the well; the setting and appearance of the people are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older Sarah sits with her hands clasped inside a sunlit tent, looking upward with a quiet smile; trees and hills lie beyond the entrance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests Sarah’s response to Yahweh’s faithfulness; the verse does not describe her surroundings or expression.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A young archer draws his bow among rocks and scrub, with sunlit wilderness hills stretching behind him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined moment illustrates the boy growing up in the wilderness and becoming an archer; the verse does not describe this particular scene.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A mother gestures toward a man and a woman holding hands beside a tent in a rocky wilderness.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined introduction evokes his dwelling in Paran and his mother taking a wife for him from Egypt; the verse does not describe the meeting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A richly dressed man gestures toward an older shepherd while an armed commander stands beside him; sheep graze near a tent in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined meeting depicts Abimelech and Phichol speaking to Abraham; the landscape, clothing, and gestures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men speak solemnly in a sunlit pastoral landscape; one gestures with open hands while the other listens, with a family, tent and grazing sheep nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the request for an oath and suggests the descendants and land mentioned in the verse; the setting and figures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Abraham raises one hand as he speaks to a listening man beside an encampment in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene depicts Abraham's spoken declaration; the setting, listener and gesture are artistic choices not specified in this verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Abraham gestures toward a stone well as he speaks to Abimelech, who listens with servants nearby in a sunlit pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Abraham's complaint beside the well; the verse does not specify the setting or gestures.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A richly robed man speaks with open hands to a listening man beneath a tree, with tents and hills in the sunlit distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Abimelech speaking and another man listening; their appearance and setting are artistic choices, and the unspecified event is not shown.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two robed men clasp hands in a sunny pastoral landscape, with sheep and oxen gathered beside them and other men watching.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the gift of animals and the covenant; the setting, clothing, onlookers, and gesture are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Abraham gestures toward seven lambs gathered apart from a distant flock in a sunlit pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Abraham setting the seven ewe lambs apart; the landscape and their arrangement are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Abimelech gestures as he speaks to Abraham beside seven lambs gathered apart from a distant flock in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Abimelech’s question and the seven lambs set apart; the setting and appearance of the people are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Sarah holds a swaddled newborn as elderly Abraham sits beside her in a tent; sheep graze in the sunlit landscape beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays a quiet family moment after the birth; the verse does not describe the setting or their expressions.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men gesture toward a group of overlapping lambs beside a stone well in a sunlit pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the proposed exchange beside the well. The overlapping lambs appear to number more than the seven specified in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men clasp hands beside a stone well in a sunlit landscape of low hills and shrubs.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the two people and their oath at the place named in the verse; their appearance and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two robed men walk together down a sunlit road while another man watches beside a stone well, with hills in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the departure described after the covenant at Beersheba; the setting and figures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man kneels with hands raised beside a newly planted young tree in a sunlit, rocky landscape; a planting tool lies nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the planting and calling on God described in the verse; its setting and visual details are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Abraham sits beside a tent beneath a tree, looking over sheep grazing in a sunlit landscape with a distant settlement.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes Abraham’s long stay; its setting and details are an artist’s interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Abraham leans toward a swaddled infant in Sarah's arms as the three smile together in a sunlit tent.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family moment illustrates Abraham naming Isaac; the verse does not describe the setting or their gestures.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Abraham cradles a sleeping, swaddled infant inside a sunlit tent, with a dry landscape visible beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures a tender moment after the event; the verse does not describe the setting or their appearance.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Abraham smiles at a swaddled infant in his arms at the entrance of a tent, with sheep and a sunlit landscape beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene pictures Abraham holding Isaac; the verse states Abraham’s age at his son’s birth but does not describe this setting or moment.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older Sarah speaks and laughs with four women gathered beside a tent in a sunlit courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative gathering pictures Sarah sharing the laughter described in the verse; the setting and listeners are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A joyful Abraham welcomes guests to a feast beside a tent while young Isaac eats bread among the gathering.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the feast described in the verse; the setting and details are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Sarah watches from a tent as a laughing young man gestures in a sunlit encampment among trees and distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This is an imaginative depiction of Sarah seeing Hagar’s son scoffing; the setting, gestures, and expressions are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Abraham reaches for a knife beside his son, who lies bound on wood among stones, in a sunlit rocky landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the moment Abraham takes the knife; its setting and visual details are an artist's interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Abraham sits among rocks and looks up, raising a hand toward sunlight breaking through clouds over a broad landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Abraham responding to the call from heaven; the setting, gesture, and light are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly father looks up with one hand raised and a knife lowered at his side, while his unharmed son lies on wood atop a stone altar in a mountainous landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the moment of the command to spare the boy; the setting, gestures and expressions are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Abraham reaches toward a ram caught among branches on a sunny, rocky hillside, while his son stands beside a stone altar in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Abraham approaching the ram; the verse also tells how he offered it in place of his son.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Abraham stands beside an arrangement of stones on a rocky mountain, extending one hand toward a sunlit valley.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Abraham acknowledging the place he names; the landscape, gesture, and stones are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Abraham sits on a rocky hillside, looking toward sunlight breaking through clouds above a wide valley.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests Abraham listening to the call from heaven; the verse does not describe his posture or the landscape.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly father kneels with his arm around his son on a rocky mountain, both looking toward sunlight breaking through clouds beside a stone altar topped with wood.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene expresses the solemn declaration and the relationship between father and son; its setting, gestures, and light are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly robed man stands on a sandy coastal rise beneath a sky filled with stars. Across the bay, people approach an open gate in a fortified city.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene brings the stars, seashore and city gate together to evoke the promise; it does not depict a single event described in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly shepherd and a child look toward families sharing fruit and grain beneath a tree in a sunlit valley.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The gathering is an imaginative illustration of the promised blessing reaching the nations through future generations, not a literal event described in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly traveler and his companions walk along a path toward a settlement, with a donkey behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative homeward journey illustrating Abraham returning to his servants and going with them to Beersheba.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Abraham stands beside a tent in a sunlit, rocky landscape, looking upward with one hand against his chest and the other open.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined setting and gesture suggest Abraham listening and responding to God; the verse does not specify these visual details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older Abraham listens outside a tent as a traveler gestures while speaking to him, amid a sunlit, hilly landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Abraham receiving the family news; the verse does not describe the messenger or setting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Three men sit together outside a sunlit dwelling; two share a friendly gesture while the third sits with a young boy. Fields and hills stretch behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering suggests the relationships named in the verse; the verse does not describe this meeting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Five people gather in a sunlit courtyard with woven rugs, pottery, and hills beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering evokes the five names in the verse; the verse does not describe this scene.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man holds a smiling infant in a sunlit stone courtyard while an older couple watch nearby, beneath grapevines.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family moment illustrates Bethuel and Rebekah alongside figures suggesting Milcah and Nahor; the verse does not describe the setting or encounter.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman sits in a sunlit courtyard with four children gathered around her, among woven textiles, clay vessels, and an olive tree.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative family scene reflects the verse's naming of Reumah and the four children she bore; their appearances, ages, and setting are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Abraham sits beside a tent with his hand on Isaac’s shoulder. They look solemnly toward a path and distant mountains.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes the moment of the instruction; the verse does not describe the setting or the figures’ poses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At sunrise Abraham leads a saddled donkey carrying bundled wood along a rocky path, accompanied by Isaac and two young men, with hills in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the journey beginning at dawn; the landscape, appearance, and arrangement of the travelers are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Abraham stands with a walking staff on a rocky rise, looking across a sunlit valley toward distant highlands.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Abraham looking toward a distant place; the landscape and his appearance are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Abraham gestures toward young men standing with a donkey as a boy stands beside him on a path through sunlit hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Abraham speaking before he and the boy go on; the landscape, clothing, and arrangement of the figures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Abraham and Isaac walk together on a sunlit rocky path. Isaac carries a bundle of wood on his shoulders, while Abraham carries a vessel of fire and a knife.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Abraham and Isaac walking together with the wood, fire, and knife described in the verse; the landscape, clothing, and appearance are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: On a rocky highland path, Isaac carries a bundle of wood and looks up questioningly at Abraham, who carries a vessel of fire and listens to him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Isaac’s question to Abraham; the landscape, clothing, and manner of carrying the fire and wood are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Abraham speaks to his son as they walk together on a rocky path through sunlit hills; the son carries a bundle of wood.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Abraham and his son walking together as Abraham speaks; the landscape, clothing, and visible details are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At a sunlit stone city gate, a seated man gestures toward an older standing man while a gathering listens and other people approach through the gate.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Ephron answering Abraham among the sons of Heth at the city gate; the appearance of the people and setting is an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures toward a golden field and a cave in a rocky hillside while addressing an older man, as several witnesses stand nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the spoken offer and its witnesses; the verse does not describe the exact setting or appearance shown.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Abraham bows before a group of people in a sunlit stone courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Abraham's bow; the courtyard, clothing, and appearance of the people are artistic choices not specified in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man offers a pouch to a listening man as people gather around them beside a golden field.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the public request and proposed payment; the verse does not describe the setting or the people's appearance.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man gestures as he speaks to an older man holding a staff in a sunlit stone courtyard, with trees and hills beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined conversation depicts Ephron answering Abraham; the setting and appearance of the men are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two robed men speak beside a golden field, one gesturing toward the land while the other listens; a pouch of silver rests on a stone and a rocky cave lies in the distance.

records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The diverging roads and settlements imaginatively suggest the two peoples and their separation; the scene is not a literal depiction of the prophecy.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An expectant mother rests her hands on her belly in a sunlit tent while an attendant prepares cloths beside a basket holding two folded blankets.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures preparations for the birth; the tent, attendant, and blankets are artistic details not stated in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A hunter with a bow watches distant animals in a golden field while another man sits working quietly outside tents among sheep.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene brings Esau’s life in the field and Jacob’s dwelling among tents together in one landscape; its particular moment and activities are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Outside a tent, Isaac smiles toward Esau while eating cooked game, and Rebekah rests a hand on Jacob's shoulder as they look at each other.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family meal and the figures' gestures illustrate the relationships described in the verse; the verse does not describe this particular scene.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob stirs a steaming pot over a fire near a dwelling as a weary Esau approaches from a golden field.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Jacob cooking and Esau returning weary from the field; the setting and visual details are an artist’s interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A mother and father sit with six children beside a woven tent in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering illustrates the six children named in the verse; their ages and the moment shown are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A weary Esau reaches toward Jacob, who sits beside a steaming pot of red stew in a sunlit pastoral camp.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Esau’s request; the setting and appearance of the people are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit pastoral landscape, Jacob gestures as he speaks to a thoughtful man seated beside a tent, with sheep and hills behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jacob making his request; the setting, appearance, and gestures are artistic choices rather than details stated in this verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A distressed Esau sits beside a tent, one hand on his chest and the other extended, with sheep and goats in a sunlit pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses Esau’s expression and gesture to evoke his urgent words; the setting and pose are artistic additions.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men clasp hands outside a tent; one raises his other hand while the other listens. Sheep graze on a sunlit hillside behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene depicts the oath and agreement described in the verse; its setting, gestures, and appearance are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Esau walks away from a pastoral meal while Jacob sits beside a bowl of lentil stew, bread and a cup beneath a tree.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Esau departing after the meal; its setting and visual details are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man sits beneath a broad tree with two grown men and three younger people, with tents and sunlit hills behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering evokes the generations named in the genealogy; the verse does not describe such a gathering or the people’s appearances.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A father and five sons gather closely beside tents in a sunlit pastoral landscape, with a flock in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering illustrates the genealogy; the verse does not describe such a meeting or identify the figures individually.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Abraham holds a key above Isaac’s open hand beside a tent, with textiles, pottery, and flocks around them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined handover and its details illustrate Abraham giving all he had to Isaac; the verse does not describe the key or the setting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Abraham gives a gift to a departing son beside a tent, while other men and loaded donkeys travel toward distant hills and another man remains by the encampment.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined farewell illustrates the gifts and eastward departure; the setting, appearance, and details of the travelers are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Abraham sits with a staff beneath a tree beside a tent, looking across a sunlit landscape where sheep graze.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects on the length of Abraham’s life; the verse gives his age but does not describe this setting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Abraham lies peacefully on a woven bed in a tent as three people mourn quietly nearby; warm evening light falls on the hills beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined bedside scene reflects Abraham’s death in old age; the setting and people are artistic additions, and the gathering to his people is not shown literally.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men carry a linen-wrapped body toward a rocky cave amid a sunlit field and distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the brothers approaching the cave for the burial; the verse does not describe the appearance of the place or the manner of carrying him.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit courtyard, a richly dressed Abimelech gestures seriously toward a man and a woman standing together, while several people watch from a distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined courtyard conversation illustrates Abimelech’s warning; the verse does not specify the setting or appearance of those present.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A richly dressed ruler raises his hand toward a crowd in a sunlit stone courtyard, while a man and woman stand together beside him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Abimelech delivering his warning; the verse does not describe the setting or the people's appearance.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Isaac holds a sheaf of grain amid a golden field filled with gathered sheaves, with a basket of grain and distant hills under a sunny sky.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative harvest scene evokes Isaac's abundant yield and the blessing described in the verse; its visual details are an artist's interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man holding a staff stands above a sunlit pastoral homestead filled with flocks, tents and baskets of produce.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the man’s growing prosperity; the verse does not specify these visual details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Sheep and goats fill the foreground of a sunlit encampment, with cattle and workers near tents behind them; three men watch from the side.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined pastoral scene expresses the abundance and envy described in the verse; its setting and figures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Men pour and shovel earth into a stone-lined well in a sunlit landscape, while others fill another well in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the filling of the wells; the people and landscape are an artist's interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Abimelech gestures toward the distance as he speaks to Isaac, who stands with a staff; people and flocks gather behind Isaac in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Abimelech asking Isaac to leave; the setting, gestures, and surrounding people and animals are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man secures a tent in a valley while people and a flock stand nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative view of Isaac pitching his tent and dwelling in the Valley of Gerar; the camp and scenery are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Isaac and helpers clear stones and earth from an old stone well with water visible, in a sunlit pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the reopening of one of the wells; the verse also tells of the wells being stopped up and Isaac restoring his father’s names for them.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Several workers gather around a freshly dug well as water bubbles up, with digging tools and a sunlit valley around them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the servants discovering springing water; the people and setting are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler carrying a bundle and staff walks through dry fields toward a distant walled city beneath a bright sky.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Isaac on his way to Gerar amid the famine; the landscape, city, and details of his journey are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two groups of herdsmen gesture toward each other across a stone-lined well, with sheep and goats nearby in a golden pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the quarrel over the well; the setting and appearance of the herdsmen are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two groups gesture in disagreement across a newly dug stone well, with tools and fresh earth in a sunlit pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the quarrel over the well; the people's appearance and the setting are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Men gather peacefully beside a stone well with a digging tool and clay vessel, while sheep graze in a sunlit valley.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the uncontested well and the sense of room to flourish described in the verse; its people and landscape are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler with a staff walks uphill along a winding, rocky path toward a distant settlement among sunlit hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the journey to Beersheba; the traveler's appearance, route, and settlement are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man sits beside a glowing tent at night, gazing toward golden light in a star-filled sky over a quiet landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the nighttime encounter and reassurance described in the verse; its setting and light are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Isaac kneels beside a stone altar near a pitched tent while servants dig a well in a sunlit pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene brings together the altar, tent, and well described in the verse; the setting and visual details are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Three visitors, including a richly dressed man and an armored companion, approach a man at his tent.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative view of Abimelech arriving with Ahuzzath and Phichol. Their appearances, clothing and military equipment are artistic choices rather than historical reconstructions.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Isaac gestures toward three visitors beside a tent in a sunlit, rocky landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Isaac questioning his visitors; the setting and their appearances are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Three travelers speak with a man beside a tent; their spokesman extends an open hand while the man listens, with sheep and hills behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the speakers proposing an agreement; the setting and gestures are artistic additions.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Three men in robes speak with open gestures to another man holding a staff on a sunny pastoral path, with tents, sheep, and distant hills behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined conversation illustrates the appeal for peace; the setting and the people’s appearances are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed man holding a staff pauses on a rocky hillside and looks toward light breaking through clouds over a wide landscape, with a tent nearby and a winding road in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the encounter and the command to remain in the land; the landscape and appearance of the encounter are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A group of men eat and hold cups around a low table laden with bread, fruit and other food beneath a leafy canopy.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the feast and shared eating and drinking; the setting, people and meal details are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In golden morning light, Isaac waves farewell beside a tent as a group of men walks peacefully along a path through the hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the peaceful departure after the oath; the setting, appearance and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two smiling servants tell a seated Isaac about water beside a stone well; one holds a water-filled jar and the other gestures toward the well.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the servants bringing Isaac news of the water; the setting and visual details are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man gestures toward a distant settlement while companions gather beside a stone well in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene uses a well and distant city to evoke the naming in the verse; their appearance and the gathering are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A mature man stands between two women whose hands meet in front of him, while people watch beside a stone dwelling at sunset.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family scene illustrates Esau taking Judith and Basemath as wives; the setting, ceremony, and witnesses are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A sorrowful man and woman sit together in a sunlit stone courtyard while two women stand at a distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined courtyard scene expresses the grief described in the verse; the setting, gestures and arrangement of the figures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed traveler stands beside a tent, looking over a sunlit valley of fields, hills, trees, and grazing sheep.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes dwelling in the land and the breadth of the promise; its details are an artist's interpretation, not details specified by the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler stands on a rocky ridge beneath a star-filled twilight sky, looking over a valley of fields and settlements as families and travelers follow a road below.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes the promise through a starry sky, a broad landscape, and people on the road; it does not portray a literal moment described in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Abraham stands beside a tent with his hand over his heart, looking toward the dawn sky, while sheep graze in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene uses Abraham's attentive posture to suggest his obedience; the verse does not describe this particular moment.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man sits outside a dwelling among clay vessels, looking toward a sunlit settlement and hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Isaac dwelling in Gerar; the appearance of Isaac, his dwelling and the settlement is not specified by the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village courtyard, a worried man gestures toward three men while Rebekah watches nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the questioning and his fearful response; the setting, gestures, and appearances are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowned king looks from an upper window into a sunny stone courtyard, where a smiling man and woman hold hands beneath grapevines.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Abimelech observing Isaac and Rebekah; the courtyard, clothing, and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit courtyard, a seated ruler gestures questioningly toward an apprehensive man, while a woman stands attentively beside him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the exchange between Abimelech and Isaac; the setting, gestures, and presence of Isaac’s wife are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A younger man carries a tray of food toward an elderly man seated in a warmly lit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene illustrates the instruction to bring food to a father in anticipation of his blessing; the setting and appearance of the people are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A young man points to his smooth forearm while speaking to a woman; a hairy-armed man is visible outside.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative illustration of Jacob’s conversation with Rebekah and the contrast he describes. The background glimpse of Esau is an artistic device, not an assertion that he attended the conversation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A worried young man holds his forearm and looks toward an elderly man seated across a warmly lit dwelling.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the speaker's fear of being discovered; the verse presents the father's touch and its consequences as a possibility.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman speaks earnestly to a hesitant man by an open doorway, touching her chest and gesturing toward the sunlit outdoors.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene interprets the mother’s appeal and her son’s response; the setting, gestures, and expressions are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man carries a covered basket into a sunlit dwelling while a woman stirs a steaming pot over a hearth.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the bringing and preparation described in the verse; the setting, basket, and appearance of the people are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Inside a sunlit house, Rebekah adjusts a richly patterned garment on Jacob’s shoulders beside a stack of folded clothes.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Rebekah dressing Jacob in Esau’s fine clothes; the setting and appearance of the garments are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a warm, woven-textile-filled room, a woman adjusts a hairy skin around a seated man’s neck; both his hands are covered with hairy skins that have dark, hoof-like tips.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the woman placing young-goat skins on his hands and smooth neck; the setting and appearance are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman hands a dish of savory food and a loaf of bread to a seated man in a sunlit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the handoff described in the verse; the setting and appearances are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A younger man enters a warmly lit dwelling and addresses an elderly man resting among woven blankets, who turns toward him with a hand raised to his ear.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the encounter and exchange in Genesis 27:18; the room, clothing, and gestures are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob offers a steaming bowl of food to his elderly father beside a low table in a warmly lit household.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Jacob presenting the meal and speaking to his father; the verse does not specify the room or their appearance.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Isaac sits in a sunlit dwelling and reaches toward Esau, who leans attentively toward him. Woven textiles and earthen vessels fill the warm room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene depicts Isaac calling Esau and Esau answering; the setting and appearance of the figures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Isaac gestures in question toward his standing son, who holds a covered dish and gestures as he answers in a sunlit dwelling.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined conversation illustrates the exchange in the verse; the dwelling and covered dish are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a warmly lit dwelling, an older Isaac reaches toward Jacob, who leans close in a textured garment.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Isaac asking Jacob to come near; the setting and appearances are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Isaac sits and feels Jacob's hand as Jacob leans close to him in a warmly lit dwelling.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene depicts Isaac feeling Jacob as described in the verse; the setting, clothing, and expressions are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man touches a kneeling younger man’s hairy hands and places a hand on his head in a warm, textile-filled dwelling.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative illustration depicts the unrecognized man’s hairy hands and the blessing; the setting, gestures, and appearances are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man seated among patterned blankets extends an open hand toward a standing man, who touches his chest, in a warmly lit dwelling.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the question and answer; the setting, appearance and gestures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man drinks from a clay cup beside a low table of prepared meat, while a younger man stands by with a pitcher in a sunlit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the meal and wine described in the verse; the setting and appearance of the people are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man seated in a sunlit dwelling reaches toward a younger man who bends close to him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene pictures Isaac inviting his son to come near for a kiss; the setting and appearances are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man embraces a younger man in a woven garment at a doorway, with a golden field beyond them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the embrace and the comparison to a blessed field; the setting and appearance are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Dew glistens on golden grain and grapevines overlooking a fertile valley at sunrise, with bundled grain and a clay jar beside the vineyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined harvest landscape evokes the abundance named in the blessing; it is not a depiction of a specified scene in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man rests a hand on a standing man's shoulder as richly dressed figures bow before him on a stone terrace overlooking a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the blessing's language of authority and homage; it is not a literal record of the moment or its fulfillment.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly white-bearded man gestures as he speaks to a younger man in a warmly lit dwelling with woven textiles and earthenware.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined conversation illustrates the speaker’s reflection on old age and the uncertainty of the day of his death; the setting and listener are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob steps away from a tent where Isaac sits, as Esau approaches with a bow and game.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene brings Jacob’s departure and Esau’s return together around a tent to suggest the close timing described in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man offers a platter of cooked meat to an elderly man rising from a bed in a warmly lit dwelling.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the son bringing the prepared food and inviting his father to eat; the verse does not describe the room or their appearances.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly seated father holds out a questioning hand toward an adult man who gestures to himself in a warmly lit dwelling.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the exchange between Isaac and Esau; the setting, clothing, and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Isaac recoils with trembling hands beside a meal in a warmly lit tent, looking toward a concerned man standing at the entrance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Isaac’s trembling and question after the earlier meal and blessing; the setting and gestures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A grieving Esau kneels and reaches toward his seated elderly father in a warmly lit dwelling.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Esau crying out and pleading with his father; the setting and visual details are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man speaks with an open hand to a distressed younger man seated in a warmly lit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the conversation described in the verse; the setting and expressions are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A distressed Esau kneels and reaches toward an elderly seated man in a warmly lit tent.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Esau’s anguished question; the setting, gestures and appearances are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Isaac sits with open hands, speaking to a distressed Esau in a sunlit dwelling; grain and a clay vessel rest nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined conversation and its setting illustrate Isaac's answer to Esau; the verse does not describe their gestures or surroundings.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A tearful Esau kneels and reaches toward his seated elderly father inside a warmly lit dwelling.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Esau pleading and weeping before his father; the setting and gestures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man speaks to a younger man inside a tent, gesturing toward a distant dwelling and dew-bright plants in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Isaac speaking and evokes the dwelling, earth, and dew mentioned in the verse; the setting and landscape are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A hunter carrying a bow and a quiver of arrows walks toward a sunlit field, with a deer in the distance and mountains beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene portrays the requested journey into the field; the landscape and distant deer are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man with a sheathed sword lifts a broken wooden yoke from his shoulders on a rocky hillside overlooking fields and a distant settlement.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene gives visual form to the verse's sword and yoke imagery; it is not presented as a literal depiction of an event.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A resentful Esau sits with clenched hands outside a stone household at sunset, looking toward Jacob walking away along a distant path.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene gives visible form to Esau’s inward resentment; the setting and Jacob walking away are artistic choices, and the threatened killing is not shown as having happened.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A concerned Rebekah speaks closely to Jacob in a warmly lit dwelling while a man stands outside in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Rebekah warning Jacob; the setting, gestures and distant figure are artistic choices, not details specified by the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman at a stone doorway gestures toward a winding road as a man carrying a bundle turns to listen.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined household scene depicts the instruction to flee; the verse does not describe the setting or gestures.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man welcomes a seated traveler with a bundle outside a stone dwelling, while sunlight breaks beside a receding rain cloud over a distant village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests a temporary stay and the hope that anger will subside; the dwelling, welcome, and weather are illustrative details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A worried woman speaks to a man carrying a travel bundle at the doorway of a stone dwelling, with a winding path leading through sunlit hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes the speaker's concern and hope of bringing him back; the setting, gestures and journey are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A troubled Rebekah gestures as she speaks to Isaac, who listens thoughtfully in a warmly lit ancient household.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Rebekah's conversation with Isaac; the setting and their appearance are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man speaks from a bed to a younger man in a warm dwelling, with ingredients and a cooking pot nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the request and the meal still to be prepared; the verse does not describe the setting or the figures' appearance.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Rebekah listens from a doorway as seated Isaac gestures toward Esau, who carries hunting gear and turns toward the open countryside.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene brings the conversation and Esau’s departure together; the setting, clothing, and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a warm dwelling, Rebekah speaks to Jacob as he listens, gesturing toward a sunlit doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Rebekah speaking to Jacob; the setting, gesture, and appearance of the people are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man reclines in a tent and gestures toward an empty bowl while a younger man holding a bow listens beside him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene pictures the request for game and food; the blessing is still to come.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older woman gestures as she speaks to an attentive man seated beside her in a sunlit courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined courtyard conversation illustrates the instruction to listen and obey; the verse does not describe the setting or appearances.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman gestures from a tent toward a man beside a flock, with two goats prominent in the foreground and a cooking pot and herbs nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined pastoral scene illustrates the instruction and the intended meal; its setting and details are an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler carrying a bundle and staff walks away from a stone settlement along a winding road through a sunlit, rocky landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jacob setting out; the landscape, settlement, clothing and travel gear are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler sleeps among rocks with a stone beside his head, beneath a tree and a deep blue twilight sky; a bundle lies nearby and warm light lingers on the horizon.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the resting place and sunset described in the verse; the landscape and other visual details are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man sleeps among rocks beneath a starry sky while angels ascend and descend a glowing ladder reaching into the clouds.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative illustration presents the ladder and angels as the dream described in the verse; its landscape and visual details are an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler sleeps among rocks beneath a starry sky, while light breaks through clouds over a broad golden valley.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes the land and divine promise in the verse; the landscape and light are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler stands on a rocky hill overlooking families and caravans traveling along branching paths through a sunlit landscape of fields, villages, mountains, and sea.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined landscape evokes the promise of numerous descendants spreading widely and blessing the families of the earth; it does not depict a literal event described in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler with a staff and bundle pauses on a rocky path overlooking sunlit hills, fields, and a distant settlement.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses a traveler and a path toward the land to evoke the promise of presence, protection, and return; it does not depict the fulfillment of that promise.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob sits awake on a bedroll among rocks, looking upward with a startled, awed expression as warm light spreads across the hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Jacob's awakening and realization; the landscape and morning light are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A startled man in ancient robes sits among rocks, looking up at golden rays streaming through an opening in the clouds above a broad valley.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the man’s fear and awe and his words about the gate of heaven; the landscape and light are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At sunrise, Jacob kneels beside an upright stone and pours oil onto its top from a clay vessel, with a folded blanket nearby and hills beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jacob pouring oil on the stone he set up as a pillar; the landscape, clothing, and other visual details are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed traveler gestures toward a stone city across a sunlit valley of olive trees and hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the naming of the place; the landscape and the traveler’s gesture are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Isaac sits with his hand on Jacob’s head, speaking as Jacob kneels and listens in a sunlit household.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Isaac’s blessing and instruction; the setting and gestures are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler sits beside a winding road through sunlit hills, looking upward with one hand raised. A loaf, folded garment, staff, and bundle rest beside him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Jacob voicing his vow; the bread and garment visually recall the provisions he speaks about, rather than documenting what he had with him.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler with a staff and bundle looks across a sunlit valley toward a stone dwelling among olive trees.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined journey toward a family home evokes the verse's hoped-for peaceful return; the landscape and dwelling are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler kneels with one hand raised beside an upright stone pillar in a sunlit rocky landscape, with a bundle and provisions nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the speaker's vow beside the stone; the landscape and provisions are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man gestures toward a young traveler with a bundle outside a stone dwelling; a winding road crosses sunlit hills toward distant houses.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined moment of instruction and departure evokes the journey and family household described in the verse; the setting and figures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed man with a staff looks over families gathered among tents, olive trees, fields, and baskets of fruit in a sunlit valley.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The gathering and fertile landscape imaginatively suggest the blessing of fruitfulness and an assembly of peoples; the verse does not describe this scene.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly patriarch blesses a kneeling younger man beside a tent overlooking a broad landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of the blessing and promised inheritance of the land, without a figure representing God.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Isaac gestures farewell beside a dwelling as Jacob, carrying a bundle and walking stick, sets out along a winding path through a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Isaac sending Jacob on his journey; the setting and details of their farewell are an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man seated outside a stone dwelling blesses and speaks to a younger traveler with a pack, while another man watches from the doorway. A path winds through a sunlit landscape toward distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene portrays Esau observing Isaac's blessing and charge to Jacob before his journey; the setting and appearances are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob carries a bundle along a sunlit path, looking back toward his father and mother standing together outside their home.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined departure illustrates Jacob’s obedience to his parents and his journey toward Paddan Aram; the setting and gestures are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit courtyard, Esau watches the elderly Isaac look toward two women standing nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The courtyard, gestures, and encounter are imagined to suggest Esau’s realization; the verse does not describe the setting or these actions.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man and woman stand together outside a desert encampment as an older man welcomes them; two women watch nearby among tents and livestock.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined encounter illustrates Esau taking Mahalath as a wife; the setting, gestures, and gathering are artistic interpretations rather than details supplied by the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob pours water into a stone trough for sheep beside an open well and its displaced stone, while Rachel stands among the flock.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative illustration brings together the verse's actions at the well; the setting and appearance of the people are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A tearful Jacob kisses Rachel on the cheek in a sunlit pastoral landscape, with sheep and a stone well behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jacob kissing Rachel and weeping; the setting and visual details are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Rachel gestures animatedly to her father at a sunlit home, while Jacob stands farther back on the path.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene shows Rachel sharing Jacob's news with her father; the setting, appearances, and gestures are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man embraces a younger traveler beside the open doorway of a sunlit stone house, with sheep and hills behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Laban welcoming Jacob; the setting and appearance of the people are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man speaks warmly with his hand on a younger traveler’s shoulder outside a stone dwelling; the traveler carries a bundle, and sheep graze in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Laban’s affirmation of kinship and suggests the welcome in which the man stays; the setting, appearance, and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man gestures toward a younger man listening thoughtfully in a sunlit pastoral courtyard, with sheep behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined conversation and pastoral setting illustrate Laban's question to Jacob; the verse does not describe their surroundings or gestures.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated older man smiles with two women standing beside him in a sunlit courtyard, with vines, pottery and distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family moment illustrates the relationship named in the verse; the setting and poses are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two women in flowing garments share a sunlit courtyard; one arranges greenery while the other holds a clay jar.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined courtyard scene portrays Leah and Rachel together; the verse describes their features without specifying this setting or activity.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit pastoral courtyard, Jacob gestures earnestly toward a seated older man as Rachel stands nearby; sheep and a shepherd's staff fill the foreground.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jacob's offer of service; the setting, gestures, and Rachel's presence are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man gestures toward a pastoral household as he speaks with a younger man carrying a shepherd’s staff. A woman works near the house, with sheep and hills behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Laban’s words as a conversation at a household; the setting and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler with a staff and bundle walks along a winding path through golden hills toward a distant settlement.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined landscape and traveler illustrate Jacob’s journey to the land of the sons of the East; the visual details are not specified in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob sits with a shepherd’s staff among sheep as Rachel stands beside him holding a clay jar; they smile at each other in a golden pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined pastoral moment suggests Jacob’s service and love for Rachel; the verse does not describe this particular encounter or setting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A younger shepherd speaks with an open hand to an older man outside a stone house, with sheep and hills in the warm evening light.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Jacob speaking to Laban; the setting and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A welcoming host gestures toward men gathering around tables of food in a sunlit village courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Laban gathering the local men for a feast; the setting and appearances are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, an older man gestures toward a woman in blue as she faces a woman in green.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The courtyard, clothing, and gestures imaginatively depict Laban giving Zilpah to Leah; the verse does not describe these visual details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit dwelling, a seated Jacob gestures toward Laban while Leah stands quietly between them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene brings the morning discovery and Jacob’s question to Laban together in one setting; the verse does not describe their surroundings or poses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, an older bearded man gestures as he speaks to a seated man, while two women stand near a doorway behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Laban explaining the order he describes; the setting, gestures, and people in the background are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man gestures toward a seated younger man among sheep, while a woman stands in a flower-framed doorway behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined pastoral conversation suggests the terms of the verse; its setting and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a warmly lit courtyard, an older man gestures toward Rachel and Jacob, who stand facing each other amid woven fabrics, vines, and pottery.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined courtyard and meeting interpret the verse visually; the setting, gestures, and clothing are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, an older man gestures toward a woman holding a basket as another woman faces her.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined household scene depicts Laban giving Bilhah to Rachel as a maidservant; the setting, gestures, and expressions are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler looks toward a stone-covered well in a sunlit field, where three groups of sheep rest nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative watercolor depicts the well, its covering stone, and the three resting flocks described in the verse; the setting and figures are an artist's interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At sunset, Jacob holds a shepherd's staff and looks affectionately at Rachel beside a tent, while Leah stands nearby and sheep gather behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests Jacob's affection for Rachel and his continued service; the setting, gestures, and appearances are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient courtyard, Leah sits with her hands on her pregnant belly, looking upward; Rachel sits apart in thought among pottery and flowering plants.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined household scene expresses the contrast in the verse; the setting, poses, and visible pregnancy are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Leah cradles her swaddled newborn in a sunlit home, looking upward with a hopeful expression as a man works in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Leah holding Reuben and suggests her hope; the setting and the distant figure are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A mother cradles her swaddled newborn in a sunlit dwelling, looking at him with a tender, wistful expression amid woven textiles and pottery.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined domestic moment depicts the mother holding her newborn; the setting and her appearance are artistic interpretations of the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A mother holds a swaddled newborn beside two young boys and looks toward a man standing in a sunlit doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family scene portrays the mother's hope for closeness; the verse does not describe the setting or her husband's response.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A mother looks upward with a grateful smile as she cradles her swaddled newborn in the doorway of a sunlit dwelling.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined moment depicts the mother and her newborn as she praises God; the setting and their appearances are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Shepherds roll a large stone toward a well while sheep drink from a trough and flocks gather in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene brings the verse's recurring practice to life, showing the stone being returned while sheep gather at the water.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler gestures toward three men in conversation on a sunny countryside path, with sheep and distant dwellings behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Jacob asking the men where they are from and their reply; the setting and visual details are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler gestures toward three men beside a stone well and a flock of sheep in a sunlit pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the question and answer; the landscape, clothing, and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man speaks with a group beneath a tree as one gestures toward Rachel approaching with a flock of sheep across a sunlit pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the exchange and Rachel approaching with the sheep; the setting and appearances are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures as he speaks to three shepherds among sheep beside a stone watering place, with sunlit pasture under a bright sky.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the conversation and the suggested watering and pasturing; its visual details are an artistic interpretation of the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Shepherds converse beside a stone-covered well while sheep wait nearby and another flock approaches across a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts a moment of waiting as the speakers explain when the sheep can be watered.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Rachel walks with a flock of sheep toward a group of men conversing beside a stone well in a sunlit pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Rachel arriving with her father’s sheep while a conversation is still underway; the setting and appearances are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A fearful man crouches behind a tree and dense garden foliage, looking toward an empty sunlit path.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the speaker hiding in the garden after hearing the voice; the verse does not describe the exact setting or pose shown.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man covers himself with leaves beside a fruit-bearing tree in a lush garden, looking toward a sunlit opening.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the man listening beside a tree; the setting and visual details are an artistic interpretation of the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a lush garden beneath a fruit tree, a concerned woman watches as a man holds bitten fruit and gestures toward her.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the man's response in Genesis 3:12; the setting, gestures, and appearance are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman clothed in leaves holds a bitten red fruit and points toward a serpent in a tree in a lush garden.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the woman responding to God and identifying the serpent; the garden details and the fruit’s appearance are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A serpent moves close to the dusty ground in a sunlit garden clearing, with cattle, sheep and deer standing among grasses and trees behind it.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the serpent on the ground among field animals as a visual response to the judgment in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit garden, a bare foot presses the head of a coiled serpent whose open mouth reaches toward the foot, while a woman watches from a distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative garden scene gives visible form to the verse’s enmity and its images of the serpent’s head and the offspring’s heel.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A sorrowful woman sits beneath a tree in a flowering garden, one hand on her abdomen, looking toward a man standing apart with folded arms.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the sorrow and the relationship described in the verse; it does not depict a specified event.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man bends over a wooden hand tool, working rocky soil among small green plants, with trees and sunlit hills beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the toil of obtaining food from the ground described in the verse; its landscape and details are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man sits in a sunny field eating leafy herbs, surrounded by thorny branches, purple thistles, and green plants, with hills in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene brings together the thorns, thistles, and field herbs described in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A weary man in simple clothing wipes his brow as he sits in a cultivated field at sunset, touching the soil beside a hoe and a piece of bread on a cloth.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene connects labor and bread with the ground and dust described in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman looks toward a serpent poised in a fruit tree in a sunlit garden, with flowers, a stream and animals in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the serpent addressing the woman in the garden; its visual details are an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Adam gestures toward Eve as they sit together beneath a tree in a sunlit landscape of flowers, greenery, and a flowing stream.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Adam speaking with Eve as he names her; the landscape and their appearance are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man and woman stand together in a sunlit garden, wearing brown and cream animal-skin tunics. Trees, flowers and a stream surround them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene shows Adam and his wife clothed in skin tunics, reflecting the verse’s account of God clothing them.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man stands in a sunlit garden looking up at a large fruit-bearing tree, with flowers, a pool, and a waterfall around him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the man contemplating the tree of life; the verse reports God’s words about the possibility of taking and eating its fruit.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man kneels and works brown soil with a hoe outside a lush garden, with a path leading back to its flower-covered entrance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the man working the ground after being sent from Eden; the garden entrance, clothing, tool, and landscape are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man walks away and looks back toward winged, lion-faced guardians and a whirling flaming sword across a path leading to a great tree in a lush garden.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the guarded way to the tree of life after the man is driven out; the appearance of the cherubim and garden is an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman gestures toward fruit hanging from a tree as she speaks to a serpent in a sunlit garden, with flowers and a stream around them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the woman speaking to the serpent about the fruit of the garden trees.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman raises an open hand while speaking to a serpent beside a fruit-bearing tree in a lush garden.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative rendering of the woman reporting the prohibition to the serpent. The fruit and scenery are artistic choices, not identifications supplied by the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman looks toward a serpent coiled on a tree branch in a sunlit garden, with flowers, fruit and a waterfall around them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative garden scene portrays the serpent addressing the woman in Genesis 3:4.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A serpent rests in a fruit tree and faces a thoughtful woman and man in a sunlit garden; fruit hangs untouched above them.
