records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative garden scene portrays the verse’s claim as a spoken temptation before the fruit is eaten.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man and woman sit beneath a fig tree, joining broad leaves with plant fiber as they make coverings, surrounded by a lush garden and a stream.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the two making fig-leaf coverings after becoming aware of their nakedness.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man and woman shelter among leafy trees, looking anxiously toward an empty sunlit garden path as leaves drift in the breeze.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the couple hiding among the garden trees after hearing God walking; the empty path suggests the moment without portraying Him.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man peers from dense leafy garden foliage toward a sunlit path, with flowers and trees surrounding him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the man listening to God’s unseen call; the garden path and visual details are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman cradles a swaddled infant inside a sunlit tent while a man sits nearby looking toward them; sheep and hills appear beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This scene imaginatively portrays Zilpah with her newborn son and Jacob nearby; the setting and their expressions are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Leah smiles at a swaddled infant in a sunlit room with woven textiles and earthenware.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene depicts Leah naming Gad; the setting and visual details are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman holds a swaddled newborn inside a woven tent while a man and young child look on; sheep graze in the sunlit landscape beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This scene imaginatively depicts a moment after the birth; the setting and the presence and gestures of the figures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling woman looks at a swaddled infant in a wicker cradle while two other women share her joy in a sunlit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Leah’s happiness and naming of Asher; the setting and companions are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A boy stands beside a woman holding leafy plants with golden fruit as another woman reaches toward her; wheat and harvested sheaves fill the sunlit field behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene brings the events of the verse together in a harvest landscape; the appearance of the people, plants, and setting is an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At sunset, two women speak seriously beside a tent; one gestures toward the other, who holds a bundle of leafy plants with pale fruit. A sleeping mat rests inside the tent.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene depicts the exchange over the mandrakes; the setting, appearances, and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At sunset, Leah gestures toward Jacob as he returns along a path from the fields. A basket of roots rests near her doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Leah meeting Jacob at evening; the setting and visual details are artistic interpretations of the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Leah cradles a newborn beside Jacob inside a tent, with sheep and sunlit hills visible outside.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family moment illustrates the birth described in the verse; the setting and expressions are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Leah holds her infant son inside a sunlit tent, with a woven cradle nearby and sheep in the landscape beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Leah holding her son as she names him; the tent and surrounding details are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Leah holds her swaddled newborn while Jacob sits beside her in a sunlit dwelling with woven textiles and pottery.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This is an imaginative depiction of a moment after the birth; the verse does not describe the setting or the family's expressions.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A distressed Rachel speaks with open hands to Jacob in a sunlit courtyard while her sister tends children in the background.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined household scene evokes Rachel’s distress and envy; the setting, gestures, and background are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Leah holds a swaddled newborn inside a pastoral dwelling, surrounded by five older boys, as her husband stands in the doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative family scene depicts Leah’s words and hope; the verse does not describe the setting or gestures shown.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A mother cradles her swaddled baby inside a sunlit tent, surrounded by woven textiles, with a pastoral landscape beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined moment of a mother holding her baby relates to the verse’s account of a daughter’s birth and naming; the setting and details are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Rachel sits with hands clasped in a sunlit dwelling, looking upward with a hopeful expression; flowers and distant hills appear by the open doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined moment uses Rachel's prayerful posture and the morning light to evoke the verse's account of God listening to her; the setting and details are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A mother cradles her swaddled newborn in a sunlit tent, looking upward with a grateful smile; sheep graze beyond the opening.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the mother’s gratitude after the birth; the setting and visual details are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman cradles a sleeping infant inside a tent and looks upward, with sheep grazing in a golden landscape beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the naming and hope expressed in the verse; the setting and pose are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob gestures toward a distant road while speaking to Laban in a sunlit courtyard; nearby, Rachel holds the infant Joseph.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Jacob's request after Joseph's birth; the setting and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man holding a shepherd's staff gestures toward two women and children carrying bundles as he speaks with an older man beside a flock.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the request and the service mentioned in the verse; its setting, gestures, and travel bundles are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man gestures earnestly toward a listening shepherd outside a stone dwelling, with a flock grazing behind them in a sunlit pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Laban’s appeal and suggests the blessing with a flock; the setting and gestures are artistic choices, and the verse does not describe a divination ritual.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men converse beside a sheepfold in a sunlit pastoral landscape; one gestures openly while the other listens thoughtfully.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined pastoral encounter illustrates the verse's offer to give the wages the listener names; the setting and appearance of the people are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A shepherd gestures toward sheep and goats as he speaks with another man beside a stone enclosure in a sunlit pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the conversation and livestock described in the verse; its setting and details are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob gestures as he speaks to a sorrowful Rachel inside a sunlit pastoral tent.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined setting and portrayal express the tense conversation described in the verse; the details of the scene are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A shepherd gestures toward a distant house as he speaks with another man beside a large flock of sheep and goats in a sunlit pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined pastoral conversation illustrates the verse's contrast between another person's increase and the speaker's concern for his own household; its visual details are interpretive.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two shepherds gesture as they converse beside a flock of sheep and goats in a sunlit, rocky landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined conversation and pastoral setting express Jacob’s response; the verse does not describe the appearance of the people or the setting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A shepherd guides spotted sheep, a brown lamb, and patterned goats apart from a flock on a sunlit hillside beside a stone enclosure.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the selection described in the verse; its setting and details are an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A shepherd gestures toward spotted goats and dark lambs in a stone sheepfold while another man examines the flock in a sunlit pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined inspection gives visual form to the future accounting described in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older bearded man gestures as he speaks to another man beneath a tree, with sheep grazing in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Laban’s response; the setting, appearance, and gestures are artistic choices beyond the words of the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older herdsman gestures toward three younger herders guiding spotted goats and dark lambs away from a pale flock in a sunlit, rocky landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the animals being separated and entrusted to the man's sons; the landscape and figures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A shepherd stands among grazing sheep and goats in a golden pasture, with a winding road leading toward distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative pastoral scene suggests Jacob tending the remaining flock and the distance described in the verse; its landscape and details are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob sits beneath a tree peeling pale strips into a branch, with more stripped branches and leafy cuttings beside him and sheep in the distant landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jacob preparing the branches described in the verse; the setting and visual details are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A shepherd places peeled branches in stone watering troughs as sheep and goats gather and drink in a sunlit pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the peeled branches and the flock at the watering troughs described in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A flock of sheep and goats stands behind leafy branches in a golden pastoral landscape, with streaked, speckled, and spotted young beside the adults.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene brings the branches and the marked offspring together to recall the sequence described in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Inside a sunlit tent, a seated woman gestures toward a standing woman as she speaks to a seated man.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the moment of the request; the setting, gestures, and expressions are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob guides white sheep and lambs toward a separate group of brown and patterned sheep across a sunny pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates Jacob arranging and separating the flocks; the landscape and the animals’ exact appearance are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob places branches in a stone watering trough before a flock of sheep and goats in a sunlit pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Jacob placing the branches before the stronger livestock at the troughs; the setting and visual details are an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit pastoral landscape, a shepherd stands among robust sheep and goats in the foreground while another shepherd tends a smaller, frailer flock beyond a stone wall.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the verse’s contrast between the stronger animals belonging to Jacob and the feebler animals belonging to Laban; the setting and appearances are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man surveys large flocks of sheep and goats in a sunny pastoral landscape, while women and men tend animals among camels, donkeys, and tents.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the abundance described in the verse; the setting and activities are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Bilhah and Jacob face one another at the entrance to a tent while another woman stands nearby in a pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined moment at the tent entrance interprets the verse; the setting, gestures, and appearance are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Bilhah holds a swaddled newborn while Jacob sits beside her inside a sunlit tent; pastoral hills and a flock appear beyond the opening.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined moment after the birth illustrates the verse; the setting and the people's expressions are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Rachel holds a swaddled infant in a woven tent, with sheep and a sunlit landscape visible beyond the entrance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Rachel with the child as she names him; the verse does not specify the setting or their appearance.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman resting in a sunlit tent cradles a swaddled newborn while a young child sits beside her. Woven textiles, pottery, and a pastoral landscape surround them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined moment after the birth illustrates the verse; the setting and figures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Inside a sunlit tent, Rachel cradles a swaddled infant and looks toward another woman standing apart, amid woven fabrics and cushions.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene interprets Rachel’s naming of Naphtali and her words about struggling with her sister; the setting and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At a woven tent, Leah presents Zilpah to Jacob in a warm pastoral landscape; the three stand together in modest clothing.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Leah presenting Zilpah to Jacob; their appearance, expressions, and setting are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A shepherd sleeps beneath a tree as streaked, speckled, and spotted rams stand among sheep in a sunlit pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes the speaker's dream and the patterned rams; the setting and sleeping figure are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob sits on bedding under a starry sky, extending an open hand toward a luminous, indistinct figure reaching toward him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the exchange in Jacob’s dream; its setting and appearance are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A shepherd looks up beside a sunlit flock on a rocky hillside, where several horned rams have streaked, speckled, or spotted coats.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the call to notice the marked rams among the flock; the setting and the shepherd's appearance are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed traveler rises with a bundle and staff beside an upright stone pillar and an oil vessel, looking toward sunlit hills and a winding road.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene brings the remembered pillar and the command to return together in one image; the verse does not describe this particular setting or moment.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two women gesture as they speak to a listening man beneath a tree, with a stone dwelling in the sunlit distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts their question; the setting, appearance, and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two troubled women talk together beneath a tree, while a man sits apart by a tent with a pouch and pieces of silver; sheep graze in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined pastoral scene suggests the speakers’ sense of being treated as strangers and their complaint about their money; its setting and actions are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two women speak with a seated man as two children listen in a pastoral camp, surrounded by packed goods and a flock, with a path winding toward distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative family scene evokes the verse’s words about riches, children, and acting on what God has said; the setting and gestures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob helps a boy onto a kneeling camel while women and children sit on other camels in a sunlit pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Jacob preparing his family on the camels; the landscape and details are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A herdsman and other travelers walk among a large flock of sheep and goats on a sunlit hill road, with bundled belongings on pack animals and mountains in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the journey with livestock and possessions; the landscape and appearance of the travelers are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Rachel gathers small figurines in a cloth inside a dwelling while Laban shears a sheep among the flock outside.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene brings the two actions of the verse into one view; the setting and appearance of the household idols are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob listens beside a tent as several men converse with tense gestures near a flock and household possessions in a sunlit pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Jacob overhearing Laban's sons; the setting, figures, and gestures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man carrying a bundle walks along a rocky path and looks back toward a distant encampment in a golden landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Jacob's unannounced departure; the landscape, camp, and visual details are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler and companions with laden animals and a flock leave a river crossing and head toward sunlit hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the river crossing and the journey toward Gilead; the people, belongings and landscape are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A messenger gestures urgently toward a startled seated man in a pastoral camp, with sheep and a winding road behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene depicts Laban receiving the report; the messenger, setting, and expressions are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man and several companions on a rocky hillside path face a traveler carrying a pack, with a winding road and sunlit hills behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the moment of overtaking; the figures, encounter and landscape details are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A startled Laban lies on woven bedding inside a tent as warm light falls across him; a moonlit encampment is visible outside.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the nighttime dream and warning; the tent, light, and distant encampment are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob stands beside a pitched tent on a rocky hillside as Laban approaches with his kinsmen; men set up a nearby tent among flocks and the hills stretch into the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This is an imaginative depiction of Laban overtaking Jacob and the two camps in the hill country of Gilead; the appearance and arrangement of the people and camps are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man gestures reproachfully toward a traveler holding a staff, while two women with bundles watch nearby in a sunlit pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Laban addressing Jacob; the verse's comparison to captives is his accusation, not a depiction of a battle.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man gestures toward a traveler looking back on a sunlit path, while a tambourine and lyre rest beside a tent.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene gives visual form to the speaker's question; the unused instruments suggest the joyful farewell he says he might have given.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man gestures with open hands as he speaks to another man, while a family and pack animals stand farther along a sunlit path.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene gives visual form to the speaker's complaint and the missed farewell; the verse does not describe the setting or gestures.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At dawn, an older man holding a staff speaks with one hand raised near his chest to a listening man, while family members stand nearby among tents and sheep in a hilly landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined pastoral encounter illustrates the speaker recounting the warning to Jacob; the setting and appearances are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob looks toward a stern, turned-away Laban at a pastoral camp, with sheep, tents and sunlit hills behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined pastoral encounter illustrates Jacob noticing the change in Laban's expression; the setting and poses are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures questioningly beside baskets and bundles as a traveler with a staff looks back at him on a sunlit highland path. A road winds toward distant houses.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined encounter suggests the longing for home and the question in the verse; the setting and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob gestures anxiously as he speaks to an older Laban on a sunlit rocky hillside; two women stand together behind Jacob beside travel bundles.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene depicts Jacob's explanation of his fear; the verse does not say that Laban took his daughters by force.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At a camp, Jacob gestures toward bundles while addressing an older man before a group of men; Rachel stands apart near a tent.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Jacob's declaration and Rachel's concealed knowledge; the setting and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older bearded man lifts the flap of a woven tent and looks inside, with other tents and sheep in a sunlit encampment behind him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Laban approaching Rachel's tent after leaving Leah's; the setting and visual details are the artist's interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Rachel sits on a bundled saddle inside a tent, watching as Laban searches through a bag among woven furnishings.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Rachel sitting on the saddle while Laban searches; the hidden idols are not visible.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated woman gestures toward an older man searching through woven bags and folded textiles inside a sunlit tent.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays her words and her father's search; the setting and visual details are an artist's interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A distressed Jacob gestures toward Laban on a rocky path, with travelers and animals on the road behind them and hills in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jacob questioning Laban after his pursuit; the landscape, clothing, and surrounding travelers are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures toward an empty space between himself and another man as kinsmen watch among open bundles and household vessels in a sunlit pastoral camp.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering portrays the verse’s challenge to bring any found item before the brothers for judgment; the setting and gestures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A shepherd gestures toward a flock as an older man listens on a sunlit hillside. Sheep, goats, lambs and a horned ram gather nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined pastoral scene evokes the speaker’s account of caring for the flock; it does not depict the full twenty years or prove the events described.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At dusk, a shepherd offers a sheep to an older man beside a flock in a rocky pasture. Fleece catches on a thorn, tracks mark the ground, and the sun and moon share the sky.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the burden of loss and the mention of day and night; the verse does not describe this particular exchange or setting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob stands with a staff on a sunlit rocky hillside, looking upward beside a winding path toward a distant settlement and hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests Jacob hearing the instruction and the journey ahead; the verse does not describe this setting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A weary man sits awake in a cloak among frost-covered rocks and grasses beneath a starry sky, with a dry valley glowing at sunset in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene brings the verse’s daytime drought, nighttime frost, and sleeplessness together in one landscape.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A shepherd gestures earnestly toward an older man beside a pastoral dwelling, with two women and a flock of sheep behind them in a golden landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the speaker recounting his years of service and changed wages; the setting and gestures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At dawn, a weary shepherd gestures with work-worn hands as an older man listens on a rocky hillside, with sheep and travel bundles nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined conversation and pastoral setting evoke the speaker’s account of hardship and labor; the details of the scene are an illustration, not details supplied by the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man gestures toward women, children, and a flock while speaking to another man in a sunlit pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Laban speaking to Jacob with the family and flock nearby; the setting, gestures, and expressions are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men in ancient clothing face each other on a rocky hillside; one extends an open hand as the other listens, with a sunlit valley and mountains behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined conversation illustrates the invitation to make a covenant; the setting and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob steadies a tall, rough stone upright amid sunlit rocky hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jacob setting up the stone; the landscape, his appearance, and the stone's size are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Men share bread and food around a heap of stones in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene portrays the meal at the heap of stones described in Genesis 31:46; the setting and appearance of the people are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men gesture toward the same heap of stones in an open pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative illustration of Laban and Jacob naming the same stone heap differently. The verse’s source names remain unchanged; withheld word glosses are not supplied by this illustration.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man gestures across a mound of stones toward another man on a sunlit, rocky hillside.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Laban speaking beside the mound described as a witness in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two robed travelers walk away on separate paths around a rocky rise, overlooking a sunlit valley at sunset.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses diverging paths to suggest the separation mentioned in the verse; the landscape and travelers are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob welcomes two women in a sunny field beside a flock of sheep, with hills and trees in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Rachel and Leah approaching Jacob by his flock; their appearance and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men in ancient robes sit facing each other on a rocky hillside; one gestures solemnly while the other listens, with a broad sunlit landscape behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene conveys the solemn private warning and does not depict God or suggest that the threatened actions occurred.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man gestures toward a mound of stones and an upright pillar between him and another man in a sunlit rocky landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Laban speaking to Jacob about the mound and pillar mentioned in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men stand on opposite sides of a mound of stones and an upright stone pillar, raising their hands in a sunlit hill country landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the mound and pillar as a boundary between the two parties; the landscape, figures, and gestures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit rocky highland, a man raises his hand solemnly while another listens across from him; both wear woven robes and hold staffs.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Jacob's oath and the solemn appeal for judgment; the setting, gestures, and appearance of the figures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Men share bread on a rocky mountain at sunset beside a smoking stone structure, with bedding laid out nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the shared meal and overnight stay after Jacob’s sacrifice; the setting and details are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man speaks to two women beneath a tree in a sunlit pastoral landscape, while an older man stands turned away among the sheep.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene interprets the speaker’s words about a changed countenance and God’s presence; the setting and poses are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A work-worn man gestures as he speaks to two women in a golden pastoral landscape, with a farm tool nearby and sheep in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the speaker addressing the women and suggests his hard work; the setting and details are an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A shepherd speaks earnestly to two women beneath a tree; an older shepherd turns away near a flock in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative pastoral scene suggests the speaker recounting deception and protection; the setting and figures are artistic choices rather than details specified in this verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A shepherd watches a flock in a golden pasture, with speckled lambs and streaked young goats near their mothers.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene brings the two descriptions of the flock together in one pastoral view; the verse describes them as alternative terms for wages.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A shepherd welcomes sheep and goats moving from a stone fold as two women stand beside him and an older man watches from the fold, in a sunlit pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined pastoral scene evokes the transfer of livestock described in the verse; its people and setting are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob kneels with clasped hands beside his staff on a rocky path overlooking sunlit hills and a distant settlement.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Jacob praying and suggests the return he recalls; the landscape and setting are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler holding a wooden staff stands on a rocky rise above a winding river, looking toward two separate camps of tents, people, and livestock in a sunlit valley.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene brings the speaker’s recollection of crossing the Jordan and his account of two camps together in one landscape.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A worried man kneels in prayer near an encampment as a mother holds two children beside a tent; an empty road winds toward distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the speaker's prayer and fear; the verse expresses a feared attack rather than describing one taking place.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man kneels on a sunlit shore, letting sand fall from his hand beside the sea.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative seashore scene pictures the verse’s comparison; the verse does not say the speaker was at the sea.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man selects folded goods by firelight beside a tent, with sheep and goats resting under a starry sky.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the overnight stay and preparation of a gift; the setting and goods are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Large flocks of goats and sheep spread across a sunlit, rocky landscape, with a bearded goat and curling-horned ram among the animals in the foreground.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined pastoral scene suggests the abundance of animals named in the verse; it does not depict a count of each flock.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A camel and her young stand beside a herd of cows and bulls, with more camels and donkeys scattered across a sunlit valley.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative pastoral scene represents the kinds of animals named in the verse; it does not depict a count of every animal.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures along a winding path as servants lead separate groups of livestock through sunlit hills, with stretches of open path between the herds.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the servants leading the herds ahead with space between them; the landscape and appearance of the people and animals are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures as he speaks to an attentive traveler beside a group of livestock on a sunlit path through the hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the instruction before the anticipated encounter; its setting and visual details are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A servant gestures toward livestock while addressing a richly dressed traveler, with another man following on a distant path.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative illustration of the message the servant is instructed to deliver. The verse gives instructions rather than narrating this meeting; appearances and setting are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At sunrise, an older man kisses a woman on the forehead as family members gather around him; a winding path leads toward distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Laban’s morning farewell and suggests his return through the distant path; the setting and appearance of the family are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures as he speaks to attentive herdsmen on a rocky path, with livestock and more handlers stretching into a sunlit landscape behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the instruction described in the verse; the setting and figures are an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob stands on a rocky path watching servants lead a caravan of livestock ahead through a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jacob following the present as it goes ahead of him; the landscape, livestock and appearance of the travelers are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man sits by a fire outside a tent at night, watching a torchlit procession with laden animals travel along a road under the moon.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the present going ahead while the man remains in camp; the appearance of the camp and procession is an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: By lantern light and beneath a moonlit sky, a man leads women and children through a shallow, rocky stream, with a donkey among them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the nighttime crossing; the landscape, lantern, and appearance of the travelers are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures toward travelers leading laden donkeys through a shallow, rocky brook in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined crossing illustrates the verse; the landscape, travelers, animals, and belongings are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men in ancient garments wrestle on rocky ground as the sun rises over distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jacob and the man wrestling as day breaks; their appearances and the landscape are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men in ancient garments wrestle on rocky ground; one touches the other's hip as he grimaces, with trees, water and distant hills in warm light.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the touch to Jacob's hip during the struggle; the setting and the figures' appearance are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At sunrise, a man grips another man’s arm on a rocky hillside as the second gestures toward the dawn over a river valley.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the exchange at daybreak and the refusal to let go without a blessing; its landscape, clothing, and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded traveler sits on a rocky hillside with one hand against his chest, looking toward an unseen person as golden light falls over a distant valley.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Jacob answering the question about his name; the landscape, light, clothing, and gesture are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated Jacob looks up at a robed figure gesturing toward him among rocks, with warm light over distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene represents the announcement of Jacob's new name; its setting and appearance are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveling Jacob pauses on a rocky path as three radiant, winged figures approach him in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Jacob's encounter with the angels of God; their appearance and the setting are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob kneels among rocks and raises a hand toward a standing figure seen from behind, who extends a hand over him in blessing. A river and hills lie in warm light beyond them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses gesture and setting to suggest Jacob's question and the blessing; the verse does not specify these visual details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob stands among rocky hills with a hand over his heart, looking upward as warm sunlight illuminates a river valley.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene portrays Jacob's awe and gratitude at Peniel; the landscape and his pose are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler with a staff and a hand on his hip walks along a rocky path as the sun rises over distant hills and a settlement.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the sunrise and the man limping as he passes Penuel; the landscape and details are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man sets aside a portion of meat on a pottery dish as a child watches; in the distance an older man walks with a staff and holds his hip.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene connects the food practice in the verse with the touch to Jacob’s hip; its household setting and figures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob stands on a rocky hillside, gesturing toward a sunlit encampment in a broad valley.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This scene imaginatively portrays Jacob’s response and the camp; the verse does not describe the landscape or the camp’s appearance.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob raises a hand beside a rocky encampment as three messengers walk along a winding path toward reddish mountains.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the messengers setting out; the verse does not describe their appearance or the setting in this detail.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob gestures as he speaks to three attentive travelers on a hillside road, with camels and a distant encampment in warm evening light.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Jacob giving the message; the setting and appearance of the people are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures toward a departing messenger while people tend oxen, a donkey, sheep and goats near a pastoral encampment.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene illustrates the sending of the message and the household described in the verse; the setting and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob listens to two messengers on a rocky hillside; one gestures toward a large company approaching along a distant road.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This is an imaginative depiction of the messengers’ report and the approaching company; the verse does not describe their appearance or setting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A worried Jacob gestures between two groups of people and livestock in a golden hill country, with sheep, cattle, and camels among them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Jacob dividing his people and animals into two camps; the landscape and individual figures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A concerned man gestures toward a distant camp while speaking to people beside a nearer camp; riders approach in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene presents the verse’s conditional danger and hope of escape as a moment of planning, not as an attack that has already happened.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit pastoral landscape, Jacob offers a wrapped gift to a smiling man who reaches toward it and rests a hand on Jacob's shoulder. Sheep and distant hills appear behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Jacob's request and the favor he describes; the gift's appearance, setting, and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men in ancient garments exchange a wrapped gift in a sunlit landscape, with pack animals and sheep nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the offered blessing as a wrapped gift and the moment of its acceptance; the verse does not specify the gift’s appearance.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two travelers speak beside a winding path through sunlit hills; one gestures toward the road ahead while the other listens.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene interprets Esau’s proposal to journey and go before the person he addresses; the setting, clothing, and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob gestures as he speaks to another man while two young children rest among sheep, lambs, cattle, and calves in a sunlit pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Jacob's concern for the children and nursing animals as he speaks; their appearance and the setting are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler gestures toward a man walking ahead on a mountain road while children and a flock of sheep and goats accompany him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene visualizes the different paces described in the verse; its landscape and figures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: On a sunlit path, Esau gestures toward companions behind him while Jacob raises his hands in a courteous response.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the exchange and its gestures; the verse does not describe their appearance or surroundings.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler seen from behind walks along a winding rocky path toward distant mountains under a blue sky.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Esau returning toward Seir; the landscape and his appearance are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob places branches on a livestock shelter beside a small house, while sheep and goats rest beneath nearby booths in a sunlit pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jacob building shelters for his livestock beside his house at Succoth; the appearance of the place and the moment shown are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler holds a tent pole beside his pitched tent and looks toward a walled city across a sunlit valley.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Jacob camping before Shechem; the appearance of the city, camp, and landscape is an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Beside a pitched tent in a sunlit field, a seated man holding a pouch and several standing men gather around an exchange of silver pieces, with hills and a settlement in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the land purchase and tent described in the verse; the appearance of the people, setting, and payment is an artist's interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob looks toward a distant procession of men while children gather around three women on a sunlit hillside.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Jacob seeing Esau approach and arranging the children; the landscape, clothing, and figures are artistic choices. Three women are visible, though the verse names Leah, Rachel, and two maidservants.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man kneels beside a newly built stone altar, his hands on its top stone, in a sunlit landscape of trees and distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the erection of the altar; the landscape, appearance, and moment shown are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures as women and children travel in a line along a sunlit, rocky path through a watercolor landscape. Two women and children lead, another woman and children follow, and a woman with a boy brings up the rear.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the order of the groups described in the verse; the landscape, appearance and gestures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man bows to the ground on a sunlit path before another man, while a group and their animals wait behind him in a hilly landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene shows one moment in the approach; the verse says he bowed seven times.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two tearful men embrace on a sunlit rocky path, one kissing the other, with travelers in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative illustration depicts the embrace, kiss and shared weeping described in the verse; its setting and visual details are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit landscape, a man gestures toward another man standing with women and children, who gather around him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates the encounter described in Genesis 33:5; the setting, appearance, and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Maidservants and children bow together on a sunlit path amid hills and fields.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This is an imaginative depiction of the maidservants and their children approaching and bowing; the setting and their appearance are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: On a sunlit pastoral path, a woman and four children bow toward a figure seen from behind. Another woman and a boy approach behind them and begin to bow.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the successive approaches and bows described in the verse; the setting, appearances, and precise gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men gesture to one another on a sunlit path, with travelers, sheep, donkeys and a camel behind them among golden hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene portrays the verse's question about the company and the reply seeking favor; the figures, setting and animals are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men meet among flocks in a sunlit pastoral landscape. One smiles and extends his hands toward the other, who stands beside sheep and pack animals.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses the brothers’ gestures and their flocks to suggest Esau’s words; the setting and visual details are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elder gestures toward a fertile valley and settlement while a visiting family listens; nearby, people exchange pottery and woven goods beside grazing animals.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene illustrates the invitation to dwell and trade in the land; its people and setting are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A young man speaks with open hands to an older man and several watchful men in a sunlit stone courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Shechem making his request; the setting and appearances are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures toward several sober listeners in a stone courtyard, with a woven textile, vessel and jewelry laid out between them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the offer and request in the verse; the setting, people and particular gifts are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man speaks with a guarded gesture as other men stand beside him, facing a younger man and an older man.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined conversation depicts the brothers' deceitful answer; the setting, appearance, and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man raises an open hand as he speaks to a group of attentive men, while others stand beside him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined courtyard conversation depicts the refusal described in the verse; the setting and appearances are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two groups of clothed men meet outside an ancient stone settlement. One man gestures as the others listen thoughtfully in a warm watercolor landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined discussion evokes the conditional proposal in the verse; the setting and participants are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two groups of men and women gather beneath a tree near a sunlit village while one man gestures toward another in conversation.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering evokes the proposed joining of families and shared life; it does not show an event described in detail by the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At a stone gateway, a robed man gestures toward a woman carrying travel bundles as he speaks to a group of men; a sunlit road and settlement lie behind her.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene presents the verse’s conditional warning as an unresolved conversation; the setting, gestures, and travel bundles are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man and a younger man listen with pleased expressions as people speak to them in a sunlit stone courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Hamor and his son Shechem responding favorably to the words; the setting and appearances are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A richly dressed young man strides through a sunlit stone courtyard while members of a household stand aside. Vines, pottery, and distant hills surround them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the young man’s promptness and standing in his household; the courtyard and the actions of its people are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Dinah walks along a sunlit path, looking toward three women gathered near a settlement among trees and hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Dinah going out to see the women of the land; the setting and appearance of the people are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man gestures to a gathering of men at a stone city gate, with a younger man standing beside him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Hamor and Shechem addressing the men at their city gate; the setting and appearances are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures toward a spacious landscape of fields, tents, and a distant caravan while a group listens near a stone town gate.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures a public discussion of the proposal; the details of the gathering and landscape are the artist's interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures toward a sunlit settlement while four men listen thoughtfully beside a stone gateway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts a discussion of the proposed condition and shared life; its setting and figures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Men converse beside a town gate as one gestures toward sheep, goats, and bundled possessions; tents and homes stand beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined discussion illustrates the verse's proposal and interest in livestock and property; the setting and figures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man and a younger man address a gathering of men at a sunlit stone city gate; a curtained doorway and folded cloth are visible nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene presents the men listening at the city gate; the private act reported in the verse is not shown.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two sword-bearing men enter an ancient stone city through an open gate; weakened and fallen men lie or crouch along the street.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This is an imaginative depiction of the attack described in Genesis 34:25; the setting and individual poses are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman walks out of a stone house between two men, one holding a lowered sword. Two motionless figures lie inside the doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Dinah leaving Shechem’s house after the killing described in the verse; the setting and appearance of the figures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Men carry baskets, vessels, and textiles from a stone city storeroom while fallen figures lie in the street beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the plundering and its aftermath; its people, setting, and details are an artistic interpretation of the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: People lead sheep, oxen, and laden donkeys along a path from a stone city beside golden fields.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the taking described in the verse; the people, setting, and individual objects are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Women carrying young children are led away by armed men while others carry vessels, textiles, and a chest from a stone house.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the captivity and plunder described in the verse; its setting and individual figures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A worried older Jacob gestures as he speaks to two younger men near family tents and sheep, with a settlement in the distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Jacob warning Simeon and Levi; the tents, household figures, landscape and gestures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two concerned men gesture as they speak to an older seated man in a sunlit courtyard, while a distressed woman sits nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family conversation conveys the speakers' protest; the setting, gestures, and presence of the woman are artistic choices beyond the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a young man gestures as he speaks to a young woman standing apart among pottery and woven fabrics.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined courtyard and the figures’ appearance illustrate the verse; the setting and their expressions are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A younger man gestures as he speaks to an older man seated in a sunlit stone courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined conversation illustrates Shechem's request to his father; the setting and appearance of the figures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older Jacob sits quietly beside a tent, looking toward men tending sheep and goats in a sunlit field.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jacob waiting silently while his sons are with the livestock; the setting and appearances are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men face each other on a sunlit path; one gestures as he speaks, while a tent and sheep stand nearby and a settlement rises in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined meeting illustrates Hamor coming to speak with Jacob; the setting, clothing, and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Grieving and angry men return along a field path toward a man beside a tent encampment; one bows his head while another clenches his fists.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene depicts the brothers returning from the field and responding to the news; the setting and messenger are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, an older man gestures as he speaks to a group of reserved listeners, while a younger man stands behind him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene represents Hamor making the request described in the verse; the setting, appearance, and reactions are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elder gestures toward another family group as men and women listen in a sunlit ancient village landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined meeting illustrates the proposal of intermarriage; the verse itself does not describe the setting or the people’s reactions.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed Jacob stands among rocky hills, looking toward warm light breaking through clouds above a broad valley.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Jacob listening as God names him Israel; the landscape, gesture, and light are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man with a staff looks across a sunlit valley of families, fields and settlements, with a procession of crowned kings in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene brings the promised future descendants and kings into one landscape; the verse records God's words and does not describe this view.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man and his family look across a sunlit valley of fields, olive trees and distant hills from a rocky hillside.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes the promised land and descendants; the verse does not describe this particular family gathering or landscape.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed man stands on a rocky hillside looking toward a luminous opening in the clouds, with distant hills and a village below.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined hillside and clearing in the clouds suggest God going up from the man after speaking with him; the verse does not describe the appearance of the place or departure.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob pours golden oil from a clay vessel onto an upright stone pillar in a sunlit rocky landscape; another vessel rests at its base.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jacob pouring oil on the pillar; the landscape, vessels, and his appearance are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob stands with a staff on a rocky hillside, extending one hand toward a sunlit valley and distant settlement.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests Jacob naming the place; the landscape, gesture, and settlement are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Rachel sits beneath a travel cloth, visibly in labor, as a woman comforts her; travelers and laden donkeys wait along a rocky road through sunlit hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene presents Rachel’s difficult labor during the journey; the people, shelter, and landscape are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a warmly lit tent, a midwife leans close and reassures a woman resting under woven blankets during labor; folded infant linens lie in a basket nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the midwife's reassurance during the difficult labor described in the verse; the setting and objects are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman rests on woven bedding and reaches toward a swaddled infant held by a grieving man in warm pastoral surroundings.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This is an imaginative depiction of the verse’s moment of loss and naming; the setting and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Grieving travelers gather beside a freshly covered grave near a winding road leading toward a distant hill settlement.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined graveside scene depicts Rachel’s burial along the road; the people and landscape are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob rises beside his travel belongings on a rocky hillside, looking toward a sunlit path winding up to a distant settlement.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Jacob responding to God’s instruction and the journey ahead; the setting and details are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob kneels beside a grave mound and steadies an upright stone pillar in a sunlit, rocky landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Jacob setting up the pillar mentioned in the verse; the landscape and visual details are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler secures the ropes of a dark tent on a sunlit hillside, with a stone tower and winding path in the distance and bundles nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Israel pitching his tent beyond the Tower of Eder; the appearance of the place and traveler is an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A solemn older man sits beneath a tree while another man speaks to him beside a pastoral encampment, with sheep and hills in the background.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Israel hearing the news; the messenger, setting, and visible reaction are artistic choices not specified in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Six young men in woven robes gather near a tent, with sheep, trees, and distant hills in a sunlit pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering of the six brothers illustrates the family relationship named in the verse; the verse itself does not describe a gathering.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman sits beneath a tree with two boys, one holding a lamb, in a sunny landscape with sheep and a tent.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family scene illustrates the relationship named in the verse; the setting, ages, and activity are not stated in it.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman sits with her arms around two boys in a sunlit courtyard, surrounded by woven textiles and pottery, with hills and trees beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative family portrait illustrates the relationship named in the verse; their ages, setting, and moment together are not specified in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman sits affectionately with two boys beside a woven tent, while a man and another woman stand nearby; sheep graze in a sunlit pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family moment reflects the relationships named in the verse; the particular scene and actions are not described in the text.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler approaches an elderly man with welcoming outstretched arms outside a dwelling, with a winding path and a distant settlement in the hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jacob arriving at Isaac’s dwelling; the appearance of the meeting and landscape is imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly, white-bearded man sits with a staff beneath an olive tree beside a tent, looking across a golden valley and winding path toward distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined quiet moment evokes Isaac’s long life; the verse gives his age and does not describe this scene.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men gently carry an elderly man wrapped in linen toward a rock-hewn burial place in a sunlit, hilly landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Isaac’s burial by his sons; the setting, clothing, and appearances are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob addresses a gathered household beside tents while people set small figurines aside, wash hands, and hold folded garments.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene brings Jacob's instructions together in one setting; the verse does not specify these visual details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler gestures toward a winding uphill path while a group with bundles, a donkey and sheep gathers around him in a sunlit rocky landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the invitation to travel to Bethel; the people, landscape and travel details are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob kneels beneath a broad tree, placing small figures and jewelry in the earth as others stand nearby with more objects; a settlement and hills lie in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jacob hiding the objects beneath the tree; the people, objects and landscape are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveling household with children and pack animals walks through a sunlit hill country while people watch from a walled city under darker clouds; other towns stand across the valley.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the journey and the surrounding cities that did not pursue Jacob’s sons; the landscape, travelers and townspeople are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older Jacob leads a group of travelers along a rocky path toward a hill settlement, with animals, olive trees and sunlit hills around them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined arrival illustrates Jacob and the people with him coming to Luz, identified in the verse as Bethel; the landscape, settlement and appearances are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed man places a stone on an altar of fieldstones in a sunlit hill country, with a winding path and distant hills behind him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This is an imaginative depiction of the altar and landscape; the verse does not describe their appearance.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Mourners gather around a stone-edged earthen grave beneath a spreading oak, with a settlement in the distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Deborah’s burial beneath the oak; the mourners and setting are artistic details beyond the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jacob kneels on a rocky hillside beside his staff and travel bundle, looking upward with open hands as golden light streams over the landscape and a path winds into distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests Jacob’s encounter and blessing through light and a journey setting; the verse does not describe the appearance in these visual details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man sits between two women and two boys outside a tent in a sunny hill country, with each woman beside a boy.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering illustrates the relationships named in the verse; the setting, ages, and gathering are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man sits outdoors surrounded by five younger men, with a tent and sunlit hills behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering illustrates the relationship named in the verse; the verse does not describe a gathering or the men’s appearance.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman cradles a smiling infant beside a seated man at the entrance of a tent, with woven textiles and sunlit hills beyond.

records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the mother with her newborn son as she names him; the setting and visual details are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A mother cradles her swaddled newborn in a warm stone dwelling, with a sunlit settlement visible through the doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the birth and naming of Shelah; the dwelling, landscape, and figures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, an older man gestures toward a woman and a younger man as they face each other.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined household introduction illustrates Judah taking Tamar as a wife for his firstborn Er; the verse does not describe the setting or encounter.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A young man lies lifeless on a woven mat in a sunlit stone room while an older man sits beside him, mourning.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene portrays the aftermath of Er’s death; the setting and mourner are artistic details, not details specified in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit courtyard, an older man speaks to a younger man while a woman stands near a doorway beside an empty cradle.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This is an imaginative depiction of Judah's instruction to Onan; the setting, gestures and empty cradle are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman gestures from a doorway while Joseph carries a basket away across a sunlit courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined household scene portrays Joseph keeping his distance as the woman speaks to him; the verse describes her repeated speech and his refusal.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph carries a basket of folded cloth as he enters a sunlit house with empty rooms beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Joseph entering to work; the house, basket and other visual details are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In an Egyptian-style room, a woman holds a patterned garment and reaches toward a man fleeing through a doorway into a sunlit courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the moment after he leaves his garment in her hand and flees outside; the setting and appearances are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman looks at a garment held in her hand as a man runs outside through an open doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the moment described in the verse; the setting, clothing, and expressions are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman gestures urgently as she speaks to several men gathered in a warmly lit household interior.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the woman addressing the household men; the setting, clothing, and gestures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman calls out while holding a garment inside an Egyptian-style room, as a man runs through a doorway into a sunlit courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the speaker's account of the garment and the man's flight; its setting and visual details are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In an imagined ancient Egyptian home, a woman sits beside a folded garment and looks toward a man arriving through the doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts her keeping the garment nearby as his master arrives home; the setting and appearance are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit Egyptian-style room, a woman gestures as she speaks to a seated man; a folded garment rests on a table nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene shows the woman giving her account. The setting, gestures, and garment are artistic details, and the illustration does not depict the alleged encounter as fact.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman calls out while holding a garment inside an Egyptian house, as a man runs through the doorway into a sunlit courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates the actions as the speaker recounts them; its setting and visual details are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In an Egyptian-style room, a woman gestures as she speaks to a seated man who listens with a stern, angry expression.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined household scene depicts the wife speaking and the master reacting to her words; the setting, clothing, and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A solemn young Joseph stands between traveling merchants and an Egyptian official exchanging a pouch in a sunlit courtyard, with camels and guards nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the purchase described in the verse; the setting, appearance, and exchange are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph stands just inside a stone prison as a guard handles the heavy wooden door and his master watches from outside; other prisoners sit in the shadows behind him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative illustration depicts Joseph being placed in the prison. The appearance of the people and prison is an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone prison, the smiling prison keeper offers a cup to Joseph, who sits on a bed and looks up at him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined exchange illustrates the favor Joseph found with the prison keeper; the verse does not describe a cup being offered.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a warm stone prison interior, the keeper gestures toward Joseph while prisoners carry supplies, work with stone, clean pottery, and sweep.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This is an imaginative depiction of Joseph's responsibility for the prisoners and the work done in the prison; the specific activities and setting are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A young man arranges clay jars and baskets of provisions in a sunlit stone prison room while the keeper walks away through a doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene shows entrusted work and the keeper stepping away; the verse does not specify these particular tasks or objects.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph arranges a large clay jar amid baskets of produce and pottery in a sunlit Egyptian household courtyard, while other workers carry baskets nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined household scene suggests Joseph’s success in his Egyptian master’s house; the verse does not describe this particular task or setting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A young servant arranges a basket of grain among abundant household goods while a richly dressed master watches thoughtfully in a sunlit courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses a household task and full baskets to evoke the prosperity the master observed; the verse does not specify these details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A household master gestures toward stored goods while standing beside Joseph in a sunlit courtyard, as workers handle baskets and vessels nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined household scene illustrates the favor and responsibility described in the verse; its particular setting and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph gestures to workers carrying baskets of produce beside an Egyptian house, with abundant crops and harvesters in the fields beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene portrays Joseph overseeing a flourishing estate to evoke the blessing described in the verse; its people, activities, and setting are artistic interpretation.
