records_chirho.alt_chirho: A young Joseph tends sacks of grain in a sunlit courtyard while a richly dressed man sits nearby holding bread; workers and household provisions fill the background.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined household scene portrays the trust and food mentioned in the verse; its setting and activities are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit household, a richly dressed woman reclines and gestures toward Joseph, who stands across the room in a simple tunic.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the invitation in Genesis 39:7; the setting, clothing, and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A young steward raises an open hand while speaking to a richly dressed woman in a sunlit Egyptian household surrounded by baskets, vessels, and stores.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts his refusal and suggests the household possessions entrusted to his care; the setting and gestures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient household, a young man wearing keys raises an open hand toward a seated woman, who looks up at him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the speaker refusing the woman; the setting, appearance, and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A troubled man looks down at a dark red stain in the earth beneath a luminous, cloud-filled sky.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes the blood crying from the ground and the solemn divine question; it does not portray the voice literally.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A solemn man looks at his blood-stained hand beside a fissure in the reddish ground, in a sunlit, rocky landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the ground receiving the brother's blood; the setting and the man's appearance are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A solitary man carrying a bundle walks along a winding road past a tilled patch with withered plants and a hoe, toward distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses an unproductive field and a departing traveler to express the verse’s words about the ground and wandering.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Cain kneels among rocks in a sunlit, rugged landscape, looking upward with one hand raised and an anguished expression.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Cain speaking in distress; the landscape and his posture are artistic choices, not details stated in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A worried man carrying a bundle looks back toward cultivated fields as he walks along a rocky path into a wide landscape at sunset.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene conveys the speaker’s displacement, wandering, and fear; the landscape and moment are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A wary traveler looks back toward another traveler who pauses on a rocky path in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined encounter suggests the protection described in the verse; the verse does not describe the sign or such an encounter.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man with a travel bundle stands beside a simple shelter overlooking a sunlit valley, with a winding path leading back toward distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests Cain arriving at a dwelling in Nod; the landscape, shelter, and journey details are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures toward a city under construction while a woman beside him holds a young child, in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene connects Cain's family with the city he named after Enoch; the figures and setting are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A family of several ages gathers outside a dwelling, smiling toward a newborn held by a man, with a sunlit landscape beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering evokes the succession of generations; the verse does not describe such a meeting or its setting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man sits between two women outside a stone dwelling, with pottery, vines, and a sunlit landscape around them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined domestic moment represents Lamech with his two wives; the verse does not describe their appearance or setting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A mother cradles her newborn child beside a smiling father beneath a leafy tree.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative rendering of Adam and Eve with newborn Cain after the birth. Clothing and setting are artistic choices; no claim is made about their historical appearance.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man tends sheep and goats beside a woven tent, where a woman sits, in a sunny pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined pastoral scene suggests Jabal's connection to tent dwellers and livestock; the verse does not describe this particular moment or setting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man plays a lyre-like harp beside a young flute player under a tree, with sheep, a goat, and a sunlit valley around them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined moment evokes Jubal’s connection to those who play the harp and flute; the verse does not describe this particular gathering or setting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient workshop, a metalworker points toward glowing metal as another raises a hammer. Two women watch beside bronze-colored vessels, with dark tools and a forge nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative workshop brings the verse’s family and metalworking instruction together in one moment; the setting, appearances, and encounter are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A bandaged Lamech speaks with open hands to two concerned women beside a stone dwelling in warm evening light.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Lamech addressing his wives; the setting, gestures, bandage and expressions are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A stern man raises his hand on a rocky rise above a golden landscape, while a solitary figure walks a distant path and long shadows cross the ground.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene uses a declaration and a distant figure to evoke the verse’s comparison; the setting and figures’ positions are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A mother cradles a swaddled newborn while Adam sits beside her, both looking tenderly at the child outside a simple dwelling in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family moment illustrates Seth's birth; the setting and the family's appearance are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man holds a swaddled infant as family members gather around him with hands raised or clasped beneath a tree at sunrise.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering brings together the birth of Enosh and the beginning of calling on the name of Yahweh; the verse does not describe the setting or the people’s gestures.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A shepherd stands among sheep on a flowered hillside while another man hoes a cultivated field nearby, beneath a bright sky.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Abel tending sheep and Cain working the ground, as described in Genesis 4:2.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Cain carries a basket of fruit and grain toward a stone offering place beside cultivated fields in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene shows Cain bringing produce as an offering; the landscape, basket and stone offering place are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Abel kneels beside a stone altar with a lamb resting on it as smoke rises; sheep graze in a sunlit pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Abel presenting his offering; the altar, landscape, smoke, and sunlight are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A downcast Cain sits with his head bowed and hands tense beside an offering of grain and produce on stones, in a sunlit rural landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene expresses Cain’s anger and fallen countenance beside his offering; the setting and visible details are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A downcast Cain sits with clasped hands beneath a tree beside cultivated fields, while warm sunlight falls over the distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined setting and posture evoke the moment when Yahweh asks Cain about his anger and fallen countenance; the verse does not describe these visual details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A serious man stands at an open doorway, facing an indistinct crouching shadow outside.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative visual metaphor for sin crouching at the door and the call to rule over it. The shadow is not a literal creature identified by the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a golden field, a man covers his face as another lies still among the grain.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts an aftermath of Cain killing his brother Abel in the field; its setting and figures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A troubled Cain gestures with open hands beside an empty path through a sunlit, rocky landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Cain responding to God’s question about his brother; the landscape and his gestures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A gnarled grapevine with three main branches bears buds, pale blossoms, and clusters of purple grapes in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene gathers the budding, blossoming, and ripening described in the verse into one moment.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit Egyptian palace, a cupbearer offers a golden cup to a seated Pharaoh. Grapes and a bowl of purple juice sit in the foreground.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the cup being given to Pharaoh, with grapes nearby suggesting the earlier pressing. The setting and appearance of the figures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph gestures with three fingers while speaking to a seated man, beneath a dreamlike image of a grapevine with three branches.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The scene imaginatively portrays Joseph explaining the meaning of the three branches; the vine is shown as a visual evocation of the interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit Egyptian royal hall, a cupbearer offers an ornate cup to the outstretched hand of a seated Pharaoh.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the restoration and return to service promised in the verse; the setting and appearance of the people are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone room, a simply dressed man gestures earnestly to a seated Egyptian man, who listens with a hand over his heart. A barred window and a bright passage frame their conversation.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the speaker's appeal for remembrance and kindness; the verse does not describe the setting or gestures shown.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A young man gestures earnestly to a seated listener in a stone dungeon, where sunlight enters through a small high window.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the speaker describing his confinement; the setting and figures are artistic interpretations of the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A baker gestures as Joseph listens in a stone room; an imagined dream appears beside them, showing the baker carrying three baskets of bread on his head.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the baker telling Joseph about the three baskets in his dream; the setting and appearances are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Birds eat breads and pastries from the top of a stack of woven baskets balanced on a concerned man’s head in an imagined ancient Egyptian setting.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates the birds eating the baked food described in the verse; the setting and the man’s appearance are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph gestures toward three woven baskets while speaking to a seated man in a sunlit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Joseph explaining the three baskets; the setting and listener are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit Egyptian palace, a worried cupbearer holding a cup and a baker holding a basket of bread stand before a displeased king seated on his throne.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined palace encounter illustrates the cupbearer and baker offending their king; the verse does not describe the setting or their expressions.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At an Egyptian palace feast, Pharaoh gestures toward a cupbearer holding a golden cup and a baker carrying bread as servants gather around the table.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Pharaoh acknowledging the two officials at his birthday feast; the setting and visual details are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit Egyptian palace, a cupbearer offers a golden cup toward the open hand of the seated Pharaoh.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the cupbearer's return to service and the cup being offered to Pharaoh; the setting and appearance are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A basket and loaves lie in the foreground of an Egyptian setting; in the distance, a shrouded figure hangs from a wooden post while attendants stand nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the chief baker’s hanging; the setting and objects are artistic details, not details specified in this verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A cupbearer carrying a golden cup walks through a sunlit Egyptian hall while Joseph sits in a shadowed room beyond a doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses a palace passage and a room to suggest the separation implied by the cupbearer's forgetting; the verse does not describe the setting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An angry Pharaoh points toward two worried officials in an Egyptian palace; one holds a cup and the other a basket of bread.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This is an imaginative depiction of Pharaoh’s anger toward the two officers; the palace setting and their poses are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A guard leads two detained men into a sunlit stone prison chamber, where Joseph sits and looks toward them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the men entering the prison where Joseph was confined; its appearance and the figures’ actions are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph pours water for two seated men in a sunlit stone room of custody while the captain of the guard gestures from the doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Joseph serving the men in custody; the setting, gestures, and act of pouring water are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men sleep on separate mats in a stone prison at night, with distinct blue and golden dreamlike currents above them and moonlight entering through a barred opening.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene represents the two prisoners dreaming on the same night; the glowing currents and details of the prison are artistic choices, not details stated in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph enters a sunlit stone room and looks with concern at two sorrowful seated men.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Joseph noticing their sadness in the morning; the setting and appearances are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone chamber, a man gestures toward two downcast Egyptian officials seated beside him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the question and the officers' sadness; the setting and their appearance are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph sits in a sunlit stone room, extending an open hand toward two concerned men, one of whom gestures as he speaks.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined conversation illustrates Joseph inviting the men to tell him their dreams; the setting and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures toward a luminous grapevine as another man listens in a stone room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the cupbearer recounting his dream to Joseph; the setting and appearance of the vision are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two apprehensive men are led toward a guarded chamber as Pharaoh gestures from a sunlit Egyptian courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the verse’s account of the two servants being placed in custody; the setting and visual details are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men sleep on separate beds in a moonlit room, with distinct golden and blue dreamlike clouds above them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the two dreams on the same night; the setting and dream imagery are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone chamber, a young man seated between two men gestures as one speaks and the other listens.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the conversation described in the verse; the setting, appearance, and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In an imagined Egyptian court, an official receives a golden cup while a ruler looks on; beyond the doorway a figure stands beneath a gallows.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the restoration and alludes to the other man’s hanging; the court setting and ceremonial details are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A clean-shaven Joseph in white clothing is guided into a sunlit Egyptian hall toward Pharaoh, who sits on a raised throne. A dark passage is visible behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Joseph arriving before Pharaoh after being brought from the dungeon and preparing himself; the setting and figures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit Egyptian palace, Pharaoh gestures from his throne toward Joseph, who stands listening, while guards stand among the columns.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Pharaoh speaking to Joseph; the setting and figures are artistic interpretations of the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph speaks with an open hand before a seated Pharaoh, who listens in a sunlit Egyptian palace.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Joseph speaking to Pharaoh; the setting, gestures, and expressions are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A contemplative Pharaoh in Egyptian royal dress stands among reeds on the sandy bank of a broad river, looking toward palms and a distant shore.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Pharaoh on the Nile bank as he describes his dream to Joseph.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Seven well-fed cows emerge from a sunlit river and graze among tall green reeds in a watercolor landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the seven cows coming out of the river and feeding among the reeds described in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A herd of thin, ribbed cows follows healthier cows along an Egyptian riverbank, with palms, boats and a distant city in warm watercolor.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the other gaunt cows coming after the first animals. The overlapping herd does not clearly show exactly seven gaunt cows, as the verse specifies.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Pharaoh stands among reeds beside the sunlit Nile, looking across the water toward palms and distant Egyptian buildings.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Pharaoh standing by the Nile as he does in his dream; the landscape and his appearance are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit landscape, gaunt cows swallow plump cows in a surreal, bloodless scene.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative illustration depicts the verse’s unsettling account of gaunt cows eating the first seven fat cows.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A startled man sits awake in bed at sunrise, looking toward a fading dream of gaunt animal forms in the clouds.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the awakening and the unchanged appearance described in the verse; the dream figures and setting are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Seven plump golden heads of grain branch from one stalk above a sunlit field, with distant hills and a village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the seven full heads on one stalk described in the dream; the landscape is an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Withered grain heads bend in a dusty wind before a field of golden grain, with hills and a village in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene visualizes the withered grain and wind; the foreground appears to show eight heads rather than the seven specified in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An Egyptian ruler gestures toward a group of puzzled men as a dreamlike vision of withered grain bending over golden heads fills the sky above them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the strange grain and the speaker telling the magicians; the composition is an artistic interpretation of the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph gestures as he speaks to Pharaoh, who listens from a throne in a sunlit Egyptian palace.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Joseph speaking to Pharaoh; the setting and appearance of the people are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Seven healthy cows stand in a sunlit meadow behind seven prominent golden heads of grain, with a river and hills in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene brings the good cows and grain together in one landscape to suggest their shared meaning in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Gaunt cows move along a riverbank opposite a distant herd, while seven drooping grain heads rise from cracked, dry ground in an Egyptian landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined landscape brings together the thin cows and blighted grain as visual signs of the famine described in the verse. The illustration shows eight foreground cows rather than the seven stated in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A speaker gestures toward Pharaoh, who listens from his throne in a sunlit Egyptian palace, as attendants stand nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative palace scene depicts the speaker addressing Pharaoh; the setting and figures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Farmers gather golden grain beside the Nile, with green fields, palms, boats, and an Egyptian settlement in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined harvest scene illustrates the abundance described in the verse; it does not portray a specific event named in it.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Seven well-fed brown and white cows emerge from a river and graze among tall reeds in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the seven cows coming up from the Nile and feeding among the reeds described in Genesis 41:2.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A family looks across a dry, depleted field beside a mud-brick granary, with baskets and scattered grain in the foreground and a settlement in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes the famine and depleted land described in the verse; the family and setting are artistic additions.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A family stands beside an empty basket in a parched field, looking toward a distant settlement under a dusty sky.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family and landscape portray the severity of the famine described in the verse; the particular people and setting are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A thoughtful Pharaoh sits awake in an Egyptian palace at dawn, beneath two similar dreamlike landscapes.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the repeated dream and its approaching fulfillment; the verse does not describe this setting or the dreamlike landscapes.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In an Egyptian palace, a seated Pharaoh gestures toward a standing man while attendants watch; the Nile and cultivated land are visible beyond the columns.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene presents Pharaoh considering a man for responsibility over Egypt; the verse gives a recommendation and does not describe this particular moment or setting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit Egyptian harvest, workers gather grain into five piles as a richly dressed official gestures beside an attendant; fields, a river and a large storehouse extend behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined harvest scene illustrates the proposed collection during years of plenty; the verse does not describe this particular moment or setting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Workers carry baskets and pour golden grain into a storage bin beside granaries in an ancient Egyptian city, while an official watches.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the gathering and storage described in the verse; its people and setting are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Inside an Egyptian granary filled with grain, a worker hands a basket to a man while families wait nearby; a dry landscape and river lie beyond the doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene visualizes the verse’s food reserve and its purpose of preserving the land through famine; the people and setting are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit Egyptian court, Pharaoh and his servants look approvingly toward a speaker standing before them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined court scene represents Pharaoh and his servants receiving the advice favorably; its setting and gestures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In an imagined Egyptian palace, Pharaoh gestures toward a standing man while his servants look on.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Pharaoh's question through the gestures and expressions of the people; the verse does not describe the setting or their appearance.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit Egyptian palace, Pharaoh sits and gestures toward Joseph, who stands listening, while attendants watch nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Pharaoh speaking with Joseph; the palace setting, gestures, and attendants are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Thin, ribbed cows emerge from the Nile beside a group of fuller cows on a sunlit riverbank, with palms and ancient buildings in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the cows coming from the Nile and gathering beside the others; the illustration shows more than the seven thin cows specified in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit Egyptian royal hall, a ruler seated on an elevated throne gestures toward an administrator standing before attentive attendants.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined royal court scene expresses the verse's delegation of authority while keeping the throne above the appointed administrator.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Pharaoh, seated on an ornate throne, gestures toward Joseph in an Egyptian palace overlooking the Nile and cultivated fields.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Pharaoh speaking to Joseph; the palace setting and view of Egypt are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit Egyptian palace, Pharaoh places a signet ring on Joseph’s hand. Joseph wears pale linen and a gold chain, while attendants stand among painted columns.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene brings together the actions described in the verse; the setting, appearance, and moment are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A richly dressed man rides in a horse-drawn chariot through an Egyptian city as attendants sound trumpets and people bow along the road.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative procession depicts the chariot ride and public recognition described in the verse; the figures, setting, and details are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Pharaoh gestures toward Joseph in a sunlit Egyptian palace as officials look on; the Nile and cultivated land are visible beyond the columns.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative palace scene illustrates Pharaoh’s declaration of Joseph’s authority; the setting and gestures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In an Egyptian palace, Pharaoh gestures toward Joseph and Asenath as an older priest stands beside them; a road leads through the green Nile valley beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene brings the naming and marriage together in a palace setting, with the distant road suggesting Joseph going out over Egypt. The setting and gestures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph walks away from an Egyptian palace toward a sunlit river landscape of fields and settlements.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene shows Joseph beginning his journey after leaving Pharaoh’s presence; the setting and clothing are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Harvesters gather and bind golden grain in a vast, sunlit field, with a village and hills in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative harvest scene expresses the abundance described in the verse; its people and setting are illustrative details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Workers carry baskets and sacks of grain from golden fields into an Egyptian storehouse, where others pour and stack the harvest.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures harvest from the surrounding fields being gathered and stored in an Egyptian city; its people, buildings, and moment are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph stands among vast heaps of golden grain as workers carry baskets and fill storehouses in an ancient Egyptian courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the abundance described in the verse; its setting and details are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Pharaoh sits startled in bed as a dreamlike vision shows gaunt cows biting plump cows in an Egyptian landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene combines the cows in the dream with Pharaoh waking; the setting and visual details are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph and Asenath sit with their two young sons in a shaded Egyptian courtyard overlooking fertile fields and a town.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative family scene evokes the birth of Joseph and Asenath’s two sons before the famine; the setting and moment are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph cradles an infant and looks upward in a sunlit room overlooking an Egyptian landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined moment of Joseph holding his son illustrates the naming in the verse; the setting and pose are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A father smiles at an infant in his arms beside a sunlit garden, with a dry landscape and distant village beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes the naming and the contrast between fruitfulness and affliction; its setting and details are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At sunset, workers gather golden grain beside the Nile and carry baskets toward a full Egyptian granary.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined harvest at sunset suggests the close of Egypt’s years of plenty; the verse does not describe this particular scene.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An Egyptian gives bread to a family beside a granary while travelers approach across a dry landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the contrast between famine in the lands and bread in Egypt; its people and setting are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Hungry families with empty baskets appeal to Pharaoh in an Egyptian courtyard as he points toward an official by a granary; dry fields stretch beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the people appealing for bread and Pharaoh directing them toward Joseph. The setting and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An Egyptian official stands at an open grain storehouse while a worker fills a sack and a man offers a pouch; families wait against a backdrop of parched fields.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Joseph opening the stores and selling grain during the famine; the setting and individual figures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Travelers with donkeys and sacks approach an Egyptian granary across a dry landscape, while Joseph pours grain into a visitor's sack and workers handle grain nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts people coming to Joseph in Egypt for grain during the widespread famine; the setting and individual interactions are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Seven full golden heads of grain rise from one stalk in a luminous dream, while a man sleeps in the background.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the seven healthy heads of grain in the second dream; the setting and appearance of the dream are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Seven dry, bent grain heads stand in dusty ground as wind sweeps across a golden field beneath a bright sky.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the seven blighted heads and suggests the east wind and earlier growth described in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Pharaoh sits awake in an Egyptian chamber, looking toward a dreamlike vision of thin, withered grain heads bending over full golden heads.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene brings the grain of the dream into Pharaoh’s chamber as he wakes; the verse describes the dream and his awakening.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A troubled Pharaoh gestures from his throne toward a group of puzzled advisers in a sunlit Egyptian palace.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Pharaoh telling his dreams to Egypt's magicians and wise men, who cannot interpret them for him.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A cupbearer gestures toward his chest as he speaks to a seated Pharaoh in a sunlit Egyptian palace, with a golden cup nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the cupbearer addressing Pharaoh; the palace setting, appearance, and gestures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A group of travelers with empty sacks addresses a seated official beside baskets of grain in a sunlit courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the speakers’ request; the setting, clothing, and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A group of men stand together in a richly decorated ancient hall as one speaks with open hands to a seated official.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the speakers making the claim expressed in the verse; the setting and appearance are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An official gestures toward a broken defensive wall as a group of travelers listen in a sunlit stone courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined courtyard and broken wall illustrate the accusation; the verse itself does not describe the setting or a damaged wall.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone hall, a man gestures as a group of brothers speak to a seated listener. Through an arch, an older man and a younger figure stand near a distant dwelling.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the brothers describing their family; the distant father and youngest son give visual form to their account.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph, dressed as an Egyptian official, gestures toward a group of concerned men in a sunlit stone hall.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined setting and arrangement portray Joseph repeating his accusation; the verse does not describe these visual details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An Egyptian official gestures solemnly toward anxious travelers gathered in a sunlit hall, with guards standing by the doorway behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene visualizes the announced test and the condition of the youngest brother coming; its setting and figures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An Egyptian official gestures toward a sunlit road and a departing traveler while other anxious men remain near a guarded doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the instruction to send one man and keep the others confined while their words are tested; its setting and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A group of men in ancient clothing sit together in a stone holding room, lit by a small high window beside a heavy closed wooden door.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene depicts the group confined together; their appearance and surroundings are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph, dressed as an Egyptian official, gestures as he speaks to a group of attentive men in a sunlit stone chamber.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Joseph speaking to the men; the setting and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man stands behind the bars of a stone prison as several men carrying grain depart with a laden donkey, some looking back at him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the separation and journey described in the verse; its people and setting are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Jacob gestures toward his gathered sons in a sunlit courtyard, with a nearly empty grain basket in the foreground and a road leading toward a distant city.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined courtyard scene interprets Jacob’s question to his sons; the setting, basket, and distant city are artistic details not specified in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated official gestures toward a group of attentive men with travel bundles in a sunlit ancient courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the instruction being given; the verse also says that the men did as instructed.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Men in earth-toned robes gather in a warmly lit stone room, speaking together with troubled expressions and clasped hands.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the brothers speaking together in distress; the setting and their gestures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A concerned man gestures as he speaks to a group of downcast men in an imagined ancient landscape, painted in warm watercolor.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Reuben addressing the others and suggests their troubled response; the setting and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit Egyptian-style chamber, several men speak quietly together while an interpreter gestures between them and an attentive seated Joseph.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Joseph understanding the men while an interpreter stands between them; the setting and appearances are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a warmly lit ancient room, a sorrowful man stands beside Simeon as his wrists are bound with rope, while a group of men watches with concern.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene brings the verse's return and binding into one moment; the setting, clothing, and expressions are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit storehouse, a worker pours grain into a sack while another places a pouch of silver into a second sack. Joseph gestures behind them, and bread, fruit and jars sit nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene brings the verse's commanded preparations together in one storehouse moment; its setting and visual details are an artist's interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Travelers lead donkeys laden with grain along a sunlit road, leaving a settlement behind.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts their departure with the grain; the setting and appearance of the travelers are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A surprised traveler opens a sack of grain and sees silver inside while his donkey eats beside a rustic lodging.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene pictures the discovery described in the verse; the lodging, clothing, and arrangement are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler holds silver beside an open sack as his brothers gather around him and exchange alarmed looks.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the discovery and the brothers’ fearful reaction described in the verse; its setting and visual details are an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Jacob listens outside a dwelling as one of several gathered travelers speaks with open hands; bundles lie nearby and hills and olive trees stretch into the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the family conversation; the setting, appearances and gestures are artistic choices beyond the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man gestures toward a distant Egyptian settlement while men listen and prepare empty sacks beside a nearly empty grain basket.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the instruction and the hoped-for journey; its setting and visual details are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A stern ruler points toward anxious travelers in a sunlit ancient hall, while a guard stands nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined encounter gives visual form to the speakers’ report; the setting and appearances are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient hall, a man gestures openly as he and three companions face a seated man who listens.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the speakers' declaration to the man; the setting and appearances are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A young man sits beside an elderly man outside a sunlit home, resting a hand on his shoulder. An empty place lies beside them, with hills and a winding path beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the youngest brother with his father in Canaan; the verse does not describe their appearance or surroundings.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit Egyptian courtyard, a seated ruler gestures toward men gathering sacks of grain, while one man stands beside him. The travelers look back as they prepare to leave.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the ruler’s instructions and the brothers’ separation; the verse does not describe the setting or their appearances.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An Egyptian official gestures while a group of travelers listen in a sunlit courtyard, with guards, sacks and trade goods nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the request and the promise as a conversation; its setting and visual details are an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Men and their elderly father react in alarm to bundles and silver visible in open sacks in a sunlit courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the discovery and fear described in the verse; the setting and appearance of the people are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Jacob gestures in distress as several solemn sons gather around him in a warmly lit household.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined household scene expresses Jacob’s lament and his fear of losing Benjamin; the setting and gestures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man extends an open hand toward a grave, seated elder in a warmly lit stone room, while two young men and another man watch nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family scene portrays Reuben's solemn pledge; the setting, gestures and onlookers are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A gray-haired father holds his seated son close and gestures toward travelers with bundles outside a stone dwelling; a winding road leads into sunlit hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined household scene portrays the father’s protective refusal and fear for the journey; the verse does not specify the setting or gestures shown.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Ten men with sacks and pack donkeys walk down a sunlit road toward an Egyptian city and its granaries.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the brothers’ journey to buy grain; the landscape, clothing, and details are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man holds a younger man close beside a stone dwelling as a group of men walks away along a sunlit path.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Jacob keeping Benjamin near him while his brothers depart; the setting and appearances are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Men carrying sacks arrive among a crowd of travelers at a grain distribution place, where grain is being measured into sacks beneath a canvas awning.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the sons of Israel among other travelers seeking grain; the setting and people’s appearances are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph sits above a group of men bowing with their faces to the ground in a sunlit Egyptian-inspired courtyard, with grain and people gathered behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the brothers bowing before Joseph and suggests his role selling to the people; its setting and details are an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A stern Joseph in Egyptian official dress watches a group of travelers as one gestures toward him in a courtyard filled with grain sacks and baskets.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Joseph questioning his brothers and their answer; the setting, clothing, gestures, and expressions are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph, dressed in blue and gold, looks thoughtfully toward a group of men who look back at him in a sunlit ancient courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the contrast between Joseph recognizing his brothers and their not recognizing him; its setting, clothing, and expressions are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit Egyptian hall, a seated Joseph gestures toward a group of concerned, travel-worn men.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Joseph speaking to the men as he remembers his dreams; the setting and expressions are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler gestures toward a winding road as companions and packed donkeys wait beside a stone dwelling in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the urgency and delay expressed in the verse; its setting and figures are illustrative.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Israel gestures while four sons listen and prepare bundles in a sunlit courtyard. Jars, aromatic goods, pistachios and almonds are arranged before them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Israel giving his instruction as his sons gather the gift; the verse itself records his words.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit courtyard, an older man gestures as travelers gather silver into pouches beside open grain sacks; a loaded camel waits nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the preparation suggested by the verse; the setting and visual details are an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Travelers walk together along a sunlit road, with one man resting a hand on a younger companion’s shoulder and a settlement in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the group setting out with their brother; the setting and their appearance are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man raises his hand in prayer as four attentive travelers gather beside him, with packed animals and a winding road behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene presents the prayer before a journey; the verse expresses hope for mercy and release alongside the speaker's acceptance of possible bereavement.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Travelers stand before an Egyptian official in a sunlit court, carrying a wrapped gift and two silver-colored bags, with a younger man among them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the men and Benjamin standing before Joseph after their journey to Egypt; the setting and appearance of the gift are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph gestures toward his steward as Benjamin and other travelers stand nearby; the steward welcomes them into a sunlit Egyptian house where workers prepare food.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene visualizes Joseph's instruction and the preparations for the noon meal; the setting, appearances, and gestures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man in Egyptian-style dress gestures toward a richly decorated interior as a group of men enters through a doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the man bringing the men into Joseph's house; the setting and appearances are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Anxious travelers confer beside laden donkeys and an open sack of silver while an Egyptian attendant gestures toward a grand doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the men’s fear as they are brought toward Joseph’s house; the attack and enslavement they anticipate are not shown as events that have happened.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A group of men speak with a steward standing in the doorway of a sunlit Egyptian residence.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the approach and conversation at the doorway; the appearance of the people and house is an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A nearly empty basket lies beside a dry, depleted grain field, with distant figures and a stone settlement under a bright sky.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene evokes the severe famine described in the verse; its landscape, basket, settlement, and figures are illustrative details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A group of travelers in robes speak earnestly to a man beside sacks of grain at a sunlit storehouse.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the speakers explaining their earlier journey to buy food; the setting and figures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Travelers at an encampment look in surprise at silver in their open sacks; one holds pieces of silver in his hand.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene depicts the discovery described in the verse; the setting and figures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit granary courtyard, travelers speak with an attendant beside sacks of grain. One holds silver in his palm, while more silver lies in an open travel sack.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the speakers bringing silver for food and wondering about the silver found in their sacks; its setting and figures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit Egyptian courtyard, a smiling official stands beside a man as travelers greet them; an open sack of silver rests among their belongings.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined reunion portrays the reassurance and Simeon being brought out; the setting, gestures, and appearance of the people are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit courtyard, travelers wash their feet in basins while a man welcomes others and donkeys eat fodder nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined courtyard scene portrays the welcome, foot washing, and feeding of the donkeys described in the verse; its visual details are imaginative.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Travelers arrange a basket and wrapped gift in a sunlit courtyard, with bread set on a nearby table.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the preparation and anticipated meal; the courtyard and details of the gift are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient house, several men bow low before Joseph, with a wrapped gift and a basket set between them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the gift brought to Joseph and the men bowing before him; the setting, appearances and gift are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit hall, a richly dressed man gestures toward a group of attentive travelers seated before him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the inquiry; the verse does not describe the setting or the men’s expressions.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Several robed men bow low on a woven carpet before a seated listener in a sunlit ancient hall.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the men's respectful bow after their answer; the setting and figures are an artist's interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A richly dressed man looks up and reaches toward a younger man while three other men watch in a warm, detailed interior.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative watercolor scene portrays the encounter and gracious address described in Genesis 43:29; the setting, appearances and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly father gestures toward a road while speaking to four men in a sunlit courtyard. An empty sack and a bowl with a few grains lie in front of them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the father speaking after the grain has been eaten; the setting and appearances are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph sits alone in a warm, sunlit chamber, leaning forward with one hand covering his face. An open doorway, curtain, woven furnishings and pottery surround him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene depicts Joseph weeping in his chamber; the room, clothing and furnishings are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A composed man with a towel gestures toward a table as an attendant brings a basket of bread; a washbasin stands behind him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene brings together the verse’s washing, self-restraint, and instruction to serve bread; its setting and appearance are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit Egyptian dining hall, one man sits at a table alone, Hebrew men dine at another table, and Egyptian diners sit together at a third as servants carry food.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined dining hall and its people visualize the separate places described in the verse; their appearance and the setting are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient hall, a seated host faces a row of men who exchange surprised looks, with an older man at one end and a younger man at the other.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the seating and the men's astonished glances; the setting and appearance of the people are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At a warmly lit banquet, a host and guests raise cups while a server sets a large platter of food before Benjamin, whose serving is much larger than the others.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative banquet scene portrays the generous portion given to Benjamin and the shared drinking and merriment described in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man gestures as he speaks to an older seated man, while a younger man stands between them in a sunlit stone dwelling.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined conversation illustrates Judah recounting the warning; the setting, gestures and presence of the younger man are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Outside a stone dwelling, a man gestures toward a younger companion while speaking to a seated elder. Other travelers gather with sacks beside a road through a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family conversation and setting depict the conditional request before the proposed journey; the verse does not describe these visual details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit courtyard, a man speaks earnestly to an older seated man while three others listen; travel bundles rest by an open doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined household conversation and the waiting travel bundles illustrate the verse’s conditional refusal to go without the brother.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly, gray-bearded Israel sits with his hands extended in a questioning gesture as four men listen in a warmly lit dwelling.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined conversation portrays Israel’s question; the setting and the listeners’ appearance are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures earnestly to an older man in a sunlit room while several worried men listen nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined household conversation illustrates the speakers’ explanation; the verse does not describe the setting or their appearance.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit courtyard, Judah gestures toward a young traveler as he speaks to an elderly Israel, while children gather close beside them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined household scene portrays Judah’s appeal; the setting, appearances, and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man gestures earnestly toward an elderly seated man while a younger man stands nearby and listens.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined conversation depicts the speaker's promise and responsibility; the verse itself does not describe the setting or gestures.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An official gestures toward anxious travelers gathered beside closed bundles, with a sunlit town and mountains beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the speaker announcing the condition before any discovery; the setting and figures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Men kneel and bend over open woven sacks on a sunlit road, with loaded animals and a distant village behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the men opening their sacks; the setting and their appearance are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A searcher discovers a cup in an open sack as a young man and older men watch anxiously beside their belongings on a dusty road.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the discovery described in the verse; the people, setting, and expressions are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Distressed men in torn garments load donkeys and travel along a dusty road toward a distant city; one man grips the torn front of his clothing.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the tearing of clothes, loading of donkeys, and return to the city described in the verse; the setting and appearances are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient interior, a group of men bow to the floor before Joseph, who stands nearby in elaborate clothing.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Judah and his brothers falling before Joseph; the setting and appearances are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph in Egyptian attire gestures toward a group of apprehensive men in a sunlit hall.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Joseph questioning the men; the setting, gestures, and expressions are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Judah kneels with open hands before a seated lord as worried companions gather around him; an ornate cup stands nearby in a sunlit hall.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Judah addressing his lord and his companions sharing his submission. The setting and appearances are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit Egyptian hall, an official gestures toward a group of travelers near an open doorway. A troubled man stands apart beside a cup.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene represents the speaker’s decision and the separation it describes; its setting and details are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Judah kneels and gestures earnestly toward a seated Egyptian official in a sunlit hall, while guards stand in the background.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Judah’s respectful approach and appeal; the setting, clothing, and gestures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated lord extends a questioning hand toward attentive men in a sunlit ancient hall.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene pictures the question described in the verse; the setting and gestures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit storehouse, a steward places a piece of silver at the mouth of a sack heaped with grain, while a richly dressed man gestures behind him and other full sacks stand nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the steward carrying out the instructions in Genesis 44:1; the setting and appearance of the people are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly father rests a hand on his younger son’s shoulder as they sit together in a stone dwelling overlooking a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family moment evokes the father’s love and the loss described in the verse; the verse itself recounts what was said to a lord.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient audience chamber, a seated official extends his hand toward three attentive men while a guard stands behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the request being spoken; the setting and figures' appearances are artistic choices beyond the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A young man holds the hand of a frail elderly father in a sunlit dwelling, with a travel bundle beside the open doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the bond and feared separation described in the verse; the setting and figures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An official gestures toward concerned travelers in a sunlit ancient audience chamber, with an empty cushioned bench in the foreground.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the condition being spoken; the verse itself recounts what was said and does not describe the setting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler gestures as he speaks to an elderly man outside a dwelling, while other travelers listen nearby in a sunlit hill country landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the return and conversation described in the verse; the setting and appearances are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly father gestures toward a winding road as several men listen around a table with a nearly empty grain bowl and a small sack.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the father giving the instruction recalled in the verse; the setting and gestures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Brothers gather beside a stone dwelling with travel bundles; one gestures as another rests a hand on the younger brother’s shoulder, and a road winds down through the hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family discussion and landscape illustrate the brothers’ stated condition; the verse does not describe this particular setting or gesture.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man raises two fingers as he speaks to attentive men gathered in a warmly lit dwelling.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering illustrates the father’s recalled words; the verse does not describe the setting or gestures.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man sits at a tent entrance holding a torn garment and looking along an empty winding path at sunset.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the speaker’s grief and the absence he describes; the setting and garment are illustrative details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A gray-haired elder reaches toward a young traveler outside a stone dwelling while other travelers wait along the road.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the speaker's fear of separation and possible harm; the verse describes a feared outcome, not an event shown here.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An attendant places a silver cup into an open sack of grain beside silver pieces in a sunlit Egyptian storeroom.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the placement described in Genesis 44:2; the setting and appearance of the attendant are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An anxious traveler and his companions stand at a doorway before an elderly father, who holds a folded garment close to his chest. No boy is among the returning travelers.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined homecoming expresses the speaker's concern and the father's bond with the boy; the verse contemplates a return without the boy rather than stating that it has occurred.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A gray-haired older man sits anxiously at a doorway, looking toward a group of downcast men in a sunlit stone courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined encounter gives visual form to the sorrow feared in the verse; it does not depict an event the verse says has already happened.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A solemn man places a hand over his heart beside a young man as an elderly father listens at a stone doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined moment gives visual form to the promise recalled in the verse; its setting and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit hall, a kneeling man gestures to himself and appeals to a seated ruler while a boy and several men stand behind him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the plea for substitution and the boy’s return with his brothers; it does not depict the request as already granted.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A worried robed man makes an open-handed appeal beside a younger companion in a stone doorway, with a road winding toward distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the speaker’s concern and the journey he describes; the setting and figures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Men in ancient clothing lead laden donkeys along a road away from a walled settlement as the sun rises over distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the departure at dawn; the setting, clothing, and other visual details are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph gestures toward men walking away from an Egyptian city as his steward rises beside him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Joseph giving his instructions while the departing men are still nearby; the verse does not describe the setting or their appearance in this detail.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An official holds up an ornate cup and points toward it as worried travelers sit among their bundles on a sunlit road.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined encounter gives visual form to the verse’s question about the cup and its accusation; the setting and gestures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures as he speaks to travelers paused with laden donkeys on a sunlit country road.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative roadside encounter illustrates the overtaking and speaking described in the verse; the setting and appearance of the travelers are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A group of anxious travelers face a richly dressed man outdoors, while one speaks with open hands and pack animals stand behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the group's questioning and protest; the setting, clothing, and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Travelers with donkeys and grain sacks speak earnestly to an Egyptian official; a pouch of silver rests in an open sack.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene visualizes the speakers’ appeal and the returned silver; the verse itself gives their words rather than these visual details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler gestures earnestly toward an official while his worried companions stand beside their bundles on a sunlit road.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the solemn pledge; the verse does not describe the setting or portray the proposed consequences taking place.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elder and his family gather beside a welcoming figure among sheep, cattle, household goods, and dwellings in a sunlit pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the family, livestock, possessions, and nearness described in the verse; its specific setting and encounter are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man offers a sack of grain to an older man and his household beside a store of grain, with dry fields stretching into the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene illustrates the promise of provision during famine; the verse does not describe this particular encounter.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man in colorful robes speaks with open hands to a group of attentive men in a sunlit room; a younger listener looks up at him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the speaker addressing his listeners and Benjamin; their appearance and surroundings are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A richly dressed man gestures toward a distant road as traveling men listen in a sunlit Egyptian courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined palace conversation depicts the verse’s instruction; the setting and gestures are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two tearful men embrace closely in a warmly lit, richly decorated interior.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the brothers' mutual embrace and weeping; the setting and clothing are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A tearful man in an ornate headdress kisses and embraces a brother as other men gather close around them in a warmly lit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the verse's embrace and tears, with the gathered brothers suggesting the conversation that follows.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A messenger gestures toward travelers in a sunlit courtyard as Pharaoh and his servants smile in an Egyptian palace.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined palace scene illustrates the report and the pleased response; the setting and gestures are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit Egyptian courtyard, Pharaoh gestures toward Joseph while men secure bundles on pack animals near a road leading into the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene brings Pharaoh's instruction and the brothers' preparations together in one setting; the verse records the instruction rather than describing the preparations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man walks with his family and laden animals toward a fertile river valley with fields, palms, boats, and distant Egyptian buildings.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined journey and landscape express the invitation and promise; the verse itself does not describe the journey taking place.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man is helped into a wooden cart as a woman and children stand nearby; workers prepare carts and oxen against a sunlit Egyptian landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts preparations for the journey described in the command; its people, setting, and details are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A tearful Joseph reaches toward a group of startled men in a warmly lit Egyptian chamber.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Joseph making himself known to his brothers after the others have left; their expressions, clothing, and setting are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A family beside bundles and household vessels looks across golden fields toward a river and an abundant Egyptian landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the verse's reassurance through travelers and a fertile landscape; those visual details are not specified by the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph, dressed as an Egyptian official, hands a sack to a man as others load provisions onto wooden carts in a sunlit courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Joseph providing carts and journey provisions to the sons of Israel; the setting and individual gestures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man offers a pouch of silver to Benjamin, who holds five folded garments, while other men nearby hold garments of their own.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the giving of garments and Benjamin’s additional gifts; its setting and appearance are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A caravan of donkeys laden with grain, bread, baskets, and jars travels along a sunlit road past Egyptian buildings, guided by several people.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the provisions being sent from Egypt; the setting, people, and appearance of the caravan are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures from a doorway as a group of travelers with bundles turn to listen on a sunlit road through a hilly landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined departure gives visual form to the verse's parting instruction; the setting and appearances are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Travelers with laden donkeys approach an elderly man outside a stone dwelling in a sunlit hill country; a winding road stretches behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the travelers arriving at Jacob in Canaan; the setting and gestures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An astonished elderly man sits as several travel-worn men gather around him and speak earnestly in a sunlit household.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the moment the news is delivered; the setting, appearances, and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Jacob sits among his sons, who speak with him and gesture toward loaded wooden carts waiting outside a stone dwelling.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Jacob hearing Joseph’s words and seeing the carts; the setting and figures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man with a white beard stands with a walking staff at the entrance to a stone dwelling, looking hopefully toward a sunlit road; a travel bundle rests beside him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Israel preparing for the journey he resolves to make; the verse does not describe the setting or his appearance.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A weeping man covers his face in an Egyptian palace as attendants in a sunlit colonnade turn toward him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the weeping and those who hear it; the setting and figures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a warmly lit Egyptian hall, Joseph holds a hand to his chest and extends the other toward a group of startled brothers, who draw back and stare at him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Joseph revealing himself and his brothers reacting in fearful silence; the setting and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a golden Egyptian interior, Joseph extends a hand toward a close group of astonished men.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Joseph inviting his brothers near as he reveals his identity; the setting, clothing and expressions are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man in ancient Egyptian clothing gestures reassuringly to a group of attentive men beside sacks of grain, with sunlit columns and a river beyond.
