records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the reassurance and preservation of life expressed in the verse; its setting and details are an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A family looks across a dry, barren field toward a distant settlement; an idle wooden plow, empty baskets, and withered plants fill the foreground.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes the famine and the absence of plowing and harvest described in the verse; its people and landscape are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An Egyptian-clad man welcomes arriving men beside stores of grain, as families gather food near a river valley.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene represents the verse’s themes of being sent ahead, preservation, and deliverance; its setting and details are an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An Egyptian official gestures toward a group of travelers in a sunlit palace while a royal figure sits nearby; the Nile and cultivated fields stretch beyond the columns.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative palace scene evokes the speaker's words about God's providence and his authority in Egypt; the verse does not describe the setting or the people shown.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph, dressed as an Egyptian official, gestures toward a distant road while several men with packed donkeys listen in a sunlit palace courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Joseph giving the urgent message described in the verse; the setting, gestures, and travelers are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, an older man sits with six younger men gathered around him; a woman rests her hands on the shoulders of one of the younger men.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering illustrates the relationships listed in the verse; the setting, appearances, and moment are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man sits affectionately with three younger men beneath a tree near tents in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative family gathering illustrates the relationship named in the verse; the setting and appearances are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man sits beneath a tree with three adult men and two boys in a sunlit hill country; two stone mounds stand in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering and the stone mounds are an artistic interpretation of the genealogy and the deaths mentioned in the verse; the verse does not describe this scene.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man sits with four sons in a sunlit stone courtyard, with hills and trees beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering illustrates the relationship named in the verse; the setting, appearances, and gestures are artistic additions.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A father sits with three sons on a sunny hillside near a tent, with sheep and distant hills behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering illustrates the relationship named in the verse; the setting and activity are not specified in the text.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A large family gathers around a seated man and woman beneath a tree, near a pastoral tent and flock in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering illustrates the verse’s genealogical summary; it does not depict a documented event or represent the stated total as a visual count.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded father sits with seven sons gathered around him near tents and grazing sheep in a sunlit pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering illustrates the relationship named in the verse; the setting, appearances, and moment are artistic inventions.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A family gathers beneath a tree beside a tent in a sunlit pastoral landscape. An older man sits among four younger men and a woman, while one man holds two boys close.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering illustrates the relationships named in the verse; the setting, ages and poses are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older woman and a bearded man sit among a multigenerational family at a pastoral encampment, surrounded by tents, woven fabrics, pottery, and distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering evokes Zilpah's family with Jacob; the verse records their relationship and number, not this particular gathering.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman and a man sit beneath a tree with two boys between them, in a sunny pastoral landscape with sheep and a tent.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family scene illustrates the relationships named in the verse; the verse does not describe this moment.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Israel raises his hands beside a smoking stone altar while a traveling household, laden animals, and sheep wait behind him in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Israel's journey and sacrifices at Beersheba; the details of the people, altar, and landscape are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman and man sit affectionately with two boys in an Egyptian home overlooking a river and distant buildings.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family moment illustrates the relationships in the verse; the setting, ages, and moment are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man sits among a cheerful group of younger people outside a stone dwelling, beneath leafy branches.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering illustrates the list of Benjamin’s sons; the verse does not describe a gathering. The image includes an extra figure and does not identify the named sons individually.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Fourteen people of different ages gather together in a sunlit ancient courtyard, surrounded by stone walls and trees.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering evokes the verse’s count; the verse does not describe a gathering or identify the people shown.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A father and son sit together beneath a tree beside a tent, with sheep grazing in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined father-and-son moment illustrates the relationship named in the verse; the setting and action are not specified in the text.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A father sits with four sons outside a sunlit dwelling, surrounded by grapevines and a distant pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering illustrates the relationship named in the verse; the setting, ages, and activity are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman sits beside a tent watching a family gathering in a sunlit landscape; seven smooth stones rest together in the foreground.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The family gathering and seven stones are an imaginative way to recall Bilhah and the seven persons counted in the verse, not a depiction of a described event.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Jacob walks with a staff among a multigenerational family caravan, with animals and bundles, overlooking a river valley and Egyptian buildings.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes Jacob’s family journey to Egypt; the figures and setting are artistic details, not a literal count of the people in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph stands with two boys beside him as a large family gathers in a sunlit Egyptian riverside landscape, with travelers, animals, fields and distant buildings.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering suggests the household counted in the verse; the composition does not depict seventy individually countable people.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler gestures toward a welcoming man as a family caravan arrives beside green fields and palms.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Judah going ahead toward Joseph and the travelers arriving in Goshen; the setting and figures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A tearful Joseph embraces his elderly father Israel beside a horse-drawn chariot, with fertile fields and palms behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Joseph and Israel’s reunion in Goshen; the setting, clothing and surrounding details are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Jacob sits on bedding beside a lamp in a tented encampment at night, his hand on his chest as he looks toward light breaking through clouds in a starry sky.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jacob responding to God’s call in the visions of the night; the camp, lamp, and light in the sky are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man and a younger man gaze at each other and clasp hands in a sunlit setting with palms and distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined meeting depicts Israel looking at Joseph with relief; the setting, clothing and gesture are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph, dressed in Egyptian clothing, gestures as he speaks to his gathered family among travel bundles and donkeys, with an Egyptian city in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Joseph speaking to his family before the report he intends to make to Pharaoh; the setting and details are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Shepherds walk through a sunny landscape with sheep, goats, and cattle, while donkeys carry bundles and household goods.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the shepherds and the animals and possessions they brought; the landscape and journey details are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Pharaoh sits in a sunlit Egyptian hall and gestures toward a group of attentive visitors standing before him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative royal audience pictures the question anticipated in the verse; the setting and gestures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A shepherd gestures toward a flock of sheep and goats while an older man and a child with a lamb stand beside him. An Egyptian official faces them across a green pasture near a waterway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the family's pastoral livelihood and the prospect of dwelling in Goshen; the verse itself gives an instruction about what to say, rather than describing this encounter.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly traveler with a staff sits among family and laden animals, looking toward a sunlit river valley with fields and distant Egyptian buildings.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the journey to Egypt and God’s reassurance; the landscape, people and lighting are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly traveler with a staff rests on a sunlit rocky rise, watching a group of people and laden animals descend a winding road toward a green river valley and an ancient Egyptian city.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes the promised journey to Egypt and God's accompanying presence. The winding road suggests the promise of being brought up again; Joseph placing his hand on Jacob's eyes is not pictured.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Jacob rides in a wooden cart alongside his sons, while women and children follow in another cart through a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the family setting out from Beersheba; the landscape, people, and arrangement of the carts are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Jacob travels with a large family, sheep and goats, and a donkey carrying bundles toward green fields and buildings in Egypt.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the family arriving in Egypt with their livestock and possessions; the people, setting, and details are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man travels with a large family of adults and children along a sunlit road, with a donkey and a river valley and Egyptian buildings in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family journey illustrates the verse's account of bringing his descendants with him to Egypt; its appearance and setting are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Jacob walks beside Reuben at the front of a traveling family, with a fertile Egyptian landscape in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined journey illustrates the verse's introduction to Jacob and his sons going to Egypt; the setting and moment are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man sits beneath a tree surrounded by four smiling adult men in a sunlit pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering illustrates the relationship named in the verse; the setting, appearance, and ages are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Jacob raises a hand toward the seated Pharaoh as he turns toward a sunlit palace doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene brings the blessing and Jacob’s departure together in one moment; the verse does not describe the setting or gestures.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph, dressed in Egyptian attire, gestures toward a fertile river plain as his elderly father and brothers stand with their animals nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Joseph showing his family the land where he settled them; the verse does not describe the moment or landscape in these visual details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph offers a loaf from a basket to a man in a sunlit courtyard, surrounded by an elderly man, other adults, and young children holding bread.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Joseph providing bread to his family; the courtyard, clothing, and particular exchange are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A weary family sits beside an empty basket and a clay vessel in a dry field, with travelers, an Egyptian settlement, and distant hills beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family and landscape evoke the widespread hardship described in the verse; the verse does not identify these people or describe this particular scene.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph carries a large bag of silver toward a guarded Egyptian palace entrance, followed by attendants, while people exchange silver beside sacks of grain in the courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene brings the collection of money for grain and its delivery to Pharaoh’s house together in one moment; the people, setting, and details are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In an Egyptian granary courtyard, a woman holds an empty basket and a man displays an empty purse as families appeal to Joseph, who listens beside stores of grain.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the Egyptians asking Joseph for bread after their money has run out; the setting and individual figures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph, dressed as an Egyptian official, speaks with an open-handed gesture to a family beside a cow and sheep; one man holds an open pouch.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Joseph's offer through a conversation and livestock; the verse does not specify in this statement what he will give in exchange.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit Egyptian storehouse courtyard, Joseph directs an attendant offering bread to a family while people bring a horse, cattle, sheep, and a donkey.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined storehouse exchange brings together the animals and provision mentioned in the verse; the setting and individual figures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A group of worried people speaks to a seated Egyptian official; one holds an empty pouch and another gestures toward dry fields and an empty livestock enclosure.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined encounter uses the empty pouch and enclosure to evoke the people's account; the verse does not specify these visual details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A group of weary people plead with an Egyptian official beside sacks of grain; one gestures toward a barren field while a woman holds an empty bowl.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene portrays the people's plea and their hope for food and seed; the setting and figures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph gestures as he speaks to a seated Pharaoh in an Egyptian hall; beyond the columns, a family with sheep, cattle, and bundled belongings stands in green pasture.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene places the family and livestock in view beyond the palace as Joseph reports their arrival; the verse does not describe the appearance or setting of the audience.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An Egyptian official and a farmer hold a small clay object between them as other farmers stand beside dry fields, with an Egyptian building in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the sale of fields during the famine; the exchange and setting are artistic details rather than details specified by the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Families carrying bundles walk with a donkey toward the gates of a city, while a long procession winds through a sunlit river landscape toward distant settlements.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene pictures people moving toward a city and suggests the breadth of the movement described in the verse; the individual travelers and setting are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two Egyptian priests in white linen eat bread beside a basket of food, overlooking cultivated fields and a river; a man carrying a basket walks away.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene pictures the priests eating their allotted food near the land they retained; the people and setting are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An Egyptian official gestures toward a sack of seed while a man holds grains and other people listen beside furrowed fields. Workers sow and plow in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene depicts Joseph addressing the people and offering seed for sowing; the setting and individual figures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a golden Egyptian harvest field, a farmer hands a basket of grain to an elaborately dressed Egyptian recipient while four full baskets stand by his family and children.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined harvest scene portrays the division described in the verse; the people, setting, and exchange are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit Egyptian courtyard, a group of people gesture respectfully toward a richly dressed seated official, with sacks of grain in the foreground and guards behind him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined courtyard encounter interprets the speakers' gratitude and plea for favor; the verse does not specify the scene's appearance.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In an Egyptian harvest field, a farmer pours grain into one basket set apart from four others as two Egyptian figures look on. A distant estate stands beyond green fields and water.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative harvest scene suggests the fifth assigned to Pharaoh and the separate land of the priests; it does not depict a specific event described in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Families of several generations gather among homes, gardens and flocks in a sunlit fertile landscape, while others work in the fields.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests Israel's settled life and growth in Goshen; its people and details are not specified by the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Jacob sits with a staff outside a shaded dwelling, with a young person beside him and others tending produce and fields overlooking a river.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This scene imagines a peaceful moment during Jacob’s years in Egypt; the verse records the length of his time there and his life, not the depicted moment or setting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Israel reclines on a bed and speaks to Joseph, who kneels beside him in an Egyptian interior lit by evening sun.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Israel making his solemn request to Joseph; the setting and appearance of the figures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Five men stand together in an Egyptian audience hall as an official gestures toward them before the seated Pharaoh.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the presentation described in the verse; the setting, clothing, and gestures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man speaks from a bed while a younger man in Egyptian attire holds his hand and listens in a sunlit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative bedside scene suggests the request and the promise in the verse; the setting and gestures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man bows over the head of a bed while another man stands nearby with his hand over his heart, in a warmly lit room with woven textiles and pottery.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene depicts Israel bowing at the bed after the oath; the room, clothing and gestures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In an Egyptian court, Pharaoh gestures toward a group of shepherds as one answers with a staff in hand; sheep stand beyond the open court.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined royal audience illustrates the question and answer; the setting, gestures, and visible flock are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Shepherd visitors address a seated Pharaoh in an Egyptian hall, while a flock waits beyond the doorway in a dry landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined audience with Pharaoh depicts the request and the need described in the verse; the setting and visual details are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit Egyptian palace, Pharaoh gestures as he speaks to Joseph, who stands listening; a guard stands behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined palace conversation illustrates Pharaoh speaking to Joseph about the arrival of his father and brothers; the setting and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An Egyptian ruler gestures toward green pastures as an elderly man and his companions listen; shepherds tend cattle and sheep beyond them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene brings the offer of land and responsibility for livestock together in one view; its setting and figures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Jacob raises his hand toward a seated Pharaoh as Joseph stands beside him in a sunlit Egyptian palace.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Jacob's blessing after Joseph presents him to Pharaoh; the palace, clothing, and gesture are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated Pharaoh gestures toward an elderly, white-bearded Jacob in a sunlit Egyptian palace, with attendants and painted columns behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Pharaoh asking Jacob about his age; the palace setting, gestures, and appearance are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Jacob holds a walking staff and gestures toward Pharaoh, who listens from a throne in a sunlit Egyptian hall. A winding road is visible through the doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Jacob speaking to Pharaoh; the palace setting and distant road are artistic details that evoke his account of sojourning.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly, white-haired Israel embraces two young people and kisses one on the cheek while Joseph stands beside them in a warmly lit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the affectionate encounter described in the verse; the setting, clothing, and appearance of the figures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Israel touches Joseph’s face as Joseph leans close, while two young people look on in a sunlit room with richly patterned textiles.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family scene expresses Israel’s wonder at seeing Joseph and his offspring; the setting and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man bows with his face to a woven floor covering while an elderly seated man and two young figures watch nearby in a sunlit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Joseph bowing after bringing them away; the figures, setting, and details are an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit room, Joseph guides two boys toward an elderly, seated Israel, who rests his hands in his lap.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family scene illustrates Joseph bringing the two sons near Israel; the setting and appearance of the figures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man sits with his arms crossed and a hand resting on the head of each of two kneeling boys, the younger boy on the right of the image, in a warm, sunlit setting.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative watercolor depicts the crossed hands described in Genesis 48:14; the setting, clothing, and appearances are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man rests his hands on the head of a kneeling man in a warmly lit room; through the doorway, a shepherd walks with a flock along a sunlit path.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the blessing of Joseph; the distant shepherd and flock echo the verse’s description of God’s lifelong care.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man seated on a bed rests his hands on the heads of two boys. Through an open doorway, people walk among sunlit fields and trees beneath distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the blessing and suggests future generations through the people and fertile landscape outside; it does not picture the Angel.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a warmly lit room, a concerned man holds an elderly seated man’s hand above the head of one of two young men; the elder’s other hand rests on the second young man’s head.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene depicts Joseph taking hold of his father’s hand in response to its placement on Ephraim, as described in Genesis 48:17. The setting and appearances are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit room, Joseph gestures toward a boy as his elderly father rests a hand on the boy’s head; another boy sits beside the father.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative family scene illustrates Joseph’s request; the setting, appearances, and depicted gesture are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man speaks with two younger figures inside a warmly lit tent, gesturing toward a fruitful tree and distant settlements beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family scene and fruitful landscape evoke the father’s assurance and the promised growth of the younger brother’s descendants; the setting and visual details are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph walks with his arms around his two sons on a sunlit path, with laden donkeys behind them and a distant settlement among hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Joseph setting out with his sons after hearing of his father’s illness; the landscape and details of their journey are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit dwelling, a seated elderly man speaks with open hands to two attentive young men, one standing slightly ahead of the other.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the spoken blessing and suggests Ephraim's precedence through the figures' placement; the setting and appearance are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Israel reclines on a bed and speaks to Joseph, who sits beside him holding his hand. A sunlit landscape is visible through an open doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined bedside conversation and the landscape accompany Israel’s words; the view suggests the promised return rather than depicting a journey described in this verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man gestures across sunlit terraced fields as a younger man listens beside him; a sheathed sword and bow rest among the rocks.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene evokes the gift of a portion and the speaker's mention of his sword and bow; the verse does not describe this setting or conversation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly white-bearded man sits up in bed as a messenger gestures toward a richly dressed man approaching through a sunlit doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene portrays Jacob sitting up after hearing that Joseph is coming; the room, clothing, and appearance of the messenger are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Jacob gestures as he speaks to Joseph, who listens beside him in a sunlit interior overlooking hills and a distant settlement.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jacob sharing his recollection with Joseph; the setting and appearance of the people are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly robed man and a family look over a sunlit valley of fields and villages, while families and flocks travel along a winding path.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes the promise of numerous descendants and a lasting inheritance in the land; it does not depict a specific moment described in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man seated in a sunlit Egyptian setting gestures toward two young men standing together as another man listens nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering expresses the speaker's acceptance of the two sons; the setting, appearance, and gestures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man gestures toward a sunlit valley of fields while two adult men and two children stand together beside him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family scene suggests the verse’s relationship between later offspring, their brothers, and inheritance; the verse does not describe this particular gathering.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A grieving traveler kneels beside a mound of stones near a winding road, with a small settlement in the distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the remembered roadside burial; the landscape, grave and moment of mourning are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man seated in a sunlit room extends an open hand toward two young figures standing beside a man, who rests his hands on their shoulders.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Israel’s question about Joseph’s sons; the setting, clothing, ages, and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a warmly lit room, Joseph stands beside two sons and gestures toward his elderly seated father, who reaches out to welcome them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Joseph presenting his sons and his father inviting them closer before blessing them; the setting and gestures are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated man holds an upright scepter and a staff between his feet in a sunlit stone court, as a diverse group approaches and several people kneel with gifts.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses a seated figure and approaching peoples to evoke the verse’s language of Judah’s scepter, the staff, and the obedience of the peoples; it does not identify the figure as Shiloh.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit vineyard heavy with purple grapes, a donkey and colt stand beside a vine while a man washes a garment in a stone basin of red wine.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative vineyard scene brings together the verse’s images of the donkey, vine, garment, and wine; its setting and figures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A dark-eyed man smiles in a sunlit vineyard courtyard beside a cup of red wine and a bowl of milk.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined courtyard scene gives visual form to the verse's comparisons; the setting and the man's appearance are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two people overlook a sunlit coastal settlement and a sheltered harbor filled with wooden sailing ships; a distant town lies along the coast.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative harbor scene evokes Zebulun dwelling by the sea and the haven for ships, with a distant coastal town suggesting Sidon; it is not a map of the border.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A sturdy brown donkey rests between two bundles of goods in a sunlit rural landscape, with fields, trees, distant hills and a village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene depicts the verse’s comparison of Issachar to a strong donkey lying between two burdens; the landscape and contents of the bundles are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man bends beneath a wooden carrying pole laden with baskets and grain, looking toward a shaded stone resting place above a fertile valley.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene evokes the pleasant land, desired rest, and burden of labor in the verse; its setting and figure are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated elder listens to two men speaking as families gather beneath a tree near a sunlit village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined community hearing illustrates the verse's statement about Dan judging his people; the particular gathering is not described in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A viper bites the heel of a startled brown horse on a rocky path as its rider falls backward, with golden hills and a distant village beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene visualizes the verse’s comparison of Dan to a viper by the path; it is not a portrait of Dan.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man sits with open hands on a rocky hillside, looking toward sunrise over a distant valley.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene uses a quiet vigil at dawn to evoke the verse's waiting for Yahweh's salvation; the verse does not describe this setting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A spear-bearing defender stands on a rocky hillside as an armed troop runs away down a dusty path; discarded shields and equipment lie among the rocks.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene portrays the verse's movement from attack to eventual triumph; its figures and setting are illustrative.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Jacob gestures as a group of men gather around him and listen in a warmly lit room with woven cushions and rugs.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering portrays Jacob calling his sons to hear what he will tell them; the setting and appearances are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Loaves of bread and a platter of fruit, cheese, olives and other foods fill a table beside an empty ornate chair, with golden fields and olive trees beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined harvest and royal table give visual form to the verse's abundance; they do not depict a specific event described in the text.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A doe and two spotted fawns move through a sunlit meadow of wildflowers, with hills and a distant village beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the deer and fawns in the supplied glosses; the landscape and moment are artistic additions.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A grapevine laden with purple grapes grows beside a stone well, its leafy branches spilling over a sunlit stone wall.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative garden scene gives visual form to the verse's comparison of Joseph to a fruitful vine; it is not a depiction of a recorded location.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A distressed man shelters behind rocks as archers shoot toward him across a sunlit, rocky landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the verse’s hostile archers and the distress of the one they attack; the setting and figures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An archer holds a bow on a rocky hillside while sheep rest beside a large stone; sunlight streams through clouds over a distant valley.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene brings the strong bow together with the verse’s shepherd and stone imagery, with sunlight suggesting divine help.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit pastoral valley, a mother nurses her infant beside her family and flocks, while rain falls in the distance and water flows among foreground rocks.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined pastoral scene brings together rain, flowing water, and a nursing mother to suggest the blessings named in the verse; it is not a depiction of a specific event described there.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly father rests his hand on the bowed head of Joseph, who wears blue and gold robes, while sunlit hills stretch into the distance behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the blessing resting on Joseph alongside the verse’s image of the enduring hills; it does not depict a documented setting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A wolf bends over a captured horned animal in a golden rocky landscape, while figures divide goods beside a campfire under a darkening sky.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene brings the verse's wolf, morning prey, and nighttime division of spoil together in one landscape.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly father gestures toward a seated son as other men gather attentively around them in a warmly lit dwelling.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering conveys the father speaking and blessing his sons; the setting and moment are an artistic interpretation of the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man rests on a bed and gestures toward a field and rocky cave visible through an open doorway, while family members gather around him and listen.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene depicts the instruction and suggests the cave he names; the verse does not describe the room or show the cave from it.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man gestures as a group of adult men gather closely and listen in a warm, textile-filled dwelling.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the gathering and listening described in Genesis 49:2; the setting and appearances are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A rocky cave entrance beneath trees opens onto a sunlit field, with a distant settlement and hills beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined landscape evokes the cave and field named in the verse; it is not a reconstruction of their historical appearance.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Five unmarked stones stand among wildflowers beside a shadowed rocky cave, with an olive tree and a golden sunset over the hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined burial place evokes the shared resting place recalled in the verse; its stones and landscape are an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A sunlit field with olive trees and a cave in a rocky rise; several robed men stand together in the distance, two clasping hands.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene brings the field and cave together and suggests the purchase through figures whose identities and gestures are not specified in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Jacob rests with closed eyes on a bed while his sons gather around him in grief in a warmly lit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Jacob at rest and his sons gathered nearby; the details of the room and their expressions are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man seated inside a woven tent extends his hand toward a standing younger man, who listens with his hands clasped. Sheep and a sunlit landscape appear beyond the tent.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative family scene pictures the personal address to Reuben; the setting and gestures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A rumpled, empty couch inside a warmly colored tent; outside, a clothed man stands with bowed head beside turbulent water under dark clouds.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene connects the verse’s comparison to uncontrolled waters with its reference to a defiled bed; it is not a depiction of a specified setting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two solemn men stand together beneath a tree overlooking a sunlit valley; one holds a lowered sword and the other wears a sheathed sword.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene represents the brothers and the swords associated with violence in the verse; their appearance and setting are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man turns away from a gathering of men in a sunlit, rocky landscape. A covered human form and a resting ox lie beyond them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the speaker's separation from the assembly and suggests the violence described in the verse; its setting and figures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two solemn men carrying bundles walk in opposite directions along paths through golden fields, with distant settlements and a rain cloud over one side of the landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The diverging travelers and paths imaginatively suggest the division and scattering described in the verse; the scene does not depict a specific event described in it.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit, rocky landscape, a standing man holds a kneeling armed man by the hair at the back of his head while other men bow or gesture toward the standing figure.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene gives visible form to the verse’s images of praise, victory over enemies, and brothers bowing before Judah.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A lion and cub lie watchfully on a sunlit rocky rise above a valley, with a winding hillside path behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene gives visual form to the verse’s lion imagery and its question about rousing the resting lion; the landscape and cub beside the adult are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man sits beneath a large tree with children and a grown man gathered warmly around him, beside a dwelling and sunlit fields.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering suggests the sons and daughters born during Enosh’s long life after he fathered Cainan; the verse does not describe the setting or their appearance.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An unmarked earthen mound rests beneath a great old tree, overlooking a sunlit valley at sunset.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A father cradles a swaddled infant as a woman sits beside them in a sunlit pastoral home.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man lies still beneath a woven blanket as three mourners gather beside him; evening light falls on a large tree outside the doorway.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A father smiles at an infant held in his arms inside a sunlit dwelling, with woven fabrics and a fertile landscape beyond.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A father sits beneath a broad tree with family members of different ages gathered around him, overlooking a sunlit pastoral landscape.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man lies with closed eyes on a woven bed as three people grieve beside him; warm light enters through a doorway overlooking a tree and distant hills.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A gray-haired father sits beneath a broad tree, surrounded by smiling sons and daughters, with fields, sheep, and a modest dwelling behind them.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man lies peacefully beneath a woven covering as three mourners gather beside him. Through the doorway, an old tree stands in the evening light.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man holds a swaddled newborn while a woman rests nearby in a sunlit dwelling overlooking fields and hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family moment illustrates Enoch becoming the father of Methuselah; the verse does not describe the setting or the people’s appearance.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man walks with his family along a flower-lined path through a sunlit landscape of trees, hills and a stream.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative family walk suggests Enoch's walk with God and his family life; the setting and figures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man with a staff stands beneath a large olive tree, looking across a sunlit valley and winding path.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the span of Enoch’s life; the verse itself gives its length and does not describe this setting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed man walks along a sunlit path through an ancient landscape of olive trees, flowers, hills, and a distant valley.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined journey uses the landscape and light to suggest Enoch walking with God and his departure; the verse does not describe the setting or how God took him.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A father holds a swaddled baby beside a woman near a shelter, with sheep and a sunlit landscape beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family scene depicts Methuselah with the infant Lamech; the setting and appearances are artistic choices, not details supplied by the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man sits beneath a spreading tree beside a simple dwelling, speaking with a family of sons and daughters of varied ages in a sunlit landscape.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man rests beneath a spreading tree as three grieving people gather around him; a winding path crosses golden fields toward hills at sunset.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects the end of Methuselah's long life; the verse does not describe the setting or those present.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man sits beside a woman holding a swaddled newborn in a warm, sunlit dwelling, with fields and distant hills visible through the doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative family scene depicts Lamech and his son; the setting and family moment are not specified in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man holds an infant with tenderness beside a rocky, thorny field, with a hand tool resting nearby in warm evening light.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man and woman stand together among flowers and trees, looking toward morning light over mountains, a river, and waterfalls.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man sits beneath a large tree with a younger man and other family members gathered around him in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering evokes Lamech’s life and children; the verse does not describe this particular moment or their appearances.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man lies peacefully on a woven bed while three people mourn beside him in a warmly lit dwelling at sunset.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene depicts Lamech’s death; the setting and mourners are artistic details not specified in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older bearded man sits outdoors with three younger men gathered around him beneath a tree, with a dwelling and sunlit hills beyond.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man cradles a smiling infant beneath a tree, with golden fields and distant hills in the sunlight.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man sits with children beneath a broad tree, while others tend a garden in a sunlit valley.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family scene reflects the verse’s account of Adam’s sons and daughters; the setting and individual details are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Adam lies peacefully beneath a broad tree while four grieving people gather around him; golden evening light falls over a valley and distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering and landscape express the close of Adam’s life; the verse does not describe the setting or those present.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man holds a smiling infant beside a woman outside a sunlit dwelling, with fields and hills beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family scene portrays Seth with the infant Enosh; the verse does not describe their appearance or surroundings.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man sits beneath a broad tree, speaking with a smiling family of adults and children beside a dwelling in a sunlit landscape.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man rests beneath a linen covering on a woven mat in an ancient dwelling, with a tree and sunset visible through the doorway.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man holds a swaddled newborn as a woman sits beside him, with sunlit fields and hills beyond their home.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family scene illustrates Enosh becoming Cainan's father; the verse does not describe the setting or the family's appearance.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A gathering of mourners bows and covers their faces on a straw-strewn threshing floor; a river, hills and sheaves of grain lie behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts a moment of the solemn mourning described in the verse; the people and landscape are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Solemn onlookers watch a large gathering of Egyptian mourners around a covered bier on a threshing floor, with a river and mountains beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the Canaanites observing Egypt's deep mourning; the appearance of the people and landscape is an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Solemn men in robes carry a cloth-covered form on a bier through a sunlit stone courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The scene imaginatively depicts the sons acting together in obedience; the verse itself does not describe the setting or the action shown.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Men carry a linen-covered body on a bier toward a cave in a rocky hillside, with fields and distant hills in the warm evening light.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the sons bringing the deceased to the burial cave; the people, landscape, and details are an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A solemn group of travelers, led by a man in Egyptian dress, walks along a rocky road with pack animals; a river, palms and Egyptian buildings lie in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined return journey illustrates Joseph and his companions traveling back to Egypt after his father's burial; the landscape, clothing and individual appearances are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Worried men gather in conversation in a sunlit courtyard; a walking staff and a folded mantle rest beside them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering and the belongings suggest the brothers' anxiety and their father's absence; the verse does not describe the setting or those objects.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A messenger gestures earnestly toward a seated Joseph in an Egyptian setting, while three concerned men stand behind the messenger.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the message being conveyed to Joseph; the setting and the people’s appearance and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph sits weeping into a cloth in a sunlit Egyptian interior while several men gather around him, some gesturing in appeal.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Joseph weeping as the plea for forgiveness is spoken; the setting, clothing, and gestures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a warm stone interior, a group of men bow low before a standing man in white and blue; one kneeling man looks up and gestures as if speaking.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the brothers falling before him and offering themselves as servants; the setting and appearance are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit Egyptian courtyard, Joseph in blue and gold extends an open hand toward a group of apprehensive men in simple robes.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses gesture and setting to picture Joseph reassuring those he addresses; the verse itself does not specify these visual details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A tearful Joseph embraces his elderly father on a bed and kisses his forehead in a warmly lit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Joseph weeping over and kissing his father; the setting and appearance are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man speaks with a group of attentive men beside a shaded stone passage, while families receive grain in a sunlit courtyard beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene uses a conversation and the sharing of grain to suggest the verse's contrast between intended harm and the preservation of many lives; it does not establish the event's exact setting or appearance.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit courtyard, a man gestures reassuringly to a group of adults and children gathered near baskets of grain and bread.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined courtyard gathering pictures the verse's reassurance and promise of provision; the setting and visible details are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Joseph sits with family members in a sunlit Egyptian courtyard, overlooking palms, the river, sailing boats, and distant buildings.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering evokes Joseph's life in Egypt with his father's household; the verse does not describe this particular moment.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Joseph holds a young child on his knees as adults and children gather around him in a sunlit Egyptian courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family gathering portrays Joseph with a child on his knees and evokes the generations mentioned in the verse; the setting and individual figures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Joseph reclines on a bed and speaks to attentive men gathered around him in a richly decorated Egyptian room. A sunlit path and hills are visible through an open doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Joseph speaking to his brothers; the distant path suggests the future journey he describes, which the verse does not depict as already completed.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Joseph gestures as he speaks to a gathering of attentive men in a sunlit room overlooking a distant landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Joseph speaking and the listeners' promise; the verse does not describe the setting or their gestures.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Mourners gather around a closed stone coffin in a sunlit chamber, with the Nile and an Egyptian landscape visible beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering and setting picture Joseph's placement in a coffin in Egypt; the verse does not describe the mourners or the chamber.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A grieving Joseph gestures toward a linen-covered figure as three attendants prepare the body in a richly decorated Egyptian interior.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the physicians carrying out Joseph’s command; the setting, clothing, and arrangement are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Mourners in an Egyptian chamber grieve beside a linen-covered body on a bier; folded linen and vessels sit nearby, and a gathering is visible beside the river beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene evokes the embalming and mourning described in the verse; the setting and individual mourners are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A solemn man gestures toward seated officials in a richly painted hall; a folded cloth lies nearby, and a winding road appears through the open doorway.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In an imagined Egyptian court, Pharaoh gestures toward a solemn man standing before him; a sunlit road is visible through the palace doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Pharaoh giving the instruction and suggests the journey ahead; the setting and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the journey described in the verse; the appearance of the procession and landscape is an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man sits beneath a tree with three younger men gathered closely around him in a sunlit landscape.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Noah stands on a rocky hillside looking toward light through dark clouds, while people struggle in a settlement across the valley.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests Noah receiving God’s warning and the violence described in the verse; its setting and visual details are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man carries a basket of grain and fruit toward stores of food beside a large wooden vessel under construction, with animals nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the gathering of provisions described in the verse; its setting and details are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Noah works a wooden joint with a mallet beside a large wooden vessel under construction in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The construction scene imaginatively expresses Noah’s obedience; its visual details are not specified in this verse.

records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined village scene suggests the seeing and taking of wives described in the verse; its setting and the people's appearances are artistic choices.

records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family and landscape evoke human life and its finite span; the verse does not describe these particular people or this setting.

records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes the families and mighty men mentioned in the verse; the figures and setting are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man with a walking staff travels along a flower-lined path beside a stream, with a settlement and mountains in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined walk evokes the verse's description of Noah walking with God; the setting and moment are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Floodwaters surge across a landscape beneath dark rain clouds, with a large wooden ark in the middle distance.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A gathering of people among wild animals and livestock in a sunlit landscape, with creeping creatures in the foreground and many birds overhead.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Pairs of animals approach and climb a wooden ramp into the ark, where Noah waits at the entrance, in a warm watercolor landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the creatures coming to Noah and entering the ark in pairs; their appearance and surroundings are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the waters lifting the ark above the earth; the landscape and weather are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A large wooden ark floats on rolling floodwaters beneath sunlit and dark clouds in a watercolor illustration.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Powerful blue floodwaters roll above the visible contours of submerged mountains, beneath dark clouds and warm rays of light.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative watercolor scene portrays the verse’s description of waters covering the high hills; its view beneath the waves is an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Noah leads his household along a wooden ramp toward the open doorway of a large timber ark, carrying baskets and belongings in a sunlit landscape.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Floodwaters stretch beneath a cloudy, golden sky, with mountain peaks visible beneath the translucent waves.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A flooded landscape beneath a cloudy golden sky, with lifeless birds among branches, animals in the water, and a distant flooded settlement.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the loss described in the verse; its particular landscape and details are an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A lifeless deer lies at the edge of floodwaters beneath a rain-darkened sky, overlooking a submerged valley.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined flood landscape uses one animal to evoke the loss described in the verse; the details of the scene are illustrative.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A large wooden ark rides churning floodwaters beneath dark rain clouds, with warm light falling across its roof and waves.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the ark as a refuge amid the flood; its lighting and appearance are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A distant wooden ark rides an expansive sea of rolling waves beneath warmly lit clouds.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes the waters prevailing over the earth; the verse states their duration rather than describing this particular view.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures toward a wooden ark as a flock of sheep climbs its ramp and two donkeys wait nearby in a sunlit landscape.

records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures birds gathering for preservation; the verse describes their number and purpose without specifying this arrangement.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Animals approach a large wooden ark across dry ground as dark clouds and distant rain gather over the landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene conveys the warning of approaching rain; the verse states the timing and coming destruction, which the illustration cannot show as a duration.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Noah carries a basket of supplies up a wooden ramp toward the open ark, with animals gathered behind him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Noah acting obediently; the verse itself does not specify the pictured action or setting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Noah looks from a wooden ark over rain and floodwaters spreading across a landscape, with light breaking through the clouds.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined view of Noah and the flood illustrates the verse; the ark opening, landscape, and his appearance are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A family walks up a wooden ramp into a large ark while rain falls and water rises around them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative view of Noah and his family entering the ark because of the floodwaters. The vessel, clothing and composition are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A variety of animals gather around a stream beneath trees, with birds overhead and a lizard, beetle, and tortoise in the foreground.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts examples of the kinds of creatures named in the verse; the verse does not specify the species shown.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Pairs of animals walk up a wooden ramp toward Noah at the open entrance of the ark.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the animals coming in pairs to Noah and the ark; the particular animals and setting are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man extends his hands from a wooden ark window as a white dove flies over water toward a sunlit horizon.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the dove's renewed departure; the appearance of the ark and landscape is an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Noah reaches toward a returning white dove carrying a leafy olive sprig at an ark opening, with water and emerging land beneath an evening sky.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene portrays the dove returning to Noah at evening; the setting and appearance are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man watches a dove fly away from an opening in a wooden ark over sunlit water toward distant land.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene depicts the sending of the dove; the setting and appearance are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Noah lifts a wooden covering and looks out from the ark over exposed earth, scattered pools, and distant mountains under a clearing sky.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative watercolor depicts Noah looking from the ark toward the exposed ground; the landscape and appearance of the ark are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A wooden ark rests on a rocky hillside above a broad expanse of dry, cracked earth, with distant mountains beneath a sunlit sky.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the dry earth described in the verse; the landscape and ark are artistic details rather than details specified by this verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older Noah sits inside a wooden ark, looking attentively toward warm light entering through an opening above.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Noah listening as God speaks; the setting and light are artistic choices, not details stated in this verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man and woman lead family members out of a wooden ark toward a sunlit landscape beneath a rainbow.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the family coming out together in response to the verse’s command; its setting and appearance are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man guides animals down a ramp from a large wooden ark into a sunlit landscape, while birds fly overhead and a snake, lizard and tortoise cross the foreground.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the creatures coming out and suggests their spreading across the earth; its details are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Noah and his wife walk onto damp ground as their sons and their sons' wives follow them out of a wooden ark, beneath a bright sky.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the family going out together; the setting, appearance, and gestures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Animals emerge in family groups from a large wooden ark onto a sunlit landscape, while birds fly overhead and small reptiles move among foreground rocks.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the creatures leaving the ark in family groups; the particular animals, landscape and appearance of the ark are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Noah and several animals look out from a large wooden ark as wind sweeps across floodwaters beneath a break in the clouds.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the ark and wind described in the verse; its appearance and the view of Noah and the animals are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Noah stands with hands raised beside a smoking stone altar, with animals and birds nearby and an ark in the distant landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Noah at the altar; the landscape and visual details are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Smoke rises from a stone altar above green, damp ground, while sheep and cattle graze in a sunlit valley.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined landscape uses an altar, rising smoke, and living creatures to evoke the verse's aroma and God's words about the ground and living things; it does not portray His inward speech literally.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A farmer scatters seed across dark soil beside green shoots and a golden harvest, beneath a sky that shifts from sunlight to stars over distant snowy mountains.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative landscape brings the verse’s recurring seasons, work, and times of day together in one view.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A distant wooden ark floats on floodwaters beneath a sky clearing from dark rain clouds to golden light, while waves and swirling water fill the foreground.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the stopping of the deep and the restraint of the rain through a storm giving way over the floodwaters.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Water runs over a rocky, muddy slope toward a broad expanse of water, with distant ridges beneath clouds and warm sunlight.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined landscape suggests the gradual retreat of the waters; its terrain and light are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A large wooden ark rests on a rocky mountain ridge above surrounding water, with misty peaks and warm sunlight in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the ark resting on the mountains of Ararat; the landscape and appearance of the ark are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Rocky mountain peaks rise above a broad expanse of water beneath a warm, cloud-filled sky.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the mountain tops appearing as the waters recede; the particular landscape and light are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Inside a timber ark, Noah opens a wooden window shutter and looks out over sunlit water.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Noah opening the ark’s window; the appearance of the ark and the view outside are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A black raven flies over floodwaters beside a wooden ark, with rocky heights emerging beneath a golden sky.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the raven's flight while the waters recede; the landscape and ark's appearance are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man reaches out from a wooden ark as a white dove flies over floodwaters beneath a golden sky.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the dove being sent out to see whether the waters had receded; the verse does not describe the visual details shown.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man reaches from the wooden ark to receive a white dove on his hand above floodwaters, beneath a golden, cloudy sky.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative illustration depicts the dove returning to the ark and the man reaching out to receive her; the visual details are an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Birds, livestock, and wild animals gather on a sunlit landscape near a wooden ark as a family watches beneath a rainbow.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures creatures coming out of the ark; its landscape, animals, and family are artistic choices rather than details specified by this verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A family and a dog look over a green valley with a winding river and grazing animals. An ark rests on a distant hill beneath a rainbow and sunlit clouds.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined landscape evokes the covenant's promise through a peaceful world after the flood; the particular family, animals, and setting are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A family and several animals gather in a flowered valley, looking toward sunlight breaking through clouds; a white bird flies near a tree.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes the people and living creatures included in the covenant; the landscape, gathering, and light are artistic details. The verse itself does not identify the sign.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A rainbow arcs through rain clouds above a sunlit valley, with streams, rocky cascades, trees, and flowers.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined landscape depicts the rainbow in the cloud described as the sign of the covenant; the landscape details are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A bright rainbow arcs through rain clouds above a sunlit, rain-washed landscape of hills, trees and a distant settlement.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative landscape pictures the rainbow appearing in the cloud over the earth; its setting is an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A family and several animals stand on a green hillside overlooking a calm river and valley under a rainbow and clearing clouds.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined landscape portrays people and animals living safely together as a reflection on God's covenant; it is not a literal depiction of God remembering.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A rainbow arcs through rain clouds over a sunlit valley with a river, trees, deer, elephants, grazing animals and birds.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative landscape uses the rainbow and living creatures to evoke the verse; it does not portray God looking on the rainbow.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Noah stands among animals on a hillside beneath a rainbow, overlooking a sunlit river valley.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene presents Noah and living creatures under a rainbow; the landscape and gathering are artistic details beyond the words of this verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Three men in long robes walk down a wooden ramp from an ark toward a sunlit, mountainous landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the three brothers leaving the ark; their appearances and surroundings are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Three men stand together on a flowered hillside overlooking a broad river valley, while groups of families travel along paths through the landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene places the three sons and later generations together to evoke the populating of the earth; the verse does not describe this particular moment or landscape.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Noah and three adult sons gather on a sunny hillside overlooking a broad green valley, river, and distant mountains.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene shows Noah and his sons in a landscape suggesting the earth they are told to fill; the verse does not describe their setting or gestures.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man kneels in freshly worked soil, planting a young grapevine beside rows of vines in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Noah planting a vineyard; the landscape, clothing, and details are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man sleeps with his bare back and shoulder exposed inside a sunlit tent, beside a clay wine vessel and an overturned cup.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined tent interior depicts the drinking and uncovered state described in the verse; its furnishings and visual details are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men carry a broad woven garment across their shoulders beside a covered bed in a warmly lit tent.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the brothers covering their father; the tent and its furnishings are artistic details. The figures’ faces do not clearly show the verse’s backward orientation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Noah sits clothed on bedding inside a tent, his hand against his forehead and a clay vessel nearby as sunlight enters.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Noah reflecting after he awakes; the setting and his expression are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit courtyard, an older man gestures solemnly toward a young man standing beside a clay jar as two other men listen.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined courtyard and its figures suggest the gravity of the declaration; the verse itself does not describe the setting or identify the speaker.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit pastoral camp, an elderly man raises his hand as he speaks, while a seated man listens and another carries a clay water vessel.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the spoken blessing and the verse’s mention of service; the setting and figures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man welcomes a traveler at a woven tent while a young person carries a water jar nearby; many tents fill a sunlit valley beyond them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined tent camp and welcome evoke the verse’s words about enlargement, dwelling in Shem’s tents, and service; the particular people and setting are artistic inventions.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Noah sits beneath a broad tree overlooking a fertile valley, fields, a river, and distant mountains in golden evening light.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined peaceful moment suggests Noah's life after the flood; the verse records the length of that life, not this particular scene.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An empty woven sleeping mat and folded earth-toned cloth lie in a sunlit ancient dwelling, with a peaceful landscape beyond the open doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The empty resting place imaginatively reflects the end of Noah’s life; the verse does not describe the setting or circumstances of his death.
