records_chirho.alt_chirho: A family stands on a rocky shore as a deer and a wild canine turn away, birds fly overhead, a lizard retreats among stones, and fish swim in the shallows.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined shoreline scene brings the creatures named in the verse together and suggests their wariness of people; it is not a depiction of a specific event described in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A family shares cooked fish and fresh green plants outdoors beneath a tree, with grazing animals in the distant landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family meal illustrates the verse’s comparison of living creatures given for food with the green plants; it does not depict a specified event in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At an outdoor table, a man raises his palm toward a dish of raw meat while a woman and child listen. Bread, vegetables, and a covered clay vessel sit nearby in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative family meal uses a gesture of restraint to evoke the verse’s prohibition; the people, setting, and meal are not described in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit rocky landscape, a grieving family gathers around a motionless man while another man stands with open hands and a lion watches nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene reflects the verse's solemn concern for human life and accountability; it does not depict an event narrated in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient village, grieving relatives gather beside a covered body while a man with bowed head stands before solemn elders.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene suggests mourning and human accountability; the verse does not describe these particular people or events.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A family with four children walks and plays on a flowered hillside above a wide valley of fields, a river, and distant mountains.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative family scene suggests fruitfulness and multiplying across the earth; it is not a literal depiction of a specific moment described in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older Noah and three adult sons sit together on a rocky hillside, looking attentively toward sunlight breaking through clouds over a distant valley.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined moment of listening illustrates God addressing Noah and his sons; the verse does not describe the setting or their appearance.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elder, younger adults, and children look toward a rainbow above a sunlit green valley.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative family scene suggests the covenant extending to descendants; it does not depict the verse as a historical photograph.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus walks through a sunlit village market as people tend their work and pass by, with animals, trees and distant hills around them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes John 1:10: the Berean Interlinear token glosses describe Him as being in the world, the world as coming into being through Him, and the world as not knowing Him. The village, people, activities and shared light are artistic choices rather than details supplied by the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands with one hand extended outside a stone village home as three people at the doorway turn or withdraw inside.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes John 1:11, in which the Word comes to His own and His own do not receive Him. The doorway, people, and moment are artistic choices, not details supplied by the verse. The English token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible, not GBT-approved glosses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands with open arms beside a sunlit stone doorway as a group of women, men, and a child reach toward Him in a watercolor village landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests Jesus welcoming those who receive Him and believe in His name, whom He gives authority to become children of God. The encounter and doorway are visual metaphors, not events stated in the verse. The source's English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible, not GBT-approved glosses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Five people, including two children and an elderly man, sit together in a sunlit garden and look upward as green shoots rise among stones in the foreground.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined garden scene uses the light and fresh shoots as symbols of life from God, evoking John 1:13's contrast between being born of God and birth from blood or human will. The people and garden are artistic choices, not events described in the verse. The English token glosses in the source are from the Berean Interlinear, not GBT-approved glosses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village, Jesus sits beneath a woven shelter, welcoming a group of men, women, and a child who look toward him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering evokes John 1:14's Word made flesh dwelling among people and the glory of the only begotten from the Father, full of grace and truth. The verse does not describe this particular gathering.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: John, wearing a rough brown garment, stretches out his arm toward Jesus approaching along a riverside path while listeners watch in warm dawn light.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative riverside scene pictures John bearing witness to Jesus, who comes after him yet has precedence because he was before John. The setting, listeners, and depicted moment are artistic details. The English token glosses come from the Berean Interlinear, not an approved Global Bible Tools translation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A warm watercolor scene shows Jesus beside a flowing spring, with men, women, and children gathering water in cups and cupped hands. Golden fields, a village, and hills lie beyond them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses the flowing spring and the people receiving its water to picture John 1:16's fullness and grace for grace, following the verse's Berean Interlinear token glosses. The verse does not describe a literal spring or this event.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath a tree with open hands, teaching a group in a sunlit countryside while Moses stands beside him holding two blank stone tablets.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene places Moses and Jesus together to reflect John 1:17: the law was given through Moses, and grace and truth came through Jesus Christ. Their meeting here is symbolic. The English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible, as identified in the chapter data.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath a tree near a sunlit lake, one hand on his chest and the other open toward a small group of attentive listeners.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering evokes John 1:18: no one has seen God, and the only begotten God, close to the Father, has made Him known. The verse does not describe this gathering, landscape, or gesture. The English token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear, not GBT-approved glosses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Three robed visitors face John on a stony riverbank. One visitor gestures with an open hand while John, dressed in rough clothing and holding a staff, listens. Reeds, water, distant hills, and hillside buildings surround them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the priests and Levites sent from Jerusalem to ask John who he is in John 1:19. The setting, appearances, and gestures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A flowing ribbon of golden light curves through a brilliant center, surrounded by layered blue and ochre watercolor clouds.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative watercolor uses a flowing current within one radiance to evoke John 1:1: the Word was in the beginning, was with God, and was God. The image is a metaphor, not a literal depiction. The English wording follows the verse's Berean Interlinear token glosses, identified as uncurated in the source.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: John, in rough clothing, touches his chest and gestures openly toward two listening men beside a reed-lined river, with hills in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John openly confessing that he is not the Christ in John 1:20. The questioners and Jordan setting draw on the surrounding passage; the gestures and appearance are artistic choices. The chapter identifies the English token glosses as Berean Interlinear Bible, not GBT-approved glosses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: John the Baptist in a rough brown robe raises both hands as two robed men question him beside a sunlit river, with reeds and distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative rendering of John 1:21, where John answers that he is neither Elijah nor the prophet. The setting, gestures, and clothing are artistic interpretation; the verse's English token glosses come from the Berean Interlinear.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: John the Baptist listens beside the Jordan as a robed messenger gestures toward him and two other men watch, with reeds and sunlit hills behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the messengers asking John who he is and what he says about himself so they can answer those who sent them. The verse's word glosses come from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: John the Baptist, wearing a rough brown garment and holding a staff, calls out and gestures toward a straight path through a sunlit, rocky wilderness.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes John 1:23, where John describes himself as a voice crying in the wilderness and calls for the Lord's way to be made straight, as Isaiah the prophet said. The landscape, staff, gesture, and visible path are artistic choices; the verse does not describe this pictured moment or a literal road. The English token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible, not GBT-approved glosses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Several robed men stand together and speak with John, who holds a staff, on the rocky, reed-lined bank of a river.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 1:24, which identifies those sent as being from the Pharisees. The surrounding passage places their exchange with John beyond the Jordan; the figures, gestures and landscape are artistic choices. The chapter's English word glosses come from the Berean Interlinear and are not a GBT approval.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: On a sunlit riverbank, three robed men question John the Baptist; one gestures with an open hand as John listens, with reeds, water, and hills behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene inspired by John 1:25, in which they ask John why he baptizes if he is not the Christ, Elijah, or the Prophet. The setting, appearances, and gestures are artistic interpretations. The chapter's English token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear, not GBT-approved glosses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: John, wearing a rough brown garment, speaks with an open hand to a gathered crowd beside a sunlit river, with trees, hills and a village beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene shows John speaking beside water to listeners, evoking his words that he baptizes with water and that someone they do not know stands among them. The setting and individual appearances are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: John the Baptist, in a rough brown garment, gestures toward an approaching robed man in fastened sandals as listeners watch beside a sunlit river.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene evokes John 1:27, where John says he is not worthy to untie the sandal strap of the one coming after him. The verse does not describe this particular arrangement or say that John untied the sandal.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: John, in a rough brown garment, supports an unnamed man in the Jordan as five people watch from a reed-lined bank, with hills and a small settlement in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John baptizing near Bethany across the Jordan, the place described in John 1:28. The person being baptized, the onlookers, and the landscape are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: John the Baptist holds a staff and gestures toward Jesus as He approaches along a sunlit riverbank, with a white lamb beside Jesus.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes John 1:29, in which John sees Jesus coming and identifies Him as the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world. The riverside setting, staff, and accompanying lamb are artistic choices, not details stated in this verse. The English token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible, not GBT-approved glosses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An unlettered parchment scroll rests within warm golden radiance amid deep blue watercolor clouds and stars.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: A symbolic meditation on John 1:2: the Word was with God in the beginning. The scroll recalls the Word without depicting Jesus as a person. It is an illustration, not a claim that the Word is a created object or that this scene shows His pre-incarnation appearance.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed man sits among blue and golden clouds, looking toward brilliant light in a star-filled expanse.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the Word, referred to as 'He' in John 1:2, being with God in the beginning. The figure and light are symbolic, not a literal depiction. The verse's English token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: John the Baptist, dressed in a rough brown garment, gestures toward Jesus beside a river while listeners watch in warm golden light.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts John identifying Jesus as the man who comes after him yet has precedence because he was before him. The riverside setting and golden light are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: John the Baptist, wearing a rough brown garment, supports a wet man in the Jordan River as Jesus stands among onlookers on the riverbank.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene connects John’s testimony that he did not know Jesus with his coming to baptize in water so Jesus might be revealed to Israel. The pictured moment and arrangement are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: John gestures on a rocky riverbank as Jesus stands in the water with a white dove resting on his shoulder beneath a beam of light.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative rendering of John's testimony that he saw the Spirit descend from heaven like a dove and remain upon Jesus.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: John the Baptist and Jesus stand in the Jordan as John holds Jesus' hands and a white dove settles on Jesus' shoulder; reeds and sunlit hills surround the river.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects John 1:33, where John recounts being sent to baptize with water and the sign of the Spirit descending and remaining on the one who baptizes with the Holy Spirit. The dove draws on the surrounding account in John 1:32; the scene's appearance is an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: John the Baptist, dressed in a rough brown garment, gestures toward Jesus as a group listens beside a river, with reeds and sunlit hills behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative riverside scene depicts John the Baptist bearing witness to what he has seen: that Jesus is the Son of God, as in John 1:34. The setting and listeners are artistic details. The verse wording follows the chapter's Berean Interlinear token glosses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: John the Baptist, wearing a coarse brown garment, holds a staff and gestures while standing with two robed disciples on a rocky riverbank.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes John 1:35, in which John was standing again with two of his disciples on the next day. The riverbank, appearances, clothing, staff, and gestures are artistic choices. The English token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible, not GBT-approved glosses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: John the Baptist gestures toward Jesus walking beside a river as two disciples watch.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative rendering of John 1:36, where John looks at Jesus walking and calls him the Lamb of God; the two disciples are mentioned in the preceding verse. The riverbank and visual details are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: John the Baptist gestures toward Jesus as two disciples follow Him along a sunlit riverside path.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes John 1:37, in which two disciples hear John speaking and follow Jesus. The riverside path, gestures, clothing, and landscape are artistic choices. The English token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible, not GBT-approved glosses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: On a sunlit country path, Jesus turns toward two men following Him and extends an open hand as they look at Him; a tree, wildflowers, distant hills and a village surround them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts John 1:38, when Jesus turns toward those following Him, asks what they seek, and they address Him as Rabbi, meaning Teacher, and ask where He is staying. The landscape and appearances are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward the open doorway of a stone dwelling as two disciples approach in warm afternoon light.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes John 1:39, where Jesus invites the two disciples to come and see where He is staying; they come and remain with Him that day, and the verse says it was about the tenth hour. The dwelling, setting, clothing and gestures are artistic choices. The English token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible, not GBT-approved glosses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A watercolor landscape at sunrise with stars, mountains, a river, an olive tree, wildflowers, birds, and a doe with her fawn.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imagined scene: light joining a landscape full of living things evokes John 1:3's claim that all things came into being through the Word and that nothing that came into being did so without Him. The English token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible, as identified in the lesson.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus walks along a sunlit path ahead of two disciples as John the Baptist points toward him from behind them; hills, water, and a village lie in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects John 1:40, which identifies Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter, as one of the two who heard John and followed Jesus. The landscape, appearances, and particular moment are artistic choices. The chapter's English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear and are not a Global Bible Tools approval.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village, Andrew gestures eagerly while speaking to Simon, who listens with his hands against his chest.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Andrew finding his brother Simon and telling him that they have found the Messiah, called Christ in John 1:41. The setting, expressions, and gestures are artistic choices. The verse relationship follows the Berean Interlinear word glosses identified in the source file.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Andrew stands just behind Simon with a hand on his shoulder, while Jesus faces Simon and speaks with open hands on a sunny path among hills and trees.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects John 1:42: Andrew brings Simon to Jesus, and Jesus looks at Simon and tells him he will be called Cephas, interpreted as Peter. Andrew is identified in the preceding verses. The setting, appearances, and gestures are artistic choices. The English word glosses in the chapter are from the Berean Interlinear and are not a Global Bible Tools approval.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus extends an open hand toward Philip on a sunlit path, with olive trees, hills, a village, and water in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes John 1:43, where Jesus intends to go to Galilee, finds Philip, and says to him, 'Follow me.' The road, gestures, and landscape are artistic choices rather than details supplied by the verse. The English token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible, not GBT-approved glosses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Three men in robes stand on a rocky path above a lakeside town; one gestures toward the clustered stone houses and boats along the shore.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative view of Bethsaida, which John 1:44 identifies as Philip's hometown and the city of Andrew and Peter. The verse does not describe the pictured gathering.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: On a sunlit hillside path, a man holding a rolled scroll speaks with an open hand to another man, who listens thoughtfully; olive trees, stone walls, water, and a village fill the background.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects John 1:45, in which Philip finds Nathanael and says they have found Jesus, son of Joseph, from Nazareth, the one Moses wrote of in the Law and the prophets also wrote of. The landscape, appearances, gestures, and scroll are artistic choices. The verse's English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear and are not a Global Bible Tools approval.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Nathanael, in earth-toned robes, raises a questioning hand as Philip, in a blue cloak, gestures invitingly toward a path through sunlit hills, with a village in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes John 1:46, in which Nathanael asks whether anything good can come from Nazareth and Philip replies, 'Come and see.' Their appearances, gestures, and setting are artistic choices, not details supplied by the verse. The English token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible, not GBT-approved glosses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward Nathanael as he approaches along a sunlit path among olive trees and stone walls, with hills and a village in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jesus seeing Nathanael approach and speaking of him as a true Israelite in whom there is no deceit. The setting, appearances, and gestures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with a surprised Nathanael beside a fruiting fig tree, amid sunlit hills, stone walls, and a distant village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This scene imaginatively places Jesus and Nathanael's conversation beside a fig tree. In John 1:48, Jesus says He saw Nathanael under a fig tree before Philip called him; the location of their conversation is not specified. The supplied English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Beneath a fig tree, Nathanael sits facing Jesus, touching his chest and gesturing toward him as he speaks. A sunlit village and hills lie beyond them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Nathanael's answer to Jesus in John 1:49, when he addresses him as Rabbi, Son of God, and King of Israel. The setting and gestures are artistic choices. The English word glosses used for the interpretation come from the Berean Interlinear layer.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits among men, women, and children in a flower-filled landscape. Golden light surrounds Him, and a young leafy tree grows beside Him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene inspired by John 1:4: the light around Christ and the people evokes the verse's image of life in Him as the light of humanity. The token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures as He speaks to Nathanael, who listens with a hand on his chest; both sit beneath a fruiting fig tree overlooking sunlit hills and a village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus speaking to Nathanael after saying He saw him under the fig tree and promising that he would see greater things. The seated figures and setting are artistic choices. The English token glosses used for this scene are from the Berean Interlinear Bible, identified in the lesson as uncurated and not GBT-approved.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands among listeners on a rocky hillside, looking up at angels ascending and descending in golden light beneath an opening in the clouds.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative visualization of Jesus' promise in John 1:51 that His hearers will see heaven opened and God's angels ascending and descending on the Son of Man. The hillside, listeners, and visible vision are artistic choices rather than details supplied by the verse. The English token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible, not GBT-approved glosses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An oil lamp glows on a stone ledge beneath an olive tree, overlooking a moonlit valley and village at night.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses a lamp shining amid the night to evoke John 1:5: the light shines in the darkness, and the darkness did not overcome it. The relationship follows the verse's uncurated Berean Interlinear token glosses; the scene is a visual metaphor, not a depicted event from the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man in a rough brown garment walks with a staff along a rocky path through sunlit hills, with a settlement and winding river in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene of John setting out evokes John 1:6, which introduces a man named John sent from God. The landscape, lighting, journey and appearance are artistic choices rather than details supplied by this verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: John, wearing a rough robe and holding a staff, gestures toward a golden dawn while a small gathering listens on a rocky hillside overlooking a valley and water.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of John bearing witness concerning the Light, so that all might believe through him, in John 1:7. The dawn symbolizes the Light; the specific landscape and gathering are artistic choices. The verse's English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear and are not GBT-approved glosses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: John the Baptist gestures toward a golden sunrise over a river as a small group listens, in a warm watercolor landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined riverbank scene uses the sunrise to picture John bearing witness to the Light, while he himself is not the Light. The riverbank and dawn are artistic choices, not details asserted by John 1:8. The verse's English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Golden dawn light spreads over an ancient hillside village, illuminating a woman and child, a man with a basket of bread, a woman with a water jar, and an elderly man with a staff.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined dawn scene represents John 1:9's true light illuminating people in the world; the village and its inhabitants are artistic details, not a historical event described in the verse. The English token glosses in the source are from the Berean Interlinear, not GBT-approved glosses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward a flower-filled garden and stream as a family gathers beside him; a cloaked thief carries a basket past uprooted plants in the background.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: Inspired by John 10:10 and its Berean Interlinear word glosses, this imagined garden contrasts the thief's destructive purpose with Jesus' coming so people may have life abundantly. The setting and figures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed shepherd spreads his arms before a flock of sheep on a rocky golden hillside, facing a wolf, with a village and mountains in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative picture of Jesus as the good shepherd who lays down his life for the sheep. The wolf and the hillside are artistic details, not events specified in John 10:11.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A frightened man runs across a rocky, golden hillside, looking back as a wolf grabs a sheep by its fleece and the rest of the flock scatters.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 10:12: a hired servant leaves the sheep and flees as a wolf snatches and scatters them. The scene follows the supplied Greek text and Berean Interlinear token glosses; the landscape and appearances are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A hired shepherd sits under a tree counting coins from a pouch while sheep stand and graze nearby in a rocky pasture.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative illustration of the hired servant's lack of concern for the sheep in John 10:13. The coins, setting, and depicted action are artistic details rather than events stated in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath a tree among sheep on a sunny hillside, holding a shepherd's staff and gently touching a sheep as they look at one another.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the good shepherd and his sheep recognizing one another, reflecting John 10:14's words about knowing his own and being known by them.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands with outstretched arms before sheep in a stone fold, looking toward sunlight as a wolf approaches.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests Jesus' words about knowing the Father and laying down his life for the sheep. The sheepfold, wolf and sunlight are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A shepherd holding a crook reaches toward sheep approaching a stone fold, while more sheep gather around him beneath a tree in a sunlit hillside landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative picture of the other sheep hearing the shepherd's call and gathering as one flock with one shepherd in John 10:16. The supplied word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a golden watercolor landscape, Jesus stands with a hand over his heart beside an open stone tomb; dawn lights a distant hill with an empty cross.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene responds to John 10:17, where Jesus says the Father loves him because he lays down his life so that he may take it again. The tomb, cross, and dawn are visual symbols, not a setting specified by the verse. The English token glosses used are from the Berean Interlinear.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus kneels on a sunlit hillside, gently placing a lit oil lamp on a stone beneath a shaft of light.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses the lamp as a metaphor for Jesus' life. His hand rests on it as he lays it down, suggesting his willing choice and his authority to take it up again. The light from above suggests the command he received from the Father. The lamp and setting are not described in this verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, two groups of people in ancient dress gesture and confer with thoughtful, concerned expressions.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering reflects John 10:19's account of division arising again among Jewish people because of these words. The courtyard and individual reactions are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man climbs over the stone wall of a sheepfold while sheep gather behind a closed wooden gate in a sunlit rural landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates John 10:1's description of a person climbing into the sheepfold by another way instead of entering through the door, whom the verse calls a thief and a robber. The description follows the supplied Berean Interlinear token glosses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, Jesus sits speaking to a group as skeptical men gesture and other listeners look on.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined courtyard scene reflects John 10:20, where many say he has a demon and is insane and ask why others listen to him. The setting and gestures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a group in robes listens as one man speaks and another points toward his eyes.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined conversation illustrates people saying the words are not those of one possessed by a demon and asking whether a demon can open the eyes of the blind. The courtyard, people and gestures are artistic inventions. The excerpt identifies the English word glosses as Berean Interlinear.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Cloaked families carrying glowing oil lamps walk along a snow-dusted stone street, with a brightly lit temple complex in the distance beneath a cloudy winter sky.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: John 10:22 places the Feast of Dedication in Jerusalem in winter. The people, lamps, snow, and setting are imaginative details; the English word glosses used here are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus walks beneath a sunlit stone colonnade, with people behind him and a temple courtyard beyond the columns.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jesus walking in the temple, in Solomon's porch, as described in John 10:23. The architecture and other figures are artistic additions. The supplied English token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands in cream robes as a group gathers around Him in a sunlit stone courtyard; a man gestures toward Him while others watch.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative rendering of John 10:24, in which people encircle Jesus and ask Him to tell them plainly whether He is the Christ. The setting and appearances are imagined. The excerpt's English word glosses come from the Berean Interlinear, not GBT-approved glosses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to a group of listeners while taking the hand of a seated man beneath a tree, with sunlit stone buildings in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jesus answering listeners who do not believe; the gesture of helping a man suggests the works he says bear witness to him in his Father's name. The verse does not identify this particular act or setting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus holds a shepherd's staff among a flock of sheep and gestures toward four reserved listeners on a sunny hillside.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative pastoral scene uses the listeners' separation from the flock to picture Jesus' words that they do not believe because they are not among his sheep. The hillside and flock are visual metaphors, not a claim about the literal setting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A shepherd in a red-brown cloak looks back and reaches toward a flock of sheep following him along a sunlit hillside path.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative pastoral scene gives visual form to the verse's sheep hearing the speaker's voice, his knowing them, and their following him. The landscape and visual details are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A group of people rests among flowers in a giant cupped hand, beneath a golden sun with a river and hills in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses a sheltering hand, light, and living greenery to evoke the eternal life and lasting protection promised in John 10:28.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits with four people on a sunlit hillside as a vast luminous hand curves protectively around them and a dark hand reaches toward them from a distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene draws on the excerpt's Berean Interlinear word glosses: the luminous hand represents the Father's protection of those he has given to Jesus, beyond another's grasp. It is a visual metaphor, not a literal depiction.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A shepherd carrying a crook steps through an open wooden door into a stone sheepfold, where sheep turn toward him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 10:2: the one entering by the door is the shepherd of the sheep. The sheepfold and surrounding setting are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath a tree on a rocky hillside, reaching one hand upward as golden rays illuminate a valley, a lake, and a distant village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The light and landscape imaginatively suggest Jesus' statement that he and the Father are one; the verse does not describe these visual details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man in white and blue robes calmly faces a group of men, some holding stones aloft while one bends to pick one up.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative illustration of John 10:31: the Berean Interlinear token glosses describe the Jews taking up stones again so that they might stone him. The courtyard, clothing, expressions, and arrangement are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with open hands to a group of men holding stones in a sunlit stone courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jesus asking which of the many good works he showed them from the Father is the reason they stone him; the setting and visual details are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, Jesus faces several men, some holding stones, as one gestures toward Him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This is an imaginative depiction of John 10:33, where the speakers say they are not stoning Jesus for a good work but accuse Him of blasphemy, saying that He, being a man, makes Himself God. The setting and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward an open scroll while four men listen in a sunlit stone courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus answering his listeners and referring to what is written in their law, including the words 'I said, you are gods'; the setting, scroll and gestures are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Five people in ancient robes gather around an intact blank scroll on a stone table as an older man gestures in a sunlit courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the people whom the verse says were called gods and to whom the word of God came. The intact scroll symbolizes Scripture that cannot be broken; the setting and gathering are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, Jesus speaks with one hand on his chest and the other extended while a seated man points at him and others listen.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 10:36: Jesus responds to an accusation of blasphemy, asking why they say this of him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world because he said he is the Son of God. The supplied excerpt identifies its English word glosses as Berean Interlinear.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits with open hands, speaking to five attentive listeners in a sunlit stone courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined conversation reflects Jesus' conditional statement: if he does not do his Father's works, his listeners should not believe him. The setting and gestures are imaginative and are not specified by the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus holds a seated man's hand in a sunlit stone courtyard while a group of onlookers watch, some skeptical and others hopeful.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined act of compassion and the courtyard setting illustrate the verse's invitation to believe Jesus' works and understand that the Father is in him and he is in the Father. The verse does not specify this particular act or setting. The interpretation follows the supplied Berean Interlinear glosses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus walks beyond the reach of several men stretching out their hands toward him in a sunlit stone courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 10:39: the supplied Berean Interlinear glosses describe their renewed attempt to seize him and his going out of their grasp. The courtyard and the figures' appearances are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A doorkeeper holds a wooden gate open while a shepherd turns and gestures to sheep following him out of a stone sheepfold.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 10:3: the doorkeeper opens for him, the sheep hear his voice, and he calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man in simple robes sits beneath a tree beside a winding river, looking across the water toward reeds and sunlit hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative view of Jesus staying beyond the Jordan after returning to the place where John had first baptized. The setting and his appearance are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowd gathers around Jesus on a sunlit path, with several people speaking and gesturing as others listen among trees, flowers, and distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts people coming to Jesus and speaking about John's testimony: John did no sign, and everything he said about Jesus was true. The setting and gestures are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath a tree among a large crowd of men, women, and children who look toward Him, with hills, water, and a village in the sunlit distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of many people believing in Jesus there, as described in John 10:42. The setting, appearance, and gestures are artistic interpretation, not details specified by this verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A shepherd glances back with an outstretched hand as sheep follow him along a sunlit hillside path, with a stone sheepfold behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative picture of John 10:4: the shepherd goes ahead and the sheep follow, reflecting the verse's description of their knowing his voice.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler calls with an outstretched hand as a flock of sheep runs away across a golden, rocky hillside.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for John 10:5: the sheep flee from a stranger whose voice they do not recognize.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus, seated in a sunlit stone courtyard, gestures as a group of listeners watches him with questioning expressions.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus speaking an allegory to listeners who do not understand what he is saying. The courtyard and gestures are artistic choices. The supplied Greek text is Nestle 1904 and the word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus, wearing a cream robe and red cloak, speaks to listeners from the entrance of a stone sheepfold as sheep gather around him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene places Jesus in a sheepfold entrance to picture his words that he is the door of the sheep. The setting and the listeners' appearance are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Several sheep turn away inside a stone sheepfold as two men gesture over the wall in a sunlit pastoral landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the verse's sheep not listening to the thieves and robbers; the setting and figures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus welcomes a robed traveler at the open doorway of a stone sheepfold, gesturing toward a sunny green pasture where sheep graze.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates Jesus' words that he is the door: whoever enters through him will be saved, will go in and out, and will find pasture. The traveler, sheepfold and landscape are artistic interpretations informed by the supplied Berean Interlinear word glosses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler stumbles over a stone on a rocky path among olive trees at night, with a moonlit village in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a person stumbling while walking at night, reflecting the verse’s words that the light is not in him.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to attentive disciples on a sunlit path, gesturing toward a distant village among hills and olive trees.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus telling his companions that their friend Lazarus has fallen asleep and that he is going to awaken him, as described in John 11:11.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus walks with disciples along a sunlit path as one gestures while speaking to him; olive trees and a distant village fill the warm landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the disciples speaking to the Lord about the hope that the one who has fallen asleep will get well. The setting and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to thoughtful disciples on a sunlit path, with a stone burial place in the distant hillside.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the contrast in John 11:13: Jesus spoke of a man’s death, while his listeners understood him to be speaking of the rest of sleep.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks solemnly to a group of attentive companions beneath a tree in a sunlit, rocky landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus plainly telling them that Lazarus has died, as expressed by the verse and its Berean Interlinear token glosses. The setting and the listeners’ appearance are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward a distant village as four attentive disciples walk with him along a sunlit road among olive trees and hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus encouraging his disciples to go with him, reflecting the verse's words about rejoicing for their sake so that they may believe.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Thomas gestures toward a figure on a sunlit path as his fellow disciples listen with concern and resolve.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Thomas, called Didymus, urging his fellow disciples to go too, even if they may die with him; the setting and gestures are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus listens to a grieving woman who gestures toward a rock-cut tomb with a partially open entrance and wilted flowers nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus arriving and learning that the man had already been in the tomb four days. The figures, setting, and visible tomb entrance are artistic choices; the verse does not specify these details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A small stone village among olive trees overlooks a winding path toward a walled city across sunlit hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative landscape illustrates John 11:18, which places Bethany near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia away; it is not a map of their exact geography.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two grieving women sit together in a sunlit courtyard as visitors gather around them with gestures of comfort.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects John 11:19, where many Jewish visitors came to Martha and Mary to console them concerning their brother. The setting and gestures are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An ailing Lazarus lies awake in bed as two women tend to him in a sunlit stone room; village buildings are visible through an open doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: John 11:1 identifies Lazarus as ailing and from Bethany, the village of Mary and her sister Martha. The bedside scene, the sisters' presence and care, and the setting are imaginative details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Martha meets Jesus on a sunlit stone path outside a house, while Mary sits inside the open doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of John 11:20: Martha meets Jesus after hearing he is coming, while Mary sits in the house. The setting and appearances are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A sorrowful Martha speaks with an outstretched hand to Jesus, who listens beside a stone path among olive trees and village buildings.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Martha speaking to Jesus about her brother's death in John 11:21; the setting and gestures are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman gestures as she speaks with Jesus on a sunlit path near an ancient village, surrounded by trees, stone walls, and wildflowers.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a conversation inspired by John 11:22, expressing confidence that God will give what is asked of him. The setting and gestures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits on a stone wall and speaks with an open hand to a tearful woman seated across from him on a sunlit village path.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus telling a woman that her brother will rise again in John 11:23; the setting and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Martha speaks earnestly to a seated man in an ancient landscape, with a tomb and a golden dawn behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Martha expressing her confidence that he will rise in the resurrection on the last day; the dawn suggests her future hope.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with a woman beneath a tree amid stones and green plants, with a sunlit hillside village in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus speaking to a woman, with morning light and new growth suggesting his words about resurrection and life in John 11:25.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with an attentive woman beneath an olive tree in a sunlit garden, with a path leading toward distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests Jesus’ question about belief and the promise of enduring life in John 11:26; the garden and distant path are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman with her hand over her heart speaks to Jesus as they sit beside a sunlit path among olive trees and distant village houses.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the woman's confession that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, who is coming into the world, in John 11:27.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman leans close to speak privately to Mary, who listens in a sunlit home.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 11:28, where a woman privately tells her sister Mary that the Teacher has come and calls her.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman rises and hurries along a sunlit path toward a man in the distance, while another woman sits beside a stone house.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 11:29: after hearing, she rises quickly and comes toward him. The setting and appearances are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Mary kneels beside Jesus and wipes his bare foot with her long hair beside an open jar of oil, while a man rests in bed in the background of a warmly lit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: John 11:2 identifies Mary as the woman who anointed the Lord with fragrant oil and wiped his feet with her hair, and says that her brother Lazarus was sick. This imaginative scene brings those details together; the verse does not say they happened in the same room or at the same time.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus and Martha sit together beneath a tree on a rocky path outside a distant village, speaking with serious, compassionate expressions.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus remaining outside the village at the place where Martha had met him; the setting and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Mary hurries from a stone house as concerned mourners follow her into the sunlight.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 11:31: those comforting Mary follow her after she rises and leaves, supposing she is going to the tomb to weep.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Mary kneels at Jesus’ feet on a sunlit village path, looking up at him through tears as he looks down at her.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 11:32: Mary falls at Jesus’ feet and speaks to him in grief about her brother’s death. The setting and appearance are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus looks with a troubled expression toward a seated, weeping woman and the grieving people gathered around her in a sunlit Judean landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 11:33: Jesus sees the woman and those who came with her weeping and is deeply moved in spirit and troubled.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands with grieving people as a man gestures along a path toward a rock-cut entrance in a sunlit hillside.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 11:34: Jesus asks where he was laid, and those with Him invite Him to come and see. The setting and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath a tree with his head bowed and tears on his face, overlooking a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus weeping in John 11:35; the landscape and pose are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A grieving man sits with his face in his hands while four onlookers speak and watch with compassion near a rocky tomb.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of onlookers recognizing a man's love, inspired by John 11:36; the setting and gestures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Grieving people speak with questioning expressions to Jesus beside a rock-hewn tomb, with a shrouded figure in the background.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects the question in John 11:37: whether the one who opened the eyes of the blind could also have kept this man from dying.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus approaches a rocky cave tomb with a solemn expression; a large stone rests against its entrance in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 11:38, where Jesus comes to the cave tomb deeply moved and a stone lies against it.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward a large stone at a rock-cut tomb as Martha looks at him anxiously and nearby people move the stone.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus asking for the stone to be taken away and Martha expressing concern about the deceased after four days, as described in John 11:39.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two worried sisters speak to a departing messenger at a stone house while a sick man rests on a bed inside.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the sisters sending word to the Lord that the one he loves is sick. The messenger, house, and gestures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with an attentive woman beneath a tree, with a sunlit village and hills in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus speaking to the woman about believing and seeing the glory of God; the setting and appearance are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus looks upward with hands raised as people stand nearby and move a large stone beside a rock-cut opening in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of John 11:41: the stone is taken away and Jesus lifts His eyes, thanking the Father for hearing Him. The setting and figures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus looks upward in prayer with one hand raised as a crowd gathers around him among olive trees and sunlit stones.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus speaking so the surrounding crowd may believe that the One who hears him sent him, as expressed in John 11:42.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus calls toward a dark rock-cut tomb with one hand outstretched as onlookers watch in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the moment in John 11:43 when Jesus cries out in a loud voice for Lazarus to come forth. The setting and figures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A linen-wrapped man steps from a stone tomb as Jesus gestures toward him and nearby people look on in wonder.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 11:44: the man who had been dead comes forth wrapped in linen, and Jesus tells those present to unbind him and let him go. The setting and figures are interpretive.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Mary and a group of visitors look toward Jesus with wonder in a sunlit stone courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of the visitors who came to Mary and, having seen what Jesus did, believed in him in John 11:45. The setting and individual reactions are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A group of people speak earnestly to attentive Pharisees in a sunlit stone courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts some people telling the Pharisees what Jesus had done, as described in John 11:46. The setting, appearance, and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Chief priests and Pharisees gather around a table in a warmly lit stone chamber, discussing with concerned expressions as one man gestures.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the council in John 11:47, where the chief priests and Pharisees ask what to do because this man performs many signs.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Concerned leaders confer in a stone chamber as one gestures toward a distant teacher and listeners, with Roman soldiers watching from Jerusalem's walls.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene conveying the speakers' fear that, if belief in Him spreads, the Romans will come and take away their place and nation; it does not portray that feared outcome as having occurred.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A stern high priest in blue and gold robes gestures as he speaks to a group of men in a warmly lit stone chamber.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Caiaphas, the high priest that year, telling the others they know nothing in John 11:49. The setting and appearance are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with a concerned woman outside a stone home while an ill man rests on a bed inside.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative setting for Jesus' words in John 11:4: after hearing about the sickness, he says it is not unto death but for God's glory, so that the Son of God may be glorified through it. The woman, home, and bedside scene are artistic choices, not details specified in this verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed elder addresses seated elders, gesturing toward a solitary man standing before families and a sunlit town.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene presents the verse's statement that one man should die for the people so that the whole nation might not perish; the setting and figures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A high priest speaks to a gathering in a sunlit stone courtyard, while Jesus stands among people in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting the high priest's prophecy that Jesus would die for the nation; the setting and figures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: People of varied ages arrive along paths through sunlit hills and gather around Jesus, who welcomes them with open arms.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering pictures John 11:52's words about the scattered children of God being gathered into one; it does not depict a specific event described in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Five robed men confer gravely around a table in a stone chamber, while a lone man walks away in sunlight beyond an arch.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the verse's account that from that day they took counsel together to kill him; the setting and figures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits with disciples in a quiet stone courtyard, with a hill town and dry hills beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus staying with his disciples in Ephraim near the wilderness, as described in John 11:54. The courtyard and shared moment are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Travelers wash at a stone basin as a crowd walks uphill toward the walls of Jerusalem in warm sunlight.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of people going up from the region to Jerusalem before Passover to purify themselves, as described in John 11:55. The washing and individual travelers are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Pilgrims stand together in a sunlit temple courtyard, talking and looking toward the entrance as others gather nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the people in John 11:56 seeking Jesus and asking one another in the temple whether he would come to the feast.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Robed leaders address attentive townspeople in a sunlit stone courtyard, while one man watches the distant street.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene illustrates the chief priests and Pharisees giving orders to report where he was so that they might seize him; the verse does not describe this particular courtyard or gathering.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits with Martha, her sister, and Lazarus in a sunlit stone courtyard, resting a hand on Lazarus's shoulder as the group smiles together.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: John 11:5 says Jesus loved Martha, her sister, and Lazarus. This imagined gathering expresses that love; the verse does not specify a meeting or setting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits on a cushioned bench in a sunlit courtyard, listening to a kneeling visitor. Two small stones lie side by side between them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects John 11:6 and the excerpt's Berean Interlinear glosses: Jesus hears that someone is sick and remains where he is for two days. The visitor and courtyard are imagined, and the two stones suggest the two days.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures as he walks with five disciples along a sunlit hillside path, with a village and mountains in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 11:7, where Jesus tells his disciples to go into Judea again, as reflected in the Berean Interlinear word glosses. The setting, gestures, and appearance are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus listens to concerned disciples on a rocky path as one gestures toward a distant town.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the disciples asking their Rabbi whether he is going there again after the Jews had recently sought to stone him. The setting and gestures are artistic interpretations of John 11:8, informed by its Berean Interlinear glosses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward a sunlit, stony path as a traveler with a walking staff walks beside him; hills and a village lie in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene inspired by Jesus' words about the twelve hours of daylight and walking without stumbling while seeing the light of this world. The traveler and setting are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Chief priests confer gravely around a table in a stone chamber while a man representing Lazarus walks in a sunlit courtyard beyond the doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the chief priests taking counsel to kill Lazarus also; the setting and figures are visual interpretations rather than details specified by John 12:10.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A group of people walk along a sunlit village path toward Jesus, who welcomes them with open hands.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene suggesting the people going away and believing in Jesus in John 12:11. The verse does not specify the pictured setting or gestures.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A large crowd gathers outside Jerusalem's stone walls as people share news and listeners turn toward them in warm morning light.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the festival crowd hearing that Jesus is coming to Jerusalem, as described in John 12:12.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A joyful crowd raises palm branches to greet Jesus as he approaches on a donkey along a sunlit road near a stone town.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene inspired by John 12:13, where people take palm branches, go out to meet him, and shout their welcome. Details of the setting and figures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits on a young donkey on a sunlit path among olive trees, with hills and a village in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jesus seated on the young donkey he found in John 12:14. The landscape and other visual details are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus rides a young donkey toward a sunlit stone city gate as people welcome him with palm branches.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the king coming to Zion seated on a donkey’s colt, expressing the verse’s reassurance not to fear. The setting and welcoming figures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Five disciples gather around an open blank scroll in a sunlit stone room, exchanging thoughtful looks as one gestures; a city lies beyond the doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the disciples later remembering what had been written about Jesus and done to him after he was glorified, though they had not understood at first. The setting and gathering are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An animated crowd gestures toward Jesus and Lazarus beside a sunlit rock-cut tomb, recalling the raising of Lazarus.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative recollection of the event to which the crowd bears witness in John 12:17. The composition combines the witnesses with the raising they remember; its faces, clothing, setting and arrangement are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowd of adults and children gathers around Jesus on a sunlit road, some speaking animatedly and others looking at him with wonder.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the crowd meeting Jesus after hearing that he had done a sign, as described in John 12:18. The setting and gestures are imagined; the sign itself is not depicted.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Three Pharisees speak together with concerned expressions while a crowd follows Jesus down a sunlit stone street.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the Pharisees speaking among themselves and observing that the world has gone after him in John 12:19.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus approaches along a sunlit village path as Lazarus welcomes him with open arms beside a stone house.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jesus arriving at Bethany, where Lazarus was, six days before Passover. The verse says Jesus had raised Lazarus from the dead; the greeting and setting are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Pilgrims in ancient Mediterranean clothing ascend a sunlit stone path with a crowd toward a temple precinct on a hill.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the Greeks among those coming up to worship at the feast in John 12:20; the appearance of the travelers and setting are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Three visitors in a sunlit stone courtyard speak with an attentive man; one gestures with open hands as the others look on hopefully.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of the people approaching Philip and asking to see Jesus in John 12:21. The setting, appearances, and gestures are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men gesture as they speak with Jesus in a sunlit stone courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Andrew and Philip telling Jesus, following Philip's telling Andrew in John 12:22. The setting and appearances are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to a small group beneath a tree, with golden light falling around him and hills and a village in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus answering that the hour has come for the Son of Man to be glorified. The setting and golden light are artistic choices, not details stated in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A lone grain of wheat rests on the soil beside an exposed planted grain with roots and a flourishing cluster of golden wheat heads, in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative picture of Jesus' comparison in John 12:24: a grain remains alone unless it falls into the ground and dies, but if it dies it bears much fruit.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler walks with open hands along a sunlit path, leaving a bundle of possessions and falling leaves behind as he approaches a green valley and distant town.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses the traveler leaving possessions behind and walking toward a flourishing landscape as a visual analogy for John 12:25's contrast between loving one's life in this world and keeping it for eternal life. It does not depict a literal event in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus walks along a sunlit path, turning toward a follower carrying a water jug, amid flowers, trees, and distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes Jesus' words about serving and following him, being where he is, and the Father's promise to honor his servant. The setting and water jug are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus kneels among rocks and olive trees, one hand over his heart, looking toward light breaking through dark clouds above a winding path and distant hillside town.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Jesus' troubled soul, his address to the Father, and his declaration that he came to this hour for this reason. The landscape and pose are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus kneels beneath an olive tree, hands clasped and face lifted toward golden light breaking through clouds above an ancient city.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus asking the Father to glorify His name and the voice from heaven answering that He has glorified it and will glorify it again. The light suggests the voice visually; the verse does not describe its appearance.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowd gathers around Jesus beneath a tree, looking upward and speaking to one another in surprise, with distant hills and buildings under a partly cloudy sky.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 12:29: the crowd hears a sound, with some saying it was thunder and others saying an angel spoke to him. Their differing explanations are suggested by their reactions, not shown as visible events.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Martha carries a platter to a low supper table where Jesus, Lazarus, and other guests recline together in a warmly lit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 12:2: a supper is prepared for Jesus, Martha serves, and Lazarus reclines among those with Him. The setting and visual details are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits outdoors and gestures toward a group of listeners, some of whom look up toward a bright sky over a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of Jesus addressing listeners after the voice, reflecting his words in John 12:30 that it came because of them.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A richly dressed princely figure stumbles out through a walled city's open gate toward a dark landscape, leaving a fallen crown behind as golden light shines over the city.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative image of the judgment of this world and its prince being cast out in John 12:31; the city, figure, and fallen crown are symbolic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A diverse gathering walks toward Jesus, who is lifted on a wooden cross above a sunlit hillside.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the verse’s words about being lifted up from the earth and drawing all to himself; the gathering and landscape are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks solemnly to attentive listeners beneath a tree, with a cross-shaped shadow across the ground and a distant city in the sunlit hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus speaking, with the shadow foreshadowing the kind of death he was about to die as described in John 12:33.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man gestures toward Jesus while a crowd watches with thoughtful, questioning expressions.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of the crowd questioning Jesus in John 12:34 about the Christ remaining and the Son of Man being lifted up.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to listeners beside a sunlit stone path at dusk, gesturing toward a distant traveler hesitating where the path fades into shadow.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene expressing Jesus' words in John 12:35 about walking while the light is present and the uncertainty of walking in darkness. The setting and traveler are illustrative details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A group of listeners looks toward warm sunlight in a stone courtyard as Jesus walks into a shaded passage and out of their sight.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes Jesus' call to believe in the light and become children of light, followed by his departure and concealment from the people. The setting and appearance are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus holds out his hands in a sunlit stone courtyard as several onlookers gaze skeptically or turn away.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting John 12:37: although Jesus had done many signs before them, they did not believe in Him. The courtyard and people's gestures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A prophet speaks to attentive listeners in a sunlit stone courtyard as a luminous arm reaches through the clouds.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative picture of Isaiah’s words quoted in John 12:38, evoking the questions of who believed the report and to whom the Lord’s arm was revealed.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly prophet speaks with an open hand to a group of thoughtful, troubled listeners in a sunlit stone courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evokes the verse's statement that they could not believe and that Isaiah spoke again; it does not depict a documented meeting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Mary kneels beside Jesus in a warmly lit house, wiping his bare foot with her long hair; an open vessel of oil rests on the rug.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 12:3: Mary anoints Jesus' feet with precious pure nard and wipes them with her hair as the fragrance fills the house. The room and visual details are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, people close or cover their eyes as a man holds a stone heart against his chest near an open, light-filled doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evokes the verse's blinded eyes and hardened heart; the open doorway suggests turning and healing without depicting them as completed.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Isaiah speaks to attentive listeners on a rocky hillside, extending his hand toward golden light streaming through clouds above a distant town.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects John 12:41: Isaiah spoke concerning Him because he saw His glory. The setting, listeners, and radiant light are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Several richly dressed rulers listen silently to Jesus in a sunlit stone courtyard as three men watch from a synagogue doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting John 12:42: many rulers believed in him but did not confess their belief because of the Pharisees, so they would not be put out of the synagogue.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Richly dressed people smile as a crowd applauds them in a stone courtyard, while a path leads toward a radiant sky behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects John 12:43's contrast between loving human glory and the glory of God; its people, courtyard, and radiant path are illustrative details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to a group of attentive listeners beneath a tree, raising one hand toward the sky above a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus speaking about believing in him and in the One who sent him; the setting and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks beneath a tree while a seated listener looks up at him, golden light falling across a Judean landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses a listener's attentive gaze and shared light to suggest Jesus' words that the one beholding him beholds the One who sent him; it does not depict a specified historical setting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus welcomes a group of people emerging from a shadowed stone street into golden light, with a village and hills beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses the contrast between shadow and light to evoke Jesus coming as light into the world so that everyone believing in him should not remain in darkness. The village and people are artistic interpretation, not details specified by the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with open hands to a group beneath a tree as one listener turns away; a sunlit path winds toward a distant village.
