records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Jesus' words about one who hears and does not keep his words, and his coming to save the world. The setting and figures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus extends a hand toward a man turning away with a raised hand, while a golden path winds toward a distant sunlit town.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays rejecting Jesus and his words. The light leading toward the horizon suggests the enduring word and the last day, when that word will judge.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to a group seated beneath a tree, one hand near his heart and the other extended toward his listeners, with a sunlit stone village beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Jesus' words that he speaks the command given by the Father who sent him; the setting, gestures, and appearances are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures as he speaks to Jesus among seated disciples in a warmly lit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Judas Iscariot speaking among Jesus’ disciples; John 12:4 identifies him as the one who was about to betray Jesus. The setting and gestures are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with an open hand to a group of adults and children seated beneath a leafy tree, with a sunlit path winding through a flowering landscape toward distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus speaking to listeners. The flourishing tree and distant light suggest life as the verse speaks of the Father’s commandment as eternal life and of Jesus speaking as the Father has said to him; the setting and listeners are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures questioningly beside a fragrant oil vessel and coins, while people in simple clothing stand beyond an open doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects the verse's question about selling fragrant oil for three hundred denarii and giving the proceeds to the poor; it does not depict the proposed sale or gift as having happened.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man glances aside as he lifts a coin from an open money bag in a sunlit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the theft described in John 12:6: the man kept the money bag and pilfered what was put into it. The room and moment are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus raises a hand toward a man as a woman beside Him holds a small closed vessel in a warmly lit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus asking that she be left alone so she may keep it for the day of His burial; the setting and vessel are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with an open hand to a group of attentive people, some in patched clothing, in a sunlit village courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Jesus' contrast between the poor always being with his listeners and his own presence with them not always continuing. The setting and gathering are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A large crowd gathers around Jesus and Lazarus in a sunlit stone courtyard, looking toward the two men.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the crowd coming to see Jesus and Lazarus, whom Jesus had raised from the dead, in John 12:9. The setting and appearances are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus kneels and washes a seated man's foot over a basin as several listeners look on in a warmly lit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus speaking about the person who has bathed needing only to wash the feet, and telling his listeners that they are clean, though not all are clean.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks among disciples in a warm, lamplit room, while one man sits apart in thought; a basin of water and folded cloth rest in the foreground.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for John 13:11: Jesus knows the one betraying him, which is why he says that not all are clean. The room, gestures, basin and expressions are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus reclines among attentive disciples around a low table, speaking with an open hand; a basin of water and folded cloth rest in the foreground.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts John 13:12 after Jesus has washed their feet, taken His garments, and reclined again to ask the disciples whether they know what He has done for them. The room and visual details are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits in a warmly lit room and gestures as a small group of followers listen attentively.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus speaking to his followers, reflecting John 13:13, where they call him Teacher and Lord and he affirms that they speak rightly. The setting and gestures are imagined; the English token glosses in the supplied excerpt are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus kneels beside a basin, washing a seated disciple's foot while other disciples watch; one holds a cloth in the warmly lit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting John 13:14: the Lord and Teacher washes his disciples' feet and calls them to wash one another's feet.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus offers a cup of water to a seated disciple, while another disciple offers a cup to a companion in a warmly lit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the verse’s pattern of following an example through shared acts of service; the verse does not specify these cups of water.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man gestures to a departing messenger while a servant holds a water jug nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evoking the verse's comparisons of a servant with his master and a messenger with the one who sent him; the pictured actions are not stated in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a kneeling man washes a seated man's foot in a basin while three companions look on and offer encouragement and a towel.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative act of care pictures the verse's relationship between knowing, doing, and being blessed; the verse itself does not specify this scene.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to companions gathered around a table of bread as a man holding bread turns away, his raised heel visible.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes John 13:18: Jesus speaks of one who eats his bread and lifts his heel against him. The departing figure and visible heel are an artistic interpretation, not a claim that the verse describes a literal departure or kick.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with an open hand to attentive disciples gathered around a low table in a warmly lamplit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of Jesus telling his listeners beforehand so that they may believe when it comes to pass, as expressed in John 13:19. The setting and figures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits among his followers at sunset, gesturing gently and resting a hand on one man's shoulder as they listen.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus with his own before Passover, expressing the verse's account of his enduring love as his hour to depart to the Father approaches. The setting and gestures are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman welcomes a travelling disciple at a village doorway while Jesus and other disciples stand on the sunlit path behind him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a household welcoming a messenger sent by Jesus, illustrating his teaching that receiving the one he sends is receiving him, and that receiving him is receiving the One who sent him.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with a troubled expression and a hand to his chest as listeners gather around a table and watch with concern.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus, troubled in spirit, telling those with him that one of them will betray him. The setting and individual expressions are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Disciples around a table exchange questioning glances as their teacher speaks in a warmly lit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the disciples looking at one another, uncertain whom he is speaking about in John 13:22.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus reclines beside a low meal table, with a disciple resting against his chest as Jesus embraces him; other diners appear in the foreground of a warmly lit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the disciple whom Jesus loved reclining in Jesus' bosom in John 13:23; the setting, appearance, and details are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a warmly lit room, Simon Peter gestures toward an attentive man beside him as another man looks on across a meal.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Simon Peter motioning to a man and telling him to ask who is being spoken about in John 13:24.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man leans close against Jesus and looks up as he speaks; Jesus listens beside him at a table in a warmly lit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 13:25: the man leans on Jesus' breast and asks him who it is. The room, clothing and other visual details are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus offers a dipped morsel of bread to Judas across a warmly lit table, with a shallow dish and other diners nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 13:26, where Jesus dips a morsel and gives it to Judas, son of Simon Iscariot.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus addresses a troubled man holding a morsel of bread at a lamplit meal, as a shadow rises behind him and others look on.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes John 13:27: after the morsel, Satan enters the man, and Jesus tells him to do quickly what he is doing. The shadow is a visual metaphor, not a depiction specified by the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man speaks quietly to another at a low meal table while reclining diners look on with puzzled expressions in a warmly lit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the uncertainty of those reclining, who did not know why he spoke to the other man in John 13:28. The setting and gestures are artistic interpretation, guided by the supplied Berean Interlinear glosses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward Judas, who holds a small money bag, as companions watch thoughtfully around a meal in a warmly lit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the moment behind John 13:29: some thought Jesus was telling Judas, who had the money bag, to buy what was needed for the feast or give something to the poor.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus and companions share supper in a warmly lit room, while a troubled Judas sits nearby with a dark wisp curling behind him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the supper in John 13:2; the dark wisp symbolizes the devil having already placed the intention to betray Jesus in Judas's heart.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man holding a morsel of bread steps briskly from a lamplit doorway into a moonlit night.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the verse: after receiving the morsel, he went out immediately, and it was night. The setting and appearance are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to attentive listeners around a table in a warmly lit room, while a man walks away through an open doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for John 13:31: after someone has gone out, Jesus speaks of the Son of Man and God being glorified in Him. The room, listeners and warm light are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits in a stone room, looking upward as warm golden light fills the space around him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses radiant light to suggest the verse's words about God being glorified in Him and glorifying Him immediately; it does not depict an event described in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks gently to a circle of attentive disciples in a warmly lamplit room, with a doorway open to the night.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus addressing his followers with tenderness as he tells them that he is with them only a little while and that they cannot come where he is going.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with open hands to disciples gathered in a sunlit stone courtyard; one disciple rests a reassuring hand on another's shoulder.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene reflects Jesus' new commandment to love one another as he has loved his disciples; the setting and gestures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village courtyard, companions comfort a weary man and offer him bread while nearby villagers watch.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene illustrates the verse’s teaching that people will recognize Jesus’ disciples by their love for one another; the particular encounter is not narrated in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Peter looks toward Jesus with a questioning gesture as Jesus gestures toward a sunlit path, in a warm watercolor courtyard scene.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Simon Peter asking where Jesus is going and Jesus saying Peter cannot follow now but will follow afterward; the courtyard and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Peter speaks earnestly to Jesus, one hand against his chest and the other extended, as Jesus listens in a warmly lit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Peter asking why he cannot follow the Lord now and declaring that he will lay down his life for Him in John 13:37. The room and visual details are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks gently to a troubled disciple seated beside him in a lamplit stone courtyard at night, while a quiet rooster stands on a nearby wall.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Jesus's question about laying down one's life and his prediction that the listener will deny him three times before a rooster crows. The setting and visible rooster are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands beneath an olive tree with light glowing between his open hands, looking toward a radiant sky above a winding path through a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses the light in Jesus' hands and the path toward the sky to evoke John 13:3: he knows the Father has given all things into his hands, and that he came from God and is going to God.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands beside a supper table and ties a white towel around his waist, while seated companions look on and an outer garment rests nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 13:4: he rises from supper, lays aside his garments, takes a towel and girds himself.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus kneels beside a seated disciple, wiping his wet foot with a towel over a basin as other disciples watch in a warmly lit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 13:5: Jesus washes the disciples' feet and wipes them with the towel around his waist; the room and figures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Simon Peter sits barefoot, gesturing in surprise toward Jesus, who kneels beside a basin of water holding a cloth in a warmly lit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus coming to Simon Peter and Peter asking whether the Lord is washing his feet. The room, appearances, and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks gently while washing a seated man’s foot in a basin; the man listens with a thoughtful, uncertain expression in a warmly lit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus answering a man who does not yet understand what Jesus is doing, but will know afterward. The setting and depicted action are artistic details, not stated in this verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Peter sits with his bare feet drawn back and his hands raised as Jesus kneels beside a basin of water, holding a cloth and looking toward him. Other men watch in a warmly lit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Peter's refusal to let Jesus wash his feet and Jesus' reply that without being washed Peter has no part with him (John 13:8). The setting and poses are artistic interpretation; the excerpt's English token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Simon Peter sits barefoot beside a basin, gesturing toward his head and raised hand as Jesus kneels nearby holding a towel and listens.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Simon Peter's request to the Lord in John 13:9: not his feet only, but also his hands and head. The setting and gestures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures as he speaks to attentive listeners seated around him in a warmly lit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus speaking with listeners evokes his question about believing that he is in the Father and the Father is in him, and his words about the Father dwelling in him and doing his works.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits with open hands, speaking to attentive disciples in a warmly sunlit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Jesus inviting his listeners to believe his words about the Father and, if not, to believe because of the works themselves. The setting and sunlight are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to gathered disciples beneath a tree while a man helps another rise and people share food along a sunlit village path.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Jesus' promise that the one believing in him will do his works and greater works, because he is going to the Father. The acts of care and light in the sky are artistic suggestions, not events specified in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus extends a hand toward a follower with open hands as others gather around him in a sunlit stone courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene suggests asking in Jesus' name and his response, with warm light evoking the Father's glory in the Son. It does not depict a specific incident described in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits among disciples in a warmly lit room, extending a hand toward a disciple who gestures with open hands.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined conversation evokes Jesus' promise that if his disciples ask him anything in his name, he will do it; the verse does not describe this particular scene.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with a small group of attentive disciples in a sunlit stone courtyard; one disciple holds a hand over his heart.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus teaching disciples, suggesting the relationship between love for him and keeping his commandments in John 14:15. The setting and gestures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath a tree, raising one hand toward a sunlit sky as disciples gather around and listen in a hilly landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene pictures Jesus speaking of asking the Father to give another Helper to be with his listeners for the age. The warm light is a poetic suggestion of abiding presence, not a literal depiction of the Helper.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A group listens to a seated teacher in a sunlit stone courtyard while townspeople pass along the street beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering and its warm light suggest the Spirit of truth abiding with those who know Him, while others pass by absorbed in their activities. The setting and light are artistic choices, not a literal depiction of the Spirit or a historical scene specified by the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus extends a welcoming hand toward a group of adult disciples in a sunlit stone courtyard, beneath olive branches.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus coming to his disciples conveys the verse's promise that he will not leave them as orphans; it is not a literal reconstruction.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands among attentive followers in a sunlit garden, while people walk away along a distant village path.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus with followers who see him, with morning light and new growth suggesting his promise that because he lives they also will live; the garden and distant passersby are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks gently with a group of disciples seated together on a sunlit stone terrace overlooking a peaceful landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Jesus reassuring his listeners, reflecting the verse's call for their hearts not to be troubled and to believe in God and in him. The setting and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands among attentive disciples in a sunlit landscape, gesturing warmly as they look toward him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene uses shared golden light and the disciples' attentive faces to suggest the verse's promise that they will know Jesus is in the Father, they are in him, and he is in them.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands with open hands beside a man and woman sharing bread in a sunlit village courtyard; a closed scroll rests nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene connects the sharing of bread and Jesus' warm presence with the verse's words about keeping his commandments, loving him, being loved by the Father and by Jesus, and Jesus showing himself. It does not portray a specified historical event.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A disciple gestures toward Jesus as he speaks, while others listen in a sunlit room; a town is visible outside.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Judas, not Iscariot, asking Jesus why He is about to reveal Himself to the disciples and not to the world. The room, gestures and view of the town are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward a sunlit table in a stone home while an attentive woman looks up at him beside the open doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the welcome and shared home in Jesus' promise that those who love him and keep his word will be loved by his Father, and that they will come and make a home with them.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to listeners in a sunlit stone courtyard while a man at the side turns away with folded arms.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflects Jesus' words about not keeping his words and the word heard coming from the Father who sent him; the courtyard and listeners are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with open hands to attentive disciples gathered around him in a warmly lit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus speaking while present with his listeners, reflecting John 14:25; the room and details are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a warmly lit room, disciples gather thoughtfully while a dreamlike remembrance above them shows Jesus teaching.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene suggesting the Holy Spirit teaching the disciples and bringing Jesus’ words to their remembrance, as described in John 14:26. The light and remembered scene are visual metaphors.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits among attentive disciples in a warmly lit room, extending an open hand as a storm blows beyond the doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests Jesus giving his peace and reassuring troubled hearts in John 14:27; the room and storm are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to attentive disciples in a warm room, gesturing toward an open doorway filled with sunlight.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus speaking to his listeners evokes his words about going to the Father and coming to them, with the doorway suggesting departure and hope.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with an open hand to attentive disciples gathered in a warmly lit room, with a golden sky visible through an open doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jesus telling his listeners beforehand, reflecting the verse’s connection between what he has said, what will happen, and their believing. The setting and dawn are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus smooths bedding in a sunlit stone house, with several welcoming rooms visible through open doorways.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus preparing a place in his Father’s house, with open rooms suggesting the many dwelling places described in John 14:2. It does not depict the house literally.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks calmly to attentive disciples in a warmly lit room, while an indistinct shadow approaches along the street outside the open door.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus speaking with his listeners as the coming ruler of the world is suggested by a shadow outside. The untouched lamplight around Jesus suggests the verse's statement that the ruler has nothing in him.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward an open doorway while disciples rise around him in a warmly lit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene depicts Jesus inviting his disciples to rise and leave, suggesting the loving obedience to the Father expressed in John 14:31.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus opens his arms to welcome a joyful group of followers on a flower-lined path, with a sunlit dwelling and garden behind him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus welcoming his followers toward a prepared place, reflecting the verse's promise that he will come again and receive them to be with him. The garden and dwelling are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to attentive disciples beneath a tree and gestures toward a winding path through a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses a winding path to evoke Jesus' words that his listeners know the way to the place where he is going.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Thomas sits with open hands as he speaks to Jesus, who listens calmly; other disciples watch in a warm stone room, with a winding path visible through the doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Thomas asking the Lord how they can know the way when they do not know where He is going. The room, listeners and visible path are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to an attentive man beneath a tree, gesturing toward a sunlit path winding through flowers and greenery to a distant city.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Jesus' words that he is the way, the truth, and the life, and that no one comes to the Father except through him. The path and distant light are visual metaphors, not a depiction of the verse's setting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to attentive disciples beneath a tree in a sunlit landscape, with warm light falling over the gathering.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evokes Jesus' words about knowing him and knowing and having seen the Father; the light is an artistic suggestion, not a depiction of the Father.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Philip gestures earnestly toward Jesus as other disciples listen beneath a tree in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Philip asking the Lord to show them the Father, as described in John 14:8; the setting and gestures are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with an open hand to Philip, who listens thoughtfully, while other disciples sit nearby in a warmly lit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Jesus speaking to Philip in John 14:9, where Jesus says that the one who has seen him has seen the Father.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus teaches a small group of attentive disciples beneath a tree in a sunlit garden, with hills and a village in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the disciples abiding in Jesus' love as they attend to his teaching, and the warm light evokes his abiding in the Father's love; the setting is not specified by John 15:10.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with a joyful group gathered beneath a tree on a sunlit hillside, surrounded by wildflowers and distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering pictures Jesus speaking and his hearers sharing joy, reflecting his words about his joy being in them and their joy being made full. The setting and expressions are artistic additions.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with open hands to a group in a sunlit courtyard as one follower helps another to stand.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus teaching and followers caring for one another, reflecting his command to love one another as he loved them. The setting and gestures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man lies still among fallen rocks, his arm reaching toward a young friend, while three friends gather close in grief on a sunlit hillside.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative rockfall scene reflects John 15:13's description of the greatest love: laying down one's life for one's friends. The verse does not describe this particular event.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward a sunlit path while four attentive followers walk beside him through a rocky landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene suggests the friendship and responsive obedience described in John 15:14. The setting and gesture are illustrative; the verse does not specify a particular command or depict this walk.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits in a sunlit stone courtyard, speaking with open hands to a group of attentive disciples gathered closely around him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes Jesus calling his listeners friends and making known what he heard from his Father; the courtyard and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward a sunlit path and fruit trees while his followers listen in a garden; one bows in prayer.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for John 15:16: Jesus addresses those he chose and appointed, while lasting fruit and prayer evoke the verse's words about bearing fruit and asking the Father in his name.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus addresses a group in a sunlit stone courtyard as one disciple helps another to his feet.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imagined moment of mutual care illustrates Jesus' command in John 15:17 to love one another; the verse does not describe this particular scene.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks gently to seated disciples beneath a tree, one hand on his chest and the other extended, while townspeople turn away along a path near a sunlit stone town.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting John 15:18: Jesus tells his followers that if the world hates them, it hated him before them. The setting and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward a group of disciples on a stone path beside a crowded town marketplace, where some people look toward them warily and others embrace.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests Jesus choosing his disciples out of the world and the world's rejection of them, alongside the verse's contrast with the world loving its own.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward a flourishing grapevine while a vinedresser tends its leafy branches in a sunlit vineyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jesus beside a vine and a vinedresser to evoke his words that he is the true vine and his Father is the vinedresser. The gardener is a visual metaphor, not a literal portrait of the Father.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to attentive disciples on a sunlit stone path while a group of townspeople gestures angrily in the background.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene connects Jesus' teaching about a servant and master to his warning that his disciples may face persecution and his words may also be kept. It does not depict a specified historical event.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to a group of disciples beneath a tree as hostile townspeople gesture toward them in a sunlit village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Jesus’ warning that others would act against his followers on account of his name because they do not know the One who sent him; the setting and gestures are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with open hands to a group of solemn, thoughtful listeners in a sunlit stone courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes John 15:22: Jesus has come and spoken to them, and they now have no excuse for their sin. The courtyard and the listeners are artistic interpretation, not details specified by the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man turns away with a hostile expression and raised hand while Jesus stands nearby on a sunlit path in a hilly landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene portrays rejection of Jesus as a visual reflection on his saying that the one who hates him also hates his Father. The sunlight is a subtle visual reminder, not a depiction of the Father.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus helps a seated man rise in a sunlit village courtyard as some onlookers rejoice and others turn away with guarded expressions.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the works Jesus says he did among the people and the rejection he describes after they saw them. The verse does not identify a particular healing, and the scene does not portray the Father.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands peacefully in a sunlit stone courtyard as a group regards him with anger; a closed scroll rests on a stone nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the verse's account of hatred without cause and its relationship to the word written in their law. The courtyard, people and scroll are artistic details, not a depiction of a specified event.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to an attentive group in a sunlit stone courtyard as golden light streams from the sky across the scene.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses light as a visual metaphor for the promised Helper, the Spirit of truth, who comes from the Father and bears witness concerning Jesus. It does not depict the Spirit or the Father literally.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus walks with a group of disciples along a sunlit path through a hilly landscape; one disciple gestures outward as they talk together.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene suggests the disciples bearing witness and their shared journey with Jesus from the beginning, as described in John 15:27.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A gardener prunes a grape-bearing vine in a sunlit vineyard, with a removed fruitless branch lying on the ground.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative vineyard scene depicts the verse's contrast between a fruitless branch taken away and a fruit-bearing branch pruned so it may bear more fruit.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath a tree and speaks to four attentive disciples in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus speaking to his disciples; the warm light suggests the verse's image of their being already clean because of the word he has spoken to them.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus teaches a group beside a grapevine laden with fruit, while a dry detached branch lies on the ground.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating John 15:4: a branch bears fruit by remaining in the vine, a picture of abiding in Christ.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus teaches a group seated beside a grapevine laden with clusters of purple grapes. A detached branch with dry leaves and dark grapes lies on the ground.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates Jesus' comparison of himself to the vine and his hearers to the branches, and the fruitfulness of abiding in him.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two vineyard workers gather dry, detached branches and place them on a fire beside a living grapevine heavy with grapes.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative vineyard scene illustrates the verse's comparison of one who does not abide in Jesus to a branch that is thrown out, dries up, is gathered and burned.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with a group of listeners in a sunlit garden; one man sits near him with his hands open in a gesture of asking.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts listeners remaining close to Jesus and receiving his words, with an open-handed gesture suggesting the asking and promised response in John 15:7. The garden setting is an artistic choice.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus teaches four attentive disciples beneath a grapevine heavy with ripe fruit in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses abundant grapes and attentive disciples to evoke Jesus’ words about bearing much fruit, glorifying the Father, and being his disciples; it does not depict an event specified by the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits among attentive listeners in a sunlit garden, extending a welcoming hand as they gather close around him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative garden scene suggests Jesus' love for his listeners and his invitation to abide in that love, as the Father has loved him. The setting and gestures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus walks up a sunlit path toward a radiant sky while a group of followers watches from a rocky hillside.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects John 16:10's words about righteousness, Jesus going to the Father, and his followers no longer seeing him. The path and light are visual metaphors, not a literal depiction of the manner or setting of his departure.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A dark-robed ruler bows beside a fallen crown on a rocky hillside, overlooking a sunlit city and fields beneath breaking clouds.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative symbolic scene of a ruler whose fallen crown and bowed posture suggest the verse's statement that the ruler of this world has been judged; the landscape and figure are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks gently with open hands to a group of thoughtful disciples seated among warm stone walls, with hills and trees beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects John 16:12: Jesus has many things still to say, while his listeners cannot bear them now. The setting and gestures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A group of travelers listen to one another on a hillside path as luminous currents of air sweep toward a sunlit valley and distant horizon.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for John 16:13: the light and winding path suggest the Spirit of truth guiding the listeners, while the distant horizon evokes things yet to come.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed speaker sits beneath a tree among attentive listeners as golden light flows from him toward them, with hills and a village in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene uses light flowing from the speaker to the listeners to suggest the verse's promise that what is his will be disclosed to them, bringing him glory. The light and setting are artistic metaphors, not details stated in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures as he teaches an attentive group in a sunlit stone courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene uses shared sunlight as a metaphor for the verse's description of what belongs to the Father and the Son being taken and disclosed to the listeners. The courtyard and gathering are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to attentive disciples beneath a tree in a sunlit landscape, while a winding path passes a rocky hill toward distant light.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for John 16:16: the winding path suggests the little while when Jesus will no longer be seen and the little while after which he will be seen again. The setting is an artistic interpretation, not a detail specified in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Four disciples gesture and look thoughtfully toward Jesus as they sit beneath a tree near a distant village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the disciples discussing Jesus' words about seeing him again after a little while and his going to the Father, as described in John 16:17.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Five people in ancient clothing gather beneath a tree, exchanging puzzled looks and open-handed gestures in a sunlit village landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of people questioning what “a little while” means and admitting they do not understand what he is saying, as described in John 16:18.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures as he speaks to five attentive disciples in a sunlit stone courtyard beneath an olive tree.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus addressing the disciples as they wonder about his words that they would not see him for a little while and would then see him again. The setting and gestures are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to four attentive disciples seated among stones on a sunlit hillside, with a village and mountains in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus speaking to his listeners; the uneven stones suggest the verse's purpose that they might not fall away. The setting is an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A small group weeps and comforts one another beneath a tree, while people celebrate in the distance and sunlight breaks through the clouds.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects John 16:20: those addressed will weep and grieve while the world rejoices, and their grief will turn to joy. The sunlight suggests the promised joy.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling, weary mother cradles her swaddled newborn in a sunlit room while a caring woman sits beside her; a peaceful landscape is visible through the doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the joy after childbirth in John 16:21, when the arrival of a child into the world eclipses the memory of anguish.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus welcomes a joyful group of followers on a sunlit stone path beside an olive tree; one reaches toward him while another smiles through tears.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative reunion expresses the verse's movement from present grief to seeing again and a joy no one can take away; the setting and figures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with seated disciples in a sunlit courtyard; one disciple looks upward with open hands.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Jesus’ words about asking the Father in his name; the courtyard and gestures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks warmly to a group of disciples in a sunlit courtyard; one raises open hands as the others listen with joyful expressions.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Jesus' invitation to ask in his name and receive, so that their joy may be full.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with open hands to attentive disciples on a sunlit stone terrace, with mist receding among distant hills and a village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evokes Jesus' promise that an hour is coming when he will speak plainly about the Father rather than in allegories. The setting and visual metaphor are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus teaches a group of disciples in a sunlit stone courtyard; one disciple raises open hands in prayer.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene inspired by John 16:26: Jesus tells his followers that in that day they will ask in his name, and does not say he will implore the Father for them. The courtyard and gestures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with open hands to attentive followers gathered in a sunlit stone courtyard beneath leafy vines.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Jesus telling his followers that the Father loves them because they have loved him and believed that he came from God. The warm light suggests the Father’s love; the setting and gestures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus walks along a sunlit path away from an ancient village, looking toward the bright horizon over a valley.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses a journey toward light to suggest Jesus leaving the world and going to the Father, from whom he came; it is not a literal depiction of the event.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath a tree with his disciples as one speaks to him with open hands and the others listen.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the disciples telling Jesus that he is speaking openly and no longer using allegory, as described in John 16:29.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A group of distressed followers leave a stone synagogue as a man gestures them away. Nearby, a sword-bearing man looks upward.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects John 16:2's warning that the followers would be expelled from synagogues and that those who killed them would think they were offering service to God. The figures and setting are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath a tree with disciples gathered around him; one speaks with open hands while the others listen, with hills, water, and a village in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the disciples expressing their belief that Jesus knows all things and came from God, inspired by John 16:30 and its Berean Interlinear word glosses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits outdoors and speaks with an open hand to a group of attentive listeners beneath a tree.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus answering them with the question, ‘Now do you believe?’ The setting and expressions are artistic choices; the English glosses are from the Berean Interlinear.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands in warm evening light at a fork in a rocky path while disciples walk away in different directions toward a distant village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Jesus saying that his disciples would scatter and leave him, yet he is not alone because the Father is with him. The landscape and gentle light are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks gently to a group of disciples gathered in a sunlit clearing, while a rainstorm darkens the distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene uses the contrast between sunlight and a distant storm to suggest the peace, tribulation, courage, and overcoming of the world in John 16:33. The setting and weather are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with open hands to attentive disciples on a sunlit stone terrace, while several people turn away along a shadowed street and one raises a hand.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene suggesting the opposition Jesus describes and his words that those who do these things have not known the Father or him. The setting and gestures are artistic interpretation, not a depicted historical incident.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with an open hand to attentive disciples gathered on a stone terrace, beneath a darkening sky over a distant city.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus speaking with his disciples evokes his words in John 16:4: he tells them these things so that, when their hour comes, they may remember that he told them; he had not told them from the beginning because he was with them.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward a sunlit path while a small group of disciples sits nearby listening beneath a tree.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus telling his listeners that he is going to the One who sent him and that none of them asks where he is going, based on the verse and its Berean Interlinear word glosses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with open hands to four sorrowful disciples seated together in a lamplit courtyard at dusk.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects John 16:6: Jesus has spoken to his listeners, and sorrow has filled their heart. The setting and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to attentive disciples beneath a tree, gesturing toward a winding path as a luminous breeze crosses the sunlit hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evokes Jesus telling his disciples that his departure is for their benefit and that he will send the Helper to them. The path and breeze are visual symbols, not a literal account of the promised events.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Golden light falls on a gathering in an ancient town square as one man sets down a purse, another returns belongings to a seated woman, and a balance scale stands nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses light, a returned purse, an act of kindness, and a balance as visual metaphors for the verse's words about convicting the world concerning sin, righteousness, and judgment. The pictured events are not stated in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus extends an open hand toward a group of hesitant people in a sunlit stone courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene depicting people turning away or hesitating before Jesus, reflecting the verse’s words concerning sin and not believing in him. The pictured encounter is not presented as a recorded event.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits with open hands and looks upward in prayer as a small group gathers around him beneath a tree, in a golden sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene suggesting the shared belonging expressed in John 17:10 and Jesus being glorified in them. The setting, people, and golden light are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus looks upward in prayer as a close-knit group of followers gathers around him beneath a tree, with golden light over a distant village and hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Jesus' prayer that the Holy Father keep those remaining in the world in His name, so that they may be one; the setting and visible light are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands among a close group of followers beneath a tree at sunset, resting a hand on one man's shoulder as a lone figure walks away along a distant path.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes Jesus keeping and guarding those with him, with a solitary departing figure suggesting the verse's exception; the setting and gestures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath a tree, looking upward with open hands as four listeners gather around Him in a sunlit landscape with a distant village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests Jesus speaking to the Father while in the world and His desire that His joy be fulfilled within those for whom He speaks.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus prays beneath a tree among attentive followers while several people nearby turn away or watch with hostile expressions.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Jesus giving God's word to his followers and the world's hatred of them because they, like him, are not of the world.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits in prayer beneath a tree overlooking people walking through a sunlit village, while dark clouds gather over distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus praying for his followers to be kept from evil while they remain in the world, as expressed in John 17:15.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits with a small group of followers beneath an olive tree on a sunlit hillside, with a busy ancient town in the valley beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the shared relationship to the world described in John 17:16: Jesus and his followers are together in an earthly setting, yet are not of the world.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus prays beneath a tree as followers gather around a glowing, unlettered scroll, with sunlight over a distant landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses the glowing scroll and light as visual metaphors for the prayer to sanctify them by the truth and for God's word as truth.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus extends a hand toward followers walking down a sunlit hillside path toward a village, with fields, water and mountains beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects John 17:18's comparison between the sending of Jesus into the world and his sending of them into the world. The setting and depicted moment are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath an olive tree with one hand over his heart, looking upward as a group of listeners gathers around him in a sunlit garden.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus' dedication for his followers, reflecting his words that they also may be sanctified in truth. The setting and gestures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus kneels beneath a tree, looking upward with open hands as golden light shines through clouds above a distant town.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus lifting His eyes toward heaven and praying to the Father, asking that the Son be glorified so the Son may glorify the Father. The setting and visual details are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits praying beneath a tree while a disciple speaks to a circle of attentive listeners in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes Jesus asking not only for those with him, but also for people who believe in him through their word; the setting and gathering are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus looks upward in prayer among a diverse group gathered beneath a tree, while others approach from a village across a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus praying and people gathered in unity, suggesting his prayer that they may be one in the Father and the Son so that the world may believe the Father sent him.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus extends his hands toward a close circle of followers as warm golden light falls over them in a village courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene uses shared light and a gathered circle to suggest the glory Jesus has given and the unity described in John 17:22.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits closely with a group of followers beneath a sunlit tree, their arms around one another as other people watch nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of fellowship and shared light evokes Jesus' prayer that his followers be brought into unity, and that the world know the Father sent him and loved them as he loved him.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits among followers in a flowered landscape, looking upward with open hands as golden light radiates behind him; the followers look toward him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus' prayer that those the Father gave him would be with him and behold his glory. The radiant light suggests the Father's love before the foundation of the world.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus looks upward in prayer as a small group of listeners gathers around him on a sunlit hillside, with a town in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus addressing the righteous Father while those around him listen, reflecting John 17:25 and its contrast between the world not knowing the Father and these knowing that the Father sent Jesus.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath a tree with open hands, speaking to a small group of attentive followers in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes Jesus making the Father's name known and the love and presence he desires to be in his followers, as expressed in John 17:26.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands with open hands among a gathering of men, women, and children beneath a flourishing tree, with warm sunlight and a distant landscape behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests Jesus' authority and the gift of eternal life to those given to him, as described in John 17:2. The gathering and landscape are visual metaphors, not a depicted event stated in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath a leafy tree among attentive adults and children, gesturing toward the bright sky in a flower-filled landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting John 17:3: eternal life is knowing the only true God and Jesus Christ, whom God sent. The gathering and setting are visual interpretation, not events specified by this verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands on a rocky hillside with open hands and looks toward sunlight breaking through clouds above a broad valley.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects John 17:4: Jesus speaks of glorifying the one addressed on earth and completing the work given to him. The hillside and landscape are artistic choices, not details specified in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus kneels on a rocky hillside with his hands raised in prayer toward radiant golden light, beneath a deep blue sky.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus praying to the Father, with radiant light suggesting the glory he had with the Father before the world existed.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus kneels in prayer among attentive disciples beneath trees, with a sunlit village and hills beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Jesus' prayer that he revealed the Father's name to the people the Father gave him, and that they have kept the Father's word; the setting and gestures are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath a tree with open hands and looks toward sunlight in the sky as a small group of followers listens nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflects the verse's statement that they have come to know that all Jesus has been given is from the one he addresses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with open hands to disciples gathered beneath a tree, overlooking a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the words Jesus gave his followers and their receptive trust, reflecting John 17:8 without claiming to depict the historical setting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus kneels with clasped hands and looks upward in prayer while five disciples sit nearby beneath an olive tree, with a sunlit village and hills in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus praying for those the Father has given him, reflecting John 17:9 rather than depicting a specified historical setting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man holding a drawn sword looks toward another man who recoils and holds the right side of his head, with torchbearers behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of John 18:10, in which Simon Peter draws a sword and cuts off the right ear of Malchus, the high priest's servant. The setting and appearances are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures calmly toward Peter, who lowers a sword into its sheath beneath olive trees at night, while torchbearers stand in the background.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus telling Peter to put the sword into its sheath and speaking of the cup the Father has given him to drink, in John 18:11.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands among soldiers and officers in a lantern-lit outdoor setting as a soldier binds his wrists with rope; a commander watches nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 18:12, in which the cohort, commander and officers of the Jews take hold of Jesus and bind him. The setting and visual details are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus, his hands bound, is escorted by several men toward an older man standing in the illuminated doorway of a stone residence.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus being led first to Annas, whom the verse identifies as the father-in-law of Caiaphas, the high priest that year. The setting and visual details are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Caiaphas gestures as he addresses a group of listeners in a sunlit stone courtyard; a solitary man stands near a gathering of people beyond them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Caiaphas giving the counsel recalled in John 18:14, that it was profitable for one man to perish for the people. The courtyard and figures illustrate the idea and are not details specified by the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a warm, torchlit stone courtyard, Jesus walks near an open gate with another disciple close behind; Simon Peter follows farther back, while a guard stands by the doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 18:15: Simon Peter and another disciple follow Jesus, and the disciple known to the high priest enters the high priest’s courtyard with Jesus. The setting and appearances are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At a warmly lit stone doorway, the other disciple gestures toward the entrance as Peter approaches from outside and a woman doorkeeper holds the door.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 18:16: Peter stands outside, the other disciple speaks to the doorkeeper and brings him in. The figures and setting are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At a stone doorway, a young woman holding a torch looks questioningly toward Peter, who raises his hands and looks uneasy; figures gather in a courtyard behind him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the doorkeeper questioning Peter about being a disciple and his denial in John 18:17. The setting, gestures, and other visual details are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Men in robes and a helmeted officer gather around glowing coals in a stone courtyard, warming their hands in the cold; a central figure stands among them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 18:18: servants and officers warm themselves at a coal fire in the cold, and Peter stands with them warming himself. The setting and appearances are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a warmly lit stone room, a richly robed high priest gestures toward Jesus, who stands calmly facing him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 18:19, where the high priest questions Jesus about his disciples and his teaching; the setting and visual details are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus leads his disciples past a rocky stream toward an opening in a flowering garden, under a moonlit sky.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus and his disciples entering a garden beyond the Kidron winter stream in John 18:1; the appearance of the place and people is imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits on stone steps and teaches a gathered group in a sunlit temple courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus teaching publicly in the temple, reflecting his answer that he spoke openly and taught where people gathered.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward a group of listeners while speaking to a questioning man in a warmly lit stone room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 18:21: Jesus directs the questioner to ask those who heard what he said. The setting and the hearers' presence are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a stone hall, an armored officer strikes Jesus on the cheek with an open hand as a seated high priest and others look on.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 18:22, where an officer standing by strikes Jesus with his palm and challenges how he answered the high priest. The setting, clothing, and figures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with open hands to a stern man whose hand is lowered, in a warmly lit stone interior; an armed figure stands in the background.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus answering the man and asking him to testify if Jesus spoke wrongly, or explain why he strikes him if he spoke rightly. The setting and appearances are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus, his wrists bound, is escorted across a stone courtyard as Annas gestures behind him and Caiaphas waits at a doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Annas sending Jesus bound to Caiaphas the high priest. The setting, figures, and details of the journey are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Peter stands by a glowing fire in a stone courtyard, warming one hand and raising the other as several people question him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 18:25: Simon Peter warms himself, is asked whether he is one of Jesus’ disciples, and denies it. The courtyard and visual details are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a firelit stone courtyard, a bearded servant gestures as he questions a second bearded man, Peter, who looks back anxiously; trees rise against the night sky.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the high priest's servant questioning Peter about having seen him in the garden with Jesus, as described in John 18:26. The setting and appearances are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Peter raises his hands toward a man in a stone courtyard as a rooster crows nearby in the early light.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of John 18:27, where Peter denies again and a rooster immediately crows. The courtyard and surrounding details are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At dawn, Jesus is led toward the stone entrance of the praetorium while a group of men remains outside, watching from the street.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of John 18:28: Jesus is led from Caiaphas to the praetorium early in the morning, while those who brought him stay outside so they may eat the Passover without being defiled. The setting and visual details are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Pilate steps outside a stone building and gestures toward a group of men listening on the steps, with guards behind him and a sunlit city in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Pilate going outside and asking what accusation the people bring against the man in John 18:29. The setting, clothing, and gestures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits with disciples beneath a broad tree in a sunlit landscape, while Judas stands apart and looks back toward the gathering.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the place Judas knew because Jesus often gathered there with His disciples; the setting and poses are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a group of robed men gesture toward a seated official as a quiet man stands between them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the exchange in John 18:30: the speakers say they would not have delivered the man if he were not doing evil. The scene illustrates their accusation without presenting it as fact.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Pilate gestures toward a group of Jewish men in a sunlit stone courtyard while a calm man stands nearby and one of the men responds with open hands.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of the exchange in John 18:31: Pilate tells them to judge the man according to their law, and they say they are not permitted to put anyone to death.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to attentive listeners beneath a tree in a sunlit landscape, with an empty wooden cross on a distant hill.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus speaking and a distant cross foreshadowing his death. John 18:32 speaks of the fulfillment of his words signifying the kind of death he was about to die; it does not describe this gathering.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Pilate, seated in a sunlit Roman hall, gestures toward Jesus as two soldiers stand nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 18:33, when Pilate calls Jesus in the praetorium and asks whether he is the King of the Jews. The setting and visual details are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits with open hands, speaking to a thoughtful man in red across a sunlit stone room; a guard stands in the background.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus asking whether the man speaks from himself or from what others told him concerning Jesus. The setting, clothing, and other figures are artistic choices; the English token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Pilate gestures toward Jesus as he questions him in a sunlit stone setting, while a Roman guard and chief priests stand behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Pilate questioning Jesus after saying that Jesus’ own nation and the chief priests delivered him to Pilate, as described in John 18:35. The setting and appearances are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with open hands to a seated official in a sunlit stone courtyard, while two guards stand quietly nearby and a landscape appears through an arch.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Jesus' answer that his kingdom is not from this world and that his attendants would otherwise fight to prevent his being handed over. The courtyard, listeners, and distant landscape are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with open hands to a seated Pilate, who listens thoughtfully in a sunlit Roman chamber, with guards nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus answering Pilate's question about kingship and speaking of his witness to the truth and those who hear his voice in John 18:37. The setting and poses are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Pilate gestures toward a group outside a stone residence while Jesus stands inside behind him, in a warm watercolor illustration.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Pilate going out to the Jewish people and saying he finds no guilt in Jesus, after asking Him what truth is. The setting and figures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A Roman official gestures toward Jesus as a guard stands nearby and a gathered crowd listens in a sunlit stone courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the question in John 18:39 about the Passover custom of releasing one person and whether the people wish the King of the Jews to be released.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed Judas leads a group of soldiers and officers along a rocky path at night, with glowing lanterns, flaming torches, and spears lighting the trees around them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 18:3: Judas comes with a cohort and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, carrying lanterns, torches, and weapons. The landscape and appearances are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a crowd cries out and points toward a guarded, chained man, while a calm robed Jesus stands apart.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of John 18:40: the crowd cries out for Barabbas rather than the other man, and the verse identifies Barabbas as an insurrectionist. The setting, appearances and arrangement are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus steps forward and gestures toward a group of men beneath trees at dusk, with torches lighting the scene.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus going forth and asking whom they seek, knowing what was coming upon Him. The setting and visual details are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures calmly toward a group of men standing beneath trees by lantern and torchlight, with a man in a golden shawl among them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of John 18:5: the group answers Jesus and he replies; Judas, who is delivering him up, stands with them. The setting, clothing, expressions and lighting are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands with one hand extended as a group of men recoil and fall to the ground among trees, stones, and torchlight.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 18:6: when he says “I am,” those addressed draw back and fall to the ground. The setting and visual details are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man in a light robe gestures toward a group of men, one of whom answers him, in a torchlit landscape at night.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative rendering of the exchange in John 18:7, where he asks again whom they seek and they answer Jesus of Nazareth. The setting and visual details are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward his companions as he faces a group of men carrying torches, while the companions move along a path behind him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene inspired by John 18:8: Jesus identifies himself to those seeking him and asks that the others be allowed to go away. The setting, appearances and gestures are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands with his arms around a close gathering of followers beneath a tree, with a sunlit landscape and village beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jesus keeping those given to him together, reflecting the verse’s account of his fulfilled word that he lost not one of them.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Pilate, seated in Roman attire, gestures toward a quiet Jesus in a sunlit stone hall, with Roman guards in the background.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of John 19:10, where Pilate questions Jesus and asserts his authority to release or crucify him.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures as he speaks to a seated authority figure in a sunlit stone hall, while a guard stands nearby and distant figures appear in the doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus answering about authority given from above and the greater sin of the one who delivered him up; the light and setting are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Pilate gestures with an open hand as Jesus stands beside him and a group calls out from the courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 19:12: Pilate seeks to release Jesus while people cry out against releasing him, appealing to loyalty to Caesar.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands in a stone-paved courtyard before Pilate, who is seated on a raised judgment seat, with Roman guards and a crowd nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of John 19:13, showing Jesus brought outside and Pilate seated at the judgment seat at the Stone Pavement, called Gabbatha. The setting and visual details are the artist’s interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A Roman governor gestures toward Jesus, whose hands are bound, as people gather below in a sunlit stone courtyard, with soldiers and Jerusalem behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the moment in John 19:14 when, on the Day of Preparation of the Passover at about the sixth hour, the speaker presents the king to the Jewish people. The setting, figures, and visual details are the artist's interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Pilate gestures toward chief priests and a crowd in a sunlit stone courtyard, while Jesus stands quietly beside him and Roman guards watch.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 19:15: the crowd calls for Jesus to be taken away and crucified, Pilate asks about crucifying their king, and the chief priests answer that they have no king except Caesar. The setting and appearances are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus, with his hands bound, is led by guards in a sunlit stone courtyard as an official gestures toward them.
