records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering illustrates John 7:50: Nicodemus speaks to the group as one of them; the verse also recalls that he had previously come to Him. The room, clothing, and expressions are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A standing man speaks with open hands to four seated men in a sunlit stone chamber; an older listener gestures toward him while the others listen.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined hearing illustrates the verse's question about judging a man before hearing him and knowing what he does. The figures and setting are artistic inventions.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone chamber, a robed man points to a blank scroll and gestures toward a listener while three other men look on.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative setting for John 7:52, in which speakers ask a man whether he is also from Galilee and tell him to search concerning their claim that no prophet arises from Galilee. The setting, scroll and gestures are artistic additions.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Four men walk along separate stone paths toward homes in a sunlit village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The supplied Berean Interlinear glosses describe each person going home; the village, people, and paths are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, Jesus in a white robe and reddish mantle gestures gently while four men in earth-toned robes look on with reserved, questioning expressions.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined encounter illustrates John 7:5, which says that even His brothers did not believe in Him. The courtyard, appearances, expressions, and poses are artistic choices. The English word glosses used for the scene are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits and gestures as four men listen in a sunlit stone courtyard; several carry walking staffs and travel bags.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined encounter illustrates Jesus saying that his own time has not yet come, while their time is always ready. The source excerpt's English token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits speaking to a group in a sunlit village square while three onlookers frown. In the background, a bread seller turns away a man reaching toward the loaves.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for John 7:7, informed by the Berean Interlinear glosses: the disapproving onlookers and withheld bread evoke the world's hostility toward Jesus as he bears witness that its works are evil. The place and particular act are illustrative, not details stated in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed man pauses beneath a tree and gestures to four traveling companions, who turn toward him on a rocky path leading uphill to a distant gathering.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imagined moment inspired by John 7:8: the speaker sends others to the feast while he remains, saying that his time has not yet been fulfilled. The setting and figures are an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath an olive tree with four men nearby, overlooking a sunlit village, fields, distant hills, and water.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jesus remaining in Galilee after speaking to them. The landscape, setting, and figures' poses are artistic choices, not details specified by the verse. The English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands facing a woman in a sunlit stone courtyard, extending one hand as she looks toward him. No one else is visible.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 8:10: Jesus looks up, sees only the woman, and asks where her accusers are and whether anyone has condemned her. The courtyard, clothing, and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, Jesus sits and extends an open hand toward a woman seated on the ground; they look at one another, with an open archway and path behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 8:11: the woman answers, “No one, Sir,” and Jesus tells her that he does not condemn her and to go and sin no more. The courtyard, gestures, and expressions are artistic choices. The English word glosses in the source excerpt are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus turns to speak to a group of followers on a stone path, with shaded rocks behind them and warm golden light, greenery, and a distant village ahead.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene shows Jesus speaking and people following him from shadow into light, reflecting his words that he is the light of the world and that the one who follows him will have the light of life. The path and landscape are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands calmly in a sunlit stone courtyard while one of four Pharisees speaks with an open-handed gesture and the others look on.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the Pharisees telling Jesus that he bears witness about himself and that his testimony is not true. The courtyard, appearances, and gestures are imagined; the accusation is theirs.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath a leafy tree with one hand to his chest, speaking to several listeners; a winding road leads toward distant hills and a village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined conversation and road evoke John 8:14, where Jesus says his testimony about himself is true because he knows where he came from and where he is going, while his listeners do not. The setting and road are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, Jesus sits with open hands beside a man in a patched cloak while two men watch from the side.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting the verse's contrast between judging according to the flesh and Jesus judging no one; the setting, people, and gestures are artistic additions.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus in a cream robe and rust-red cloak speaks with an outstretched hand to listeners in a sunlit stone courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses a beam of light to suggest the presence of the one who sent Jesus. John 8:16 says that his judgment is true because he is not alone; the courtyard, listeners, and light are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men gesture as they speak to a seated elder across a low table with a blank scroll, in a sunlit stone courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined hearing evokes the verse's statement that the testimony of two men is true as written in the law. The people and setting are artistic additions, not a reconstruction of a recorded event.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits in a sunlit stone courtyard, one hand on his chest and the other extended as attentive listeners gather around him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Jesus bearing witness about himself and the Father who sent him also bearing witness about him. The warm light is a visual symbol of the Father's witness, not a claim that light visibly appeared. The scene follows the supplied Greek verse and its Berean Interlinear token glosses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, Jesus speaks with one hand on his chest and the other extended while four listeners watch, one gesturing toward him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative rendering of John 8:19: people ask where Jesus' Father is, and Jesus replies that they know neither him nor his Father; if they had known him, they would also have known his Father. The courtyard, appearances, and gestures are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus walks up a rocky path toward a hillside of olive trees, with a distant town and hills in warm sunlight.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 8:1, which says Jesus went to the Mount of Olives. The path, landscape, clothing, sunlight, and distant town are artistic details. The excerpt's English token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits among listeners and teaches beside offering chests in a sunlit temple court with stone columns.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jesus teaching in the temple treasury while no one seizes him; John 8:20 says that his hour had not yet come.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to a group of listeners in a sunlit stone courtyard, gesturing toward a road winding into the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene reflects Jesus speaking of going away, his hearers seeking him, their dying in sin, and their inability to come where he goes. The courtyard, the road and the gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a group of men in ancient clothing exchange questioning looks and gestures while a robed teacher stands apart.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imagined portrayal of the Jewish listeners in John 8:22 wondering whether the speaker would kill himself because he said they could not come where he was going. The conversation, courtyard and gestures are artistic imagination; the image does not depict an act or establish his intention.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward a bright sky while six listeners gather around him on a rocky path, with a tree, water, and distant buildings in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene uses Jesus' gesture toward the sky and the listeners' place on the earth to evoke his contrast in John 8:23: they are from below and of this world, while he is from above and not of this world. The contrast follows the excerpt's Berean Interlinear glosses; the setting and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits on stone steps in a sunlit courtyard, touching his chest and extending an open hand as a group of men and women listen thoughtfully.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Jesus speaking the warning in John 8:24: those who do not believe that he is [He] will die in their sins. The courtyard and the listeners' poses are artistic choices. The wording follows the excerpt's Berean Interlinear glosses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits speaking with an open hand in a sunlit stone courtyard as a man gestures toward him and other men listen.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for John 8:25: people ask Jesus who he is, and he replies to them. The setting, appearances, and gestures are artistic interpretations based on the supplied Greek text and Berean Interlinear word glosses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits in a sunlit stone courtyard and gestures as he speaks to a group of attentive listeners; a town and hills are visible through an archway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus addressing listeners evokes John 8:26, in which he speaks of having much to say and judge concerning them and of speaking to the world what he heard from the true One who sent him. The courtyard and listeners are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed speaker raises an open hand while addressing listeners seated in a sunny stone courtyard; several look puzzled or thoughtful.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a speaker addressing listeners who did not understand that he was speaking to them about the Father. The setting and gestures are artistic inventions, based on the excerpt's Berean Interlinear word glosses for John 8:27.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus in a cream robe and rust-red mantle speaks with open hands to attentive listeners in a sunlit stone courtyard. A cross-shaped shadow falls across the paving.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jesus speaking to his listeners in John 8:28. The cross-shaped shadow suggests the future lifting up he describes; it is an artistic interpretation, not a detail stated in the verse. The attentive listeners evoke his words that they will come to know, and his gesture suggests his speaking what the Father taught him.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A watercolor illustration of Jesus seated in a sunlit stone courtyard, speaking with open hands to a group of listeners.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene of Jesus teaching in warm light evokes his words that the One who sent him is with him and has not left him alone, and that he always does what pleases him. The verse does not specify this courtyard or these listeners.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In warm morning light, Jesus sits on stone steps in a temple courtyard and gestures as people gather to listen, while others approach.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 8:2: early in the morning he comes again to the temple, the people come to him, and he sits and teaches them. The courtyard, clothing, and arrangement of the people are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus, seated in a sunlit stone courtyard, speaks with open hands to a gathered crowd of attentive men, women, and children.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes John 8:30: as Jesus speaks, many believe in him. The courtyard, appearances, and gestures are artistic choices. The English word glosses used for the scene come from the Berean Interlinear.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures while teaching an attentive group seated together in a sunlit stone courtyard beneath leafy vines.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined teaching scene illustrates Jesus speaking to Jews who had believed in him about abiding in his word and truly being his disciples. The courtyard, appearances, and arrangement are imagined. The verse relationship follows the supplied Berean Interlinear token glosses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A group of people in ancient clothing walk toward an open stone gateway in golden light, smiling as broken chains fall around them. Hills and a village lie beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses illuminating light to suggest the truth being known, and broken chains and an open gateway to suggest the freedom the truth brings. The verse does not describe a literal imprisonment.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus listens as four men gather beneath an olive tree in a sunlit stone courtyard; one man holds out both hands as he speaks.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the reply in John 8:33: the speakers call themselves Abraham's offspring, say they have never been in bondage to anyone, and ask how they will become free. The setting and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to listeners in a sunlit stone courtyard. A thoughtful man in the foreground wears wrist shackles, with his chain tangled among thorny vines.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates Jesus' words in John 8:34: the chain and thorns symbolize the bondage to sin described in the verse, rather than an event stated in the text.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man carrying a bundle walks away from a stone house and looks back toward a younger man standing in its sunlit doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined household scene illustrates John 8:35's contrast between the slave, who does not abide in the house for the age, and the son, who abides for the age. The depicted departure is an artistic imagining.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus loosens a chain at a man's wrist as they and a small group walk through an open stone gateway into sunlit countryside.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses the loosening chain and open gateway as a visual metaphor for the Son setting people free, as described in John 8:36. The verse does not describe a literal gate or chain.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath an olive tree in a sunlit stone courtyard, gesturing toward a group of stern listeners; one man holds a stone at his side.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of Jesus addressing Abraham's descendants as they resist his word and seek to kill him. The courtyard, olive tree, and stone are artistic details not specified in this verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits in a sunlit stone courtyard and speaks with an open hand to a group of listeners; two men confer quietly and another turns away, with trees and distant buildings behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene suggests the contrast in John 8:38 between what Jesus has seen with the Father and speaks, and what his listeners have heard from the father and do. The courtyard, gestures, and figures' actions are illustrative, not a claim about the historical setting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath an olive tree in a sunlit stone courtyard, extending a hand toward a group of listeners. One man stands with both hands against his chest while the others listen.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 8:39, based on the supplied Greek verse and Berean Interlinear glosses: people say Abraham is their father, and Jesus says that if they were Abraham's children they would do Abraham's works. The setting, gestures, and olive tree are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a woman in a blue robe stands among robed men who bring her before a seated man, while others watch.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates John 8:3, in which the scribes and Pharisees bring to him a woman caught in adultery and set her in the midst. The setting, appearances, and gestures are imagined. The supplied English token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures with open hands as he speaks to stern listeners in a sunlit stone courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined exchange illustrates John 8:40: Jesus says they seek to kill him although he has spoken truth he heard from God, and that Abraham did not do this. The setting and appearances are imaginative.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed man addresses a group in a sunlit stone courtyard. One listener holds a hand to his chest and raises the other toward the sky.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This is an imagined scene of the exchange in John 8:41: the speaker says that they are doing the works of their father, and they respond that they were not born of sexual immorality and have one Father, God. The setting and gestures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits in a sunlit stone courtyard, gesturing upward as a group of listeners gathers around him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene relates to Jesus telling his listeners that if God were their Father they would love him, and that he came from God and was sent by him.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated teacher in a sunlit stone courtyard gestures with open hands toward five listeners, who look thoughtful or puzzled.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the speaker asking why his speech is not understood and saying that his listeners are unable to hear his word. The courtyard, gestures, and expressions are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A teacher speaks to listeners in a sunlit stone courtyard while a dark, reaching figure rises behind a cracked mask, a smoking oil lamp, and a broken blade.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of the verse’s warning: the shadow and objects suggest the devil’s murderous nature, falsehood, and absence of truth. The scene is not a historical reconstruction.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Watercolor of Jesus seated in a sunlit stone courtyard, speaking with open hands to a group of listeners. One man turns away with folded arms while others look doubtful.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined encounter reflects John 8:45: Jesus says that because he speaks the truth, his listeners do not believe him. The courtyard and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands in a sunlit stone courtyard with his hands open, addressing a group of men whose expressions are thoughtful and questioning.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates Jesus asking who can convict him concerning sin and why his hearers do not believe him if he speaks the truth.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a seated teacher gestures as one listener looks up attentively while others look away or appear preoccupied.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering evokes the contrast in John 8:47 between hearing God's words and not hearing them, which the verse relates to being of God.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands calmly in a sunlit stone courtyard while a man gestures toward him and several other men look on.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This is an imaginative portrayal of John 8:48, in which the speakers question Jesus and accuse him of being a Samaritan and having a demon. Their accusation is represented through gesture, not presented as fact.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, Jesus gestures upward while answering several men who watch with doubtful expressions.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative interpretation of John 8:49: Jesus denies having a demon, says he honors his Father, and tells his listeners they dishonor him. The setting and gestures are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a group of robed men speak and gesture toward a woman as a seated teacher listens.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 8:4, in which the speakers tell the Teacher that the woman was caught in the act of adultery. The setting, figures, and gestures are imagined from the Nestle 1904 text and Berean Interlinear glosses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits in a sunlit stone courtyard, one hand near his heart and the other raised toward the light, while a group of listeners watches.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imagined scene reflects Jesus' words that he does not seek his own glory and that there is One who seeks it and judges. The courtyard, listeners and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures while speaking to a seated listener who holds a hand over his heart beneath an olive tree; a sunlit path winds through the hills toward the horizon.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene shows Jesus speaking to a listener who holds his words close. The living olive tree and path toward the light evoke his promise that whoever keeps his word will never see death. The setting, gestures and landscape are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, Jesus listens as four men in ancient robes address him with questioning gestures; an olive branch and a hilly landscape appear behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the exchange in John 8:52. The speakers accuse Jesus and refer to the deaths of Abraham and the prophets while repeating his words about keeping his word and never tasting death. The courtyard, landscape and olive branch are artistic additions; the accusation is theirs.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits facing three men in a sunlit landscape. One man extends a hand as if asking a question, while two others listen; unmarked rock-cut tomb openings appear on the distant hillside.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined conversation evokes John 8:53, where Jesus is asked whether he is greater than Abraham, who died, and the prophets, who also died, and whom he makes himself. The distant tombs are a visual reminder of death, not identified burial sites or a claim about the actual setting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits in a sunlit stone courtyard, speaking with open hands to a small group of attentive listeners as golden light falls from above.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jesus answering that self-glorification is nothing and that his Father glorifies him, the one his listeners call their God. The courtyard and light are artistic interpretations, not details stated in the verse. English token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits among listeners in a sunlit stone courtyard, one hand on his chest and the other raised, with a closed scroll on his lap.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests Jesus' words about knowing God, speaking truthfully, and keeping God's word. The courtyard, gestures, and scroll are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Abraham stands with his arms open on a rocky hillside, smiling toward a golden sunrise over distant hills and a village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative sunrise evokes the day Jesus says Abraham rejoiced to see; the verse does not describe a sunrise or specify how Abraham saw it.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Four men in a sunlit stone courtyard question Jesus, who listens calmly as one of them gestures with open hands.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the question in John 8:57: how could Jesus, who was not yet fifty, have seen Abraham? The setting, appearances, and gestures are artistic additions. The word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits on a stone step and gestures as five listeners gather around him beneath a star-filled sky, with a distant town and hills beyond them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene shows Jesus speaking to listeners as he says that before Abraham was, he is. The starry sky is a visual suggestion of the span of time, not a detail stated in the verse. The wording follows the excerpt's Berean Interlinear word glosses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus slips behind a stone column toward the temple gateway while people in the courtyard raise stones.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 8:59: people take up stones to throw at Jesus, who hides and leaves the temple. The column, gateway, and gestures are artistic details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a robed man holding a rolled scroll gestures toward a seated teacher while other men and a worried woman stand nearby; stones lie on the ground.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects the question in John 8:5, where the speakers invoke Moses' command concerning stoning and ask what the person addressed says. The people, poses, courtyard, scroll, and stones are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus crouches and traces marks in dusty ground with his finger while four men stand nearby, watching and gesturing beneath a tree beside stone buildings.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 8:6: while others speak to test Jesus and seek grounds to accuse him, he bends down and writes on the ground with his finger. The setting, appearance, and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, Jesus addresses a group of men while a woman stands nearby and one man holds a stone at his side.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 8:7: after being persistently questioned, Jesus answers that the one without sin should cast the first stone at her. The setting, clothing, and gestures are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stoops and traces marks in the dusty ground with his finger, with a sunlit stone courtyard and trees behind him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts John 8:8, where he stoops down again and continues writing on the ground. His appearance, the use of a finger, the marks, and the setting are imagined; the verse does not say what he wrote.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus and a woman stand together in a sunlit stone courtyard as several people walk away toward a gate, with an older man farthest along.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 8:9: after hearing, the people depart one by one, beginning with the older ones, leaving Jesus and the woman standing in the midst. The setting, clothing and expressions are imagined. The scene follows the supplied Greek excerpt and its Berean Interlinear token glosses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated man looks up at five surprised people gathered around him on a sunlit stone street. A woman points to her eyes while others gesture toward him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 9:10, in which people ask a man how his eyes were opened. The setting, appearance, and gestures are artistic choices. The supplied English token glosses come from the Berean Interlinear.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man kneels beside a sunlit stone pool with open eyes, water dripping from his hands and face as he looks upward in wonder.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the man at Siloam immediately after washing and receiving sight, one moment from the account he gives in John 9:11.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man in a sunlit stone village lane opens both hands in uncertainty while three nearby men question him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the question and the man’s reply that he does not know where the person is; the person being sought is not shown.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Several men bring a man with open eyes toward a group of Pharisees in a sunlit stone courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of people bringing the man who was formerly blind to the Pharisees in John 9:13; the setting, clothing and gestures are imagined. The English token glosses in the supplied excerpt come from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus holds a small lump of clay while a man with open eyes looks up at him in a sunlit stone courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the Sabbath day on which Jesus made clay and opened the man's eyes; the setting and poses are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a smiling man gestures toward his face as four robed men listen; a basin of water and a bowl of clay are nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative rendering of John 9:15: the Pharisees ask how the man received sight, and he recounts that clay was put on his eyes, he washed, and he can see. The courtyard, basin, and arrangement are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Robed men in a sunlit stone courtyard debate, some gesturing while others listen with questioning expressions.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imagined courtyard discussion expresses the division in John 9:16: some question the man's Sabbath observance while others ask how a sinful man could perform such signs. The setting, expressions, and gestures are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated man with open eyes gestures as he speaks to four men gathered around him in a sunlit stone courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the exchange in John 9:17: the man whose eyes were opened answers those questioning him about the one who opened them, saying he is a prophet. The setting, clothing, and appearances are artistic choices. The verse relationship follows the excerpt's Berean Interlinear word glosses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A young man stands beside an older man and a woman in a sunlit stone courtyard, while a seated man gestures toward them and two others look on.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined courtyard scene evokes John 9:18, in which people who doubted that the man had been blind and had received sight call his parents. The setting, figures, and poses are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man gestures toward a couple as other men watch, while a young man nearby looks upward.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene inspired by John 9:19, in which questioners ask whether a man is the couple's son, whom they say was born blind, and how he now sees. The setting, appearances, and gestures are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus walks along a sunlit stone street and looks toward a man seated beside a wall, his eyes closed and a walking stick resting across his lap.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 9:1, in which Jesus sees a man blind from birth while passing by. The setting, appearance, and walking stick are artistic choices. The English word glosses come from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A mother and father gesture toward their son while speaking in a sunny stone courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of John 9:20, in which the parents say they know he is their son and that he was born blind. The setting and appearances are imagined, and the image does not establish his present eyesight.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a woman and an older man gesture toward an adult man with open eyes as other people listen.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative interpretation of John 9:21: the speakers say they do not know how the man now sees or who opened his eyes, and direct others to ask him, since he is of age and will speak for himself. The setting and gestures are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An anxious couple speaks with three men beside the open doorway of a sunlit stone building, while one man gestures outward.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evoking the parents' fear in John 9:22 and the agreed consequence of exclusion from the synagogue for anyone who confessed Him as Christ. The setting and interaction are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a mother and father gesture as they address robed listeners, while their adult son stands beside them with his hands clasped.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene illustrates John 9:23, where the parents say their son is of age and tell the listeners to ask him. The courtyard, gestures, and appearances are artistic inventions.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a seated man listens to three robed men, one raising a hand toward the sky as another gestures during the conversation.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene shows the man who had been blind after he is called back. The others urge him to give glory to God and call another man a sinner. The courtyard, clothing, and gestures are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man with bright, open eyes speaks with open hands to two listeners in a sunlit stone courtyard, with vines and an archway behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the speaker's answer in John 9:25: he does not know whether the other person is a sinner, but he knows that he was blind and now sees.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated man holds one hand near his eye while four robed men gesture toward him in a sunlit stone courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 9:26, in which people ask what was done to a man and how his eyes were opened. The setting and gestures are imagined. The supplied English token glosses come from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated man in a cream tunic gestures toward a group of listeners in a sunlit stone courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imagined setting for the speaker's response in John 9:27: he says he already told them, asks why they want to hear again, and asks whether they also want to become his disciples.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, four robed men confront another man; one points at him while another gestures toward himself and holds a closed scroll.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene illustrates John 9:28, where a group rebukes a man and contrasts his discipleship with their claim to be disciples of Moses. The courtyard, gestures, and scroll are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a robed group discusses a blank parchment while one person gestures toward a man standing near an archway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects the speakers' statement that God has spoken to Moses and that they do not know where the man is from. The courtyard, parchment, and gestures are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: On a sunlit stone street, several disciples gesture as they question Jesus, while a seated man holds a walking staff beside them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the disciples asking Jesus whether the man born blind or his parents sinned. It depicts their question without presenting an answer, following the supplied Berean Interlinear word glosses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures toward his face while speaking to three thoughtful listeners in a sunlit stone courtyard, painted in warm watercolor.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene represents the man's reply in John 9:30: he marvels that his listeners do not know where the one who opened his eyes is from. The setting and expressions are imaginative. The source excerpt's English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A kneeling man looks upward while pouring water into another man's bowl. Behind them, a merchant raises one hand while tending a balance at a fruit stall.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates John 9:31's contrast: God does not hear sinners, but hears the one who fears Him and does His will. The praying person sharing water is an artistic example; the verse does not describe these particular people or actions.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures toward his eyes and looks upward with wonder while four listeners gather around him in a sunlit stone courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects John 9:32's account of the unheard-of opening of the eyes of someone born blind. The courtyard, listeners, and their gestures are artistic additions.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man in cream robes helps a kneeling man to stand while a bearded speaker gestures and others watch.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses an act of help as a visual metaphor for John 9:33, which says that if this man were not from God, he could do nothing. The verse does not describe this particular action or setting. The English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed man with a walking stick looks back as he steps through a stone doorway into daylight, while several men inside gesture sternly after him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 9:34: a group rebukes a man, challenges him for teaching them, and casts him out. The setting, appearances, and gestures are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus leans toward a seated man beside a closed wooden door, gesturing as the man listens in a sunlit stone courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jesus finding the man after hearing that he was cast out and asking whether he believes in the Son of Man. The courtyard and poses are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated man gestures with open hands toward another man listening in a sunlit stone courtyard, surrounded by trees, vines, and clay vessels.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This scene imaginatively portrays a man asking the Lord to identify the one in whom he may believe, as expressed in the supplied Berean Interlinear glosses. The setting and the figures' appearances are artistic choices.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward himself as he speaks with a seated man in a sunlit stone courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative setting for John 9:37: Jesus tells the man he has seen him and that the one speaking with him is the same person.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man kneels with open hands before Jesus in a warm sunlit stone courtyard, looking toward him with trust and reverence.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the man confessing belief and worshiping Jesus in John 9:38. The courtyard, clothing and appearances are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits on a stone wall and speaks with open hands to listeners on a sunlit village path. One man looks up at him attentively, while another sits in shadow with folded arms and looks away.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses the listeners' contrasting postures and the play of light and shadow to reflect Jesus' words about judgment and the reversal of sight: those not seeing may see, and those seeing may become blind. The setting and individual responses are visual interpretation rather than details specified by the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures while seated beside a man in a green scarf, as three listeners gather on sunlit stone steps in a village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This scene imaginatively portrays Jesus' answer in John 9:3: neither the man nor his parents sinned, and the works of God should be revealed in him. The setting, listeners, gestures and sunlight are artistic choices, not details specified in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, four robed Pharisees face Jesus; one gestures toward himself while the others listen.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of John 9:40: Pharisees who are with Jesus hear these things and ask whether they too are blind. The courtyard and gestures are artistic choices. The English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits speaking to four men in a sunlit stone courtyard; one gestures toward his eyes while the others watch.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined conversation illustrates Jesus' words in John 9:41: if they were blind they would not have sin, but since they say they see, their sin remains. The setting, gestures, and expressions are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus and three companions draw water together at a stone village well in the golden light of a setting sun.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imagined scene of people working at a village well illustrates Jesus' words about doing the works of the One who sent him while it is day, before night comes. The verse does not describe this particular act.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A watercolor scene of Jesus standing with open arms among listeners on a hillside, with a sunlit valley and stone village beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering depicts Jesus among people, with light across the landscape suggesting his words that, while he is in the world, he is the light of the world.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed man gently applies brown clay to a seated man's closed eyes beside a stone wall, with damp earth on the ground nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene follows the excerpt's Berean Interlinear glosses for John 9:6: after speaking, he spat on the ground, made clay from the spittle, and applied it to the man's eyes. The setting and appearance of the people are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man with dripping hands walks up a sunlit stone path from a pool, looking around with wonder.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the man after he washed in the Pool of Siloam and began his return seeing, as described in John 9:7. His appearance and the setting are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man stands in a sunlit stone village lane as three neighbors look at him and gesture in conversation. A woven mat and a small bowl lie beside a doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 9:8, in which neighbors ask whether this is the man they had seen sitting and begging. The setting, mat, bowl, and gestures are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man in an ancient village gestures toward his chest as people around him point, smile, and look uncertain.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 9:9: people disagree about whether the man is the one they recognize or someone like him, while he says that he is the man. The setting, expressions, and gestures are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: On a sunlit stone village path, a young man raises his hand in refusal as three men beckon and offer him a pouch of coins; an older man watches from a doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a son refusing enticement, reflecting the warning in Proverbs 1:10.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Three men conceal themselves among rocks and shrubs beside a sunlit road, one gesturing to a young man, while a lone traveler approaches from the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the invitation to lie in wait for an innocent person without cause in Proverbs 1:11.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: On a rocky hillside at sunset, a frightened man slips toward a deep dark pit while a woman reaches for him; three threatening figures approach behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the verse’s threat to swallow people alive and whole, like those going down to the pit.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Four men carry and gather chests, textiles, jewelry, and ornate vessels inside a stone house filled with valuables.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the boast in Proverbs 1:13 about finding precious possessions and filling houses with spoil.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A hesitant young man sits beneath a tree as three men invite him into their group; one gestures toward him, another holds a leather purse, and small lots lie between them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of the invitation in Proverbs 1:14 to cast one’s lot among the group and share one purse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A father rests a hand on his son’s shoulder and speaks to him at a fork in a rocky path, while a group of men walks away along one branch. An olive tree, golden fields, stone walls, distant buildings and hills fill the landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting the father’s warning in Proverbs 1:15 to keep one’s foot from the path of those who would lead him astray.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: On a sunlit rocky path, a frightened traveler runs while armed men pursue him, their feet kicking up dust; hills, trees, and a distant village fill the landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of armed pursuers illustrates Proverbs 1:16, where their feet run toward evil and they hurry to shed blood.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A small brown bird perched in an olive tree looks down toward a rope net spread openly across sunlit ground, with olive groves, hills and a distant village beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Proverbs 1:17: a bird sees a net spread in the open.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Three men crouch behind rocks and thorny shrubs beside a winding sunlit path, watching the road as a rope loops around the ankles of the man in front. Hills and a village lie in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of men lying in wait while their own snare catches one of them, reflecting Proverbs 1:18’s warning that they lurk for their own lives.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A startled traveler clutches a pouch overflowing with gold coins while a rope catches his ankle on a rocky path beside a deep ravine. Hills, trees, and a distant village fill the sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates Proverbs 1:19 by showing a person whose pursuit of gain puts his own life in danger.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowned Solomon sits with a scroll overlooking an ancient city.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative illustration of the introduction to the proverbs of Solomon.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman in a white head covering and green robe speaks with one hand extended to listeners in a sunlit stone market square, surrounded by stalls, baskets and townspeople.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Wisdom calling aloud outside and raising her voice in the open squares in Proverbs 1:20.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman gestures as she speaks beside an open stone city gate, while townspeople gather and a busy market and walled city stretch beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Wisdom crying out in the busy concourse and speaking at the city gates in Proverbs 1:21.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient town market, a woman in blue and white extends her hand as a man turns away with a raised palm; two men laugh together, while a youth rests his head on his hand.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 1:22, showing Wisdom calling as people turn away or delight in mockery.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman in blue and white robes speaks with an outstretched hand to a group of listeners in a sunlit ancient town square, while golden strands of light flow among them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Wisdom calling listeners to turn at her rebuke, with the golden breeze suggesting her promise to pour out her spirit and make her words known.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient town square, a woman in white and red reaches out to passing townspeople, who continue on their way among stone buildings, baskets and market stalls.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Wisdom calling and stretching out her hand while no one pays attention, reflecting Proverbs 1:24.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone town, a woman in blue and cream reaches out to counsel a group. A man raises his hand dismissively as others turn or look away.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Wisdom's counsel and rebuke being refused in Proverbs 1:25.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A laughing woman stands apart in a sunlit ancient town square while frightened townspeople look toward a dark rainstorm over the hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Wisdom laughing at calamity as terror comes, as described in Proverbs 1:26.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Four frightened people in windblown robes huddle on a rocky path as a vast whirlwind swirls beneath dark clouds over a golden landscape, with a village in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evoking the verse’s comparison of terror to a storm and destruction to a whirlwind, with distress and anguish coming upon people.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At sunrise in a stone town, a man calls out while a woman peers around a wall and another person searches farther down the street; an empty courtyard lies beyond an arch.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of calling and searching without finding, reflecting Proverbs 1:28.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village, an older man holds an open blank scroll and reaches toward four people walking away; two raise their hands in refusal. A path winds up a golden hill behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of people turning away from offered learning and an open path, reflecting Proverbs 1:29's rejection of knowledge and failure to choose the fear of Yahweh.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elder teaches an attentive young learner beside an open scroll.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The scene suggests receiving wisdom and understanding.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient town square, a robed woman reaches out as she speaks. A man raises his hand dismissively, a woman folds her arms, and an older man walks away among stone buildings and market stalls.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Wisdom offering counsel while people reject it, reflecting Proverbs 1:30 and its description of despised rebuke.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two sorrowful people eat dark, withered fruit beneath a gnarled tree beside a winding path. A basket overflows with more fruit between them, with hills and a village in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of eating the fruit of their own way and being filled with their own fancies in Proverbs 1:31.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two smiling travelers in robes walk toward a crumbling cliff above a river gorge; one gestures back toward a winding path while the other walks with his hands behind his head, and rocks fall from the cliff.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of travelers turning away and walking complacently toward danger reflects Proverbs 1:32's warning about the turning away of the simple and the complacency of fools.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, an older man speaks to an attentive seated man while a child sleeps beside a dog. Olive trees, village houses, and hills fill the background.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of listening and peaceful dwelling reflects Proverbs 1:33 and its promise of security without fear of evil.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elder discusses fairness with two neighbors at a village gate while a young learner watches.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The scene suggests instruction in justice and fairness.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elder points down a hillside path as a young person considers the way.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The scene suggests prudence and discernment learned by a young person.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man listens to another teacher beside an open scroll.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The scene suggests the wise person listening and increasing learning.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elder speaks to a thoughtful group gathered beneath a tree.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The scene suggests listening to and considering the words of the wise.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man bows in prayer while a learner listens to an elder and another man turns away.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The scene suggests reverence, learning and the rejection of instruction.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A boy listens to his father and mother in a courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The scene suggests a son listening to his parents instruction.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling young man wears a flower and leaf garland and several gold chains in a sunlit stone courtyard, as a man rests a hand on his shoulder and a woman adjusts the garland.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating Proverbs 1:9, where parental instruction is likened to a graceful ornament for the head and chains about the neck.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient marketplace, a man winks at a companion while a worried fruit seller watches; nearby, an animated speaker stumbles over a stone.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evokes the winking eye that causes trouble and the prating fool who falls in Proverbs 10:10.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man speaks to listeners beside a flowing spring surrounded by greenery. Farther back, another man speaks while holding a clenched fist behind his back.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evokes the righteous mouth as a well of life and contrasts it with violence concealed by the mouth of the wicked.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunny stone courtyard, a man and woman gesture toward each other while a seated neighbor spreads a woven cloth over a broken clay vessel and scattered shards.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 10:12: hatred stirs up strife, while love covers all sins.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, a white-bearded elder speaks with an open hand to seated listeners beneath an olive tree. A man stands apart with his head lowered and his back partly turned, beside an upright wooden rod. Earthen vessels, foliage, and distant hills surround them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene connects the wise speaker with the verse’s wisdom on understanding lips, and the rod beside the other man with its image of correction for one lacking understanding.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a woman and a man place rolled scrolls in a wooden chest while another man gestures open-mouthed beside a stack of tipping clay jars.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 10:14: the stored scrolls suggest knowledge kept by the wise, while the gesturing man and unstable jars suggest the nearness of destruction to a fool’s mouth.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A prosperous man stands among stored provisions behind a fortified stone city wall, while a woman and two children sit beside a damaged dwelling with scant food outside the city.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 10:15's contrast between wealth as a strong city and the hardship of poverty for the poor.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village garden, a worker shares a basket of vegetables with a woman and two children. Nearby at a market stall, a hooded man offers coins to another man who reaches toward a vessel.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 10:16 by contrasting labor that nourishes life with money used to draw someone toward wrongdoing.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older guide points toward a green valley and winding path as one young traveler listens; another turns away along a rocky track.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the contrast in Proverbs 10:17 between keeping instruction on the way of life and refusing correction and going astray.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, a smiling man holds a thorny branch behind his back while whispering to a woman. Another man reaches toward him, and a worried man watches from behind a low wall.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene suggesting the verse's concealed hatred, lying lips, and spreading of slander.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man gestures while speaking to three seated listeners. A woman and a man look uneasy, while another man listens quietly with his hands folded.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the danger of many words and the wisdom of restraining one’s lips in Proverbs 10:19.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a smiling father and son work together on a wooden tool. Nearby, a sorrowful seated mother watches another boy hurry away beside an overturned basket of spilled grain.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene expressing the contrast in Proverbs 10:1: a wise son gladdens his father, while a foolish son brings grief to his mother.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, an elder speaks to a seated listener across a table bearing a shining silver bowl. A man holding a small pouch turns away in the background.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pairs a gentle conversation with bright silver to evoke the value of righteous speech, while the departing figure suggests the contrast with the heart of the wicked in Proverbs 10:20.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man speaks to adults and children gathered beneath a fruit tree, with a basket of bread among them. A lone traveler walks toward a dry, rocky landscape in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 10:21: the gathering and bread suggest how righteous words nourish many, while the barren path hints at the danger of lacking wisdom.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling family rests beneath a fig tree among baskets of grapes, figs, and grain, with a stone house and sunlit hills behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative harvest scene evokes the richness and absence of added sorrow in the blessing of Yahweh described in Proverbs 10:22.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient marketplace, a laughing man steps away from a tipped basket of fruit while a startled woman and a kneeling man gather the scattered produce.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasting a fool treating wrongdoing as sport with the response of a man of understanding, inspired by Proverbs 10:23.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A worried man clutches a torn sack as grain spills onto the ground, while nearby a woman pours water into a smiling gardener’s cupped hands beside a flourishing garden and a sunlit village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the fear of the wicked coming upon him and the desire of the righteous being granted, as contrasted in Proverbs 10:24.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man in ancient clothing stands on a stone foundation beside a stone house, watching a whirlwind sweep past the scattered remains of a shelter in a sunlit valley.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the whirlwind passing and the righteous remaining on an enduring foundation, reflecting Proverbs 10:25.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man reclines beneath a tree beside a tied parcel. Nearby, a man winces while holding a cup, and a woman rubs her eye beside a smoky cooking fire.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating Proverbs 10:26: a lazy messenger is compared to vinegar on the teeth and smoke in the eyes of those who send him.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man with clasped hands looks upward beneath a flourishing olive tree. A winding sunlit path leads toward distant hills and a village, while a broken, withered sapling stands beside the path.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses a thriving tree and long path to suggest the days prolonged by fear of Yahweh, and a broken sapling to suggest the shortened years of the wicked in Proverbs 10:27.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village, a smiling family shares bread and a basket of grapes with a seated neighbor, while a distressed man stands beside an overturned basket of scattered fruit.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects the contrast in Proverbs 10:28 between the gladness of the righteous and the perishing expectation of the wicked.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A family rests inside a sturdy stone shelter beside a sunlit path while two men flee a collapsing stone structure in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasting the way of Yahweh as strength for the upright with destruction for workers of iniquity in Proverbs 10:29.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler on a rocky riverbank pulls a struggling man from rushing water, beside an open chest spilling gold coins toward the torrent; a sunlit village and hills lie beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative rescue illustrates Proverbs 10:2: wicked treasure cannot profit, while righteousness delivers from death.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man with a staff stands on rocky ground beneath a fruiting olive tree beside a stone house, overlooking cultivated fields as four figures walk away along a distant road.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating Proverbs 10:30: the righteous remain secure while the wicked do not dwell in the land.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A white-bearded elder speaks to listeners beneath a fig tree laden with fruit, with a flowering shoot extending from his mouth. Nearby, a gardener holds pruning shears and a dry, twisted branch in a sunlit orchard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the wise speech of the righteous as fruitful growth and the cutting off of perverse speech as a pruned branch, echoing Proverbs 10:31.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a white-bearded elder speaks gently to a seated man. Nearby, a man whispers to a worried woman beside a curling thorny vine.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasting gracious speech with the perverse speech described in Proverbs 10:32.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man shares bread with a child at a table with two women, while another man reaches through a closed wooden gate toward the meal.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of provision and frustrated desire reflects Proverbs 10:3, where Yahweh does not let the righteous soul famish and casts away the desire of the wicked.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit golden field, a farmer gathers wheat beside overflowing baskets while another man rests under an olive tree beside a nearly empty basket; stone homes and hills lie in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative harvest scene illustrating Proverbs 10:4’s contrast between a slack hand and the fruitful work of the diligent.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a golden grain field, a young man gathers stalks into a sheaf while another sleeps under a tree beside loose harvested grain; hills and a village lie beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasts gathering in summer with sleeping during harvest in Proverbs 10:5.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village courtyard, a woman places a leafy flower garland on the head of a seated man holding bread, while a child carries a basket of loaves. Nearby, a smiling man speaks to another man whose fist is held behind his back.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasts a blessing on the head of the righteous with the verse's image of violence concealed by the mouth of the wicked.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older woman speaks warmly to a child watering a flowering tree in a sunlit village garden. A decaying wooden marker rests among dry leaves nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts a cherished memory, represented by a flourishing tree, with a decaying marker for the name of the wicked in Proverbs 10:7.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village courtyard, an older craftsman points to a piece of wood while a young apprentice listens; nearby, a gesturing man stumbles over a stone.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene expressing Proverbs 10:8: the wise in heart receive commands, while a prating fool falls.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler with a staff walks along a sunlit road near a stone village, while another man emerges beside a stone wall from a winding path and villagers watch in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures walking securely in integrity and crooked ways becoming known, as described in Proverbs 10:9.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone city square, smiling townspeople gather around an elder sharing a basket of grain and fruit with a woman and child. A broken wooden yoke lies near the city gate behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the city rejoicing as the righteous prosper, with a broken yoke suggesting relief from wicked oppression in Proverbs 11:10.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A sunlit stone hill city with gardens rises behind a man speaking with open hands to smiling neighbors. On the right, a stern man speaks to a small group as dark wind curls beside a crumbling city wall.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 11:11, contrasting a city lifted up by the blessing of the upright with its overthrow through the mouth of the wicked.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, a man in red raises a dismissive hand and looks scornfully toward two neighbors; the men in green and blue stand quietly with their hands clasped. An olive tree, pottery, and distant hills surround them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Proverbs 11:12, contrasting contempt for a neighbor with the restraint of understanding.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a woman speaks to a seated man who rests a cloth over a clay jar; behind them, a traveler whispers to another seated man.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts the talebearer who reveals secrets with the faithful person who conceals a matter in Proverbs 11:13.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At an ancient stone city gate, a community leader studies a map with four counselors. An older counselor points toward a bridge where people and pack animals cross a rocky ravine safely.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene relates the shared counsel of many advisers to the safety of the people in Proverbs 11:14.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient marketplace, a traveler holds a purse close and raises one hand to decline a merchant’s outstretched hand; another man watches beside coins and a blank tablet.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene portraying the security of declining a stranger’s pledge of surety, as contrasted with the suffering warned of in Proverbs 11:15.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village marketplace, a woman helps an elderly woman while smiling neighbors watch; two stern men guard a chest and piles of coins nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene relating the gracious woman and honor to the ruthless men and riches in Proverbs 11:16.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, a smiling man offers a bowl to a seated, weary traveler holding bread. In the background, a stern man gestures refusal toward another person in need.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 11:17: mercy brings good to the merciful person, while cruelty brings trouble to the cruel person.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A farmer scatters seed across furrows while sharing grain with a woman beside a full basket and golden wheat; nearby, another man holds chaff beside a spilled sack.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasting deceptive work with sowing righteousness and its sure reward in Proverbs 11:18.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler pours water for a weary man beside a tree and a flowering spring, while another man reaches for scattered coins near a crumbling ravine.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts righteousness leading to life with pursuing evil toward one’s own death, as in Proverbs 11:19.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient marketplace, a smiling merchant places a stone weight on one pan of a hanging balance opposite grain as a woman watches. A hollowed weight rests on the table nearby, surrounded by baskets and grain.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative marketplace scene relates to Proverbs 11:1, contrasting dishonest scales with a just weight that delights the LORD.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: On a sunlit village path, a traveler returns a small purse to a grateful older man while another man turns away concealing a purse behind his back.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative contrast between honest and crooked conduct, reflecting Proverbs 11:20. The village actions are a learning illustration, not a narrated historical event.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At a sunlit stone village gate, two anxious men clasp hands as elders confront them, while a child runs toward a smiling family nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene depicting the wicked facing judgment despite joining forces and the descendants of the righteous being delivered, as in Proverbs 11:21.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a muddy pig wears a gold ring through its snout while a woman looks into a hand mirror and spills water from a tilted jar.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates the proverb’s comparison of a gold ring in a pig’s snout to a lovely woman lacking discretion; the spilled water is an invented visual detail.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village, a woman offers a loaf of bread to a seated child, while a richly dressed man clutches a sack and looks fearfully toward dark rain clouds.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasts a generous desire for good with a fearful expectation of wrath, reflecting Proverbs 11:23.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient village, a smiling man scatters grain from a full basket to neighbors beside a plentiful harvest, while another man clutches a nearly empty clay vessel among dry plants and stones.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene expressing the contrast in Proverbs 11:24 between scattering and increasing, and withholding more than is right and coming to poverty.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman waters a young olive tree as a neighbor offers her a cup of water.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The verb and noun cues follow OSHB morphology. The scene reflects the verse’s image of giving and receiving refreshment.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village marketplace, a grain seller pours grain into a woman’s basket as smiling people raise their hands nearby. Farther back, villagers gesture toward a stern merchant standing beside a locked storehouse.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative marketplace scene reflecting Proverbs 11:26: people curse the one who withholds grain, while blessing comes upon the one who sells it.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village, a young woman gathers fruit from an overturned basket while an older woman smiles and touches her shoulder. Nearby, a startled man catches his foot in a rope snare.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene relating a helpful act and grateful favor to the verse, alongside a snare catching the person who set it as an image of trouble coming to one who seeks evil.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A richly dressed man slips on a crumbling bank beside an overturned chest spilling gold, while four people tend a leafy tree in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 11:28: the one trusting in riches falls, while the righteous flourish like foliage.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a downcast man carries a clay jar toward a seated elder, while a worried woman and two children stand in a doorway. Wind blows dry leaves past an overturned empty basket.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evokes the household troubled by its own member, an inheritance of wind, and the fool serving the wise of heart in Proverbs 11:29.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a richly dressed man holds his forehead beside a fallen stool and spilled fruit, while a simply dressed younger man listens to an older man seated beneath a tree.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative courtyard scene reflects Proverbs 11:2: pride is followed by shame, while wisdom is with the humble.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated man offers grapes to a child as a group gathers beneath a large fruit-laden tree, with baskets of fruit and a sunlit village in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene connects the fruit of the righteous, a tree of life, and the wisdom of winning souls through a generous gathering.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At a sunlit stone village gate, a man gathers pieces of a broken clay vessel beside a woman, while an elder watches another man hand a bundle of goods to its owner.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of earthly accountability reflects the proverb’s contrast between recompense for the righteous and for the ungodly and sinner.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: On a sunlit hillside path, a traveler offers a small purse to a woman, while another man tumbles into thorny brush beside a crumbling shortcut; a village lies in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasting the guidance of integrity with the ruin brought by unfaithfulness in Proverbs 11:3.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a rainstorm, a traveler pulls a man from a raging flood beside a rocky bank; an open chest of gold lies nearby as sunlight breaks through dark clouds.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative rescue evokes the proverb’s contrast between riches that cannot help in the day of wrath and righteousness that delivers from death.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: On a sunlit stone path toward a distant village, a traveler returns a cloth bundle to a seated man. Nearby another man has fallen among rocks beside an open sack spilling its contents.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting the blameless person whose way is directed aright and the wicked person who falls through his own wickedness in Proverbs 11:5.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler on a stone bridge hands a purse to an older man, while another man lies tangled in ropes beneath a tree and reaches toward scattered coins. A stream runs through the rocky ravine below, with fields and a village beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative contrast for Proverbs 11:6: an honest act accompanies a safe crossing, while a man reaching for coins is caught in ropes, suggesting the upright delivered and the unfaithful caught by desire.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A covered man lies on a wooden bier in a stone chamber at sunset, with an ornate fallen helmet and a smoking, extinguished oil lamp on the floor nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 11:7: the covered man, fallen helmet, and spent lamp suggest the end of a wicked man's expectation and hope in strength at death.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: On a sunlit rocky village path, a man helps a relieved traveler to his feet beside a branch-covered stone pit, where another man looks up in alarm.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of deliverance and reversal: the traveler is safe while another man is in the pit, reflecting Proverbs 11:8.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient village, a man gestures and whispers to two listeners while a worried traveler is guided around a net on the ground by another man pointing toward a clear path.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasts destructive speech against a neighbor with the deliverance that comes through knowledge in Proverbs 11:9.
