records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village farmyard, a kneeling man holds a bowl of water for a resting donkey and gently touches its back; its pack lies nearby. In the distance, another man leads a heavily laden donkey.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Proverbs 12:10, contrasting attentive care for an animal with a distant image of disregard.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A farmer hoes dark soil among green crops beside a basket holding a round loaf of bread. Farther down a sunlit path, another man runs after feathers blowing in the wind, with fields, olive trees, a village and hills beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts tending the land and having bread with pursuing frivolity, as in Proverbs 12:11.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two fishermen haul a net full of fish beside a river while a scowling man watches from the bank. Nearby, a man gathers figs from a flourishing tree with roots exposed above the water.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasting the wicked coveting the catch of evil men with the fruitful root of the righteous in Proverbs 12:12.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A startled man gestures while caught in a rope net beside a tree, as another man walks out of a narrow rocky passage onto a sunlit village path.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene expressing Proverbs 12:13: the wicked are ensnared by transgressing with their lips, while the righteous come through trouble.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling craftsman speaks with a woman offering a basket of figs and bread beside a wooden stool, carpentry tools, and wood shavings in a sunlit stone courtyard beneath a fig tree.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene connecting the good fruit of a person's speech with the recompense of the work of their hands in Proverbs 12:14.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: On a sunlit rocky hillside, a traveler with a raised hand strides along a broken path while another traveler listens to an older guide pointing toward a winding stone path. Olive trees, distant hills and a village fill the background.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasting confidence in one's own way with the wisdom of listening to counsel in Proverbs 12:15.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village courtyard, an angry man raises his hand and shouts while a seated basket maker looks down and continues weaving; two onlookers watch nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates the contrast in Proverbs 12:16 between a fool displaying wrath at once and a prudent person covering shame.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At a sunlit stone village gate, a man speaks with an open hand to a seated elder while a guarded man stands nearby with his hands behind his back and villagers watch.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative village-gate hearing illustrates the contrast in Proverbs 12:17 between truthful speech and a false witness’s deceit.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, an angry man speaks toward a startled seated man as translucent sword shapes fly from his mouth. An older man beside the listener rests a hand on his shoulder and speaks gently amid a warm glow and green leaves.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene depicting speech that pierces like a sword and the healing associated with the speech of the wise in Proverbs 12:18.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a woman speaks to seated listeners beneath a large olive tree. Nearby, a man speaks as pale mist leaves his mouth and two people walk away.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts enduring truth, suggested by the rooted olive tree and attentive listeners, with a lie that passes quickly, suggested by the dispersing breath.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit pottery workshop, an older potter guides a smiling apprentice shaping a clay vessel, while another apprentice sits with folded arms and turns away from a potter beside a crooked vessel.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative workshop scene contrasts welcoming instruction with turning away from correction, reflecting Proverbs 12:1.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a smiling older man stands between two smiling men who clasp hands. Two other men whisper together in a shadowed doorway behind them, beneath an olive tree.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting the contrast between deceit among those who devise evil and the joy of counselors of peace in Proverbs 12:20.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler helps an injured man rise on a sunlit stone path, while two men struggle in thorn bushes beside an overturned basket and spilled valuables; a village and hills lie beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasting the righteous person who is not overtaken by grave trouble with the wicked filled with evil, as in Proverbs 12:21.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient marketplace, a smiling merchant pours grain into a customer’s sack while another man glances back uneasily beside a balance scale.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative marketplace scene reflects Proverbs 12:22’s contrast between lying lips and those who act truthfully, who are Yahweh’s delight.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, a thoughtful seated man holds a rolled scroll close while a smiling man gestures broadly to onlookers and tips a clay vessel, spilling water onto the ground.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasting the prudent person's concealed knowledge with the foolishness proclaimed by fools in Proverbs 12:23.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone building yard, a craftsperson on a raised platform gestures toward the work while holding a plan. Nearby, a weary man carries a large stone as an overseer points; other workers build a wall behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating Proverbs 12:24’s contrast between the diligent who rule and the lazy person put to forced labor.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard beneath an olive tree, a worried man sits with his hands clasped while a smiling neighbor puts an arm around him and speaks with an open hand.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Proverbs 12:25: anxiety weighs down the heart, while a good word brings gladness.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At a fork in a sunlit hillside, one traveler gestures toward a village while a second looks at him; a group walks away along a rocky, thorn-lined path.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 12:26, picturing careful companionship and a way that leads astray.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A hunter reclines beneath a tree beside an unprepared deer and a cold stone hearth, while a woman tends a cooking fire and baskets of provisions near a stone house in a sunlit hillside village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts the hunter leaving his catch unroasted with the care of diligent work, reflecting Proverbs 12:27.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler helps a seated man to his feet on a winding countryside path, surrounded by wildflowers, trees and a flowing stream, with a sunlit village and mountains in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses an act of kindness and a flourishing path to reflect the verse’s association of righteousness with life and a path without death.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, a man gives bread to a seated man in patched clothing. Nearby, a distressed man stands with a scale, weights and spilled coins before three elders at a table.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 12:2, contrasting a good man's favor from Yahweh with the condemnation of wicked intentions; the village judgment is a visual analogy.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man sits beside a flourishing olive tree whose exposed roots grip a stream bank, while another man struggles with a tumbling stack of stones on loose ground in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasting the firm root of the righteous with the instability of wickedness in Proverbs 12:3.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman places a leafy crown on a seated man in a sunlit stone courtyard; a weathered bone and decaying wood lie beneath a tree nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 12:4: the leafy crown suggests an excellent wife as her husband’s crown, while the bone and decaying wood evoke the contrasting image of inward decay.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient marketplace, an elder gestures beside a balance scale while listening to two men. Nearby, one man whispers to another who holds a stone behind his back; baskets of produce fill the foreground.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative marketplace scene contrasts the right thoughts of the righteous with the deceitful counsel of the wicked in Proverbs 12:5.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village, a man calls out and guides a startled traveler away from two men hiding behind a wall, one holding a knife.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a spoken warning delivering a traveler from an ambush, reflecting Proverbs 12:6's contrast between the words of the wicked and the mouth of the upright.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A family gathers at the warmly lit doorway of a standing stone house after a storm, while a large ruined building lies overturned across the rocky valley.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the contrast in Proverbs 12:7 between the overthrow of the wicked and the enduring house of the righteous.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village grain market, smiling villagers gather around a man speaking with open hands. Nearby, a man hides a pouch of grain beneath his cloak as others look on disapprovingly.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative marketplace scene illustrating Proverbs 12:8's contrast between commendation for wisdom and contempt for a perverse heart.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a simply dressed seated man holds bread while a young servant pours a drink beside him. Passersby walk behind them, and an elaborately dressed man stands proudly near an empty basket.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating Proverbs 12:9's contrast between a slighted person with a servant and a self-honoring person lacking bread.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men argue in a sunlit village courtyard while a young man listens to an older adviser nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative illustration of pride producing strife and wisdom accompanying those who receive counsel.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village marketplace, coins spill from a worried merchant’s pouch while a laborer beside baskets of produce adds a coin to a clay jar; a hoe lies nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the proverb’s contrast between wealth gained by dishonesty diminishing and wealth gathered by labor increasing.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling man seated beside a flourishing pomegranate tree reaches for a ripe fruit, with a basket of fruit on his lap and an empty clay jar nearby in a sunlit garden.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of fulfilled longing as a flourishing tree, reflecting the verse's contrast between hope deferred and desire that comes.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit hillside village, an elder gestures as a traveler turns away beside a broken wooden bridge and a spilled bundle; another traveler listens while a woman offers him a basket of fruit.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting the contrast in Proverbs 13:13 between despising the word and fearing the commandment, with its respective consequences and reward.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older teacher guides a young traveler away from a rope snare on a rocky path and points toward a clear stream cascading among flowers and greenery, with hills and a village in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the instruction of the wise as a fountain of life that turns one away from the snares of death in Proverbs 13:14.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Villagers warmly greet a smiling man holding a shovel beside a flowing stone water channel, while another man carrying a tool walks away along a winding stone road through a sunlit hillside landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a helpful act met with favor and a lasting road, reflecting the verse's contrast between good understanding and the enduring way of the unfaithful.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village courtyard, one craftsperson examines a plank beside a sturdy wooden stool while another proudly gestures toward a crooked stool made from mismatched pieces.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating Proverbs 13:16's contrast between acting with knowledge and exposing folly.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: On a sunny village road, a man tumbles into a muddy ditch beside a fallen pouch, while another traveler offers a small vessel to a seated man with a bandaged arm, accompanied by a woman. A donkey stands nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 13:17, contrasting a wicked messenger falling into trouble with a faithful envoy associated with healing.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village workshop, an elder gestures to a carpenter who looks up attentively from his work. A smiling woman holds out a wooden bowl, while another man sits with folded arms and looks away beside scattered wood and an empty basket.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts accepting correction and receiving honor with turning away from correction, as described in Proverbs 13:18.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit orchard, a smiling woman reaches for a ripe fig above a basket of fruit. Behind her, two men hold figs as a third man gestures to them beside another basket.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative orchard scene connects the sweetness of a fulfilled desire with the refusal to turn from wrongdoing in Proverbs 13:19.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a seated father gestures as his son listens attentively. Nearby, an older man reaches out to a young man who crosses his arms and turns away. Olive branches, vines, pottery, chickens, and distant hills surround them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the contrast in Proverbs 13:1 between a wise son heeding his father’s instruction and a scoffer refusing to listen to rebuke.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A young traveler listens to two companions walking along a sunlit path through a rocky countryside. On a nearby rough path, a man stumbles as two companions follow behind him; a village and hills lie in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts walking with wise companions with the harm associated with keeping company with fools in Proverbs 13:20.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: On a winding road beside an ancient village, an anxious man runs with grain spilling from his sack as a dark rainstorm approaches behind him. In sunlight nearby, smiling villagers offer a man a basket filled with fruit and wheat.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 13:21: the storm suggests trouble pursuing the sinful, while the harvest gift suggests good repaying the righteous.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard beneath grapevines, an elderly man passes a small wooden chest to a boy while a girl and two adults gather around; baskets of produce, grain, jars, sacks, and another chest sit beside a closed wooden door.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a grandfather passing an inheritance to his grandchildren, with stored provisions suggesting the wealth kept for the righteous in Proverbs 13:22.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A distressed farming family stands beside a plentiful golden grain field as a richly dressed man loads a sack onto a cart and grain spills onto the ground; an armed attendant and distant village appear behind him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene linking the poor's abundant harvest with food lost through injustice in Proverbs 13:23.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a kneeling father speaks to his seated son with a hand on his shoulder. A wooden rod rests against the wall beside them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Proverbs 13:24 and its connection between a father’s love and prompt discipline.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard beneath grapevines, a smiling man holds bread at a table with olives and other food. Nearby, two men argue over a nearly empty bowl.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene expressing Proverbs 13:25's contrast between eating to satisfaction and being in want.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men converse over fruit and bread at a courtyard table beneath grapevines, while behind them a man reaches aggressively toward another man carrying a basket of produce.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating the contrast in Proverbs 13:2 between enjoying good from the fruit of one's mouth and the unfaithful appetite for violence.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, a thoughtful man holds a finger near his closed mouth while another man shouts with his arms spread beside a shattered clay vessel.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts guarded speech with the harm suggested by unrestrained words in Proverbs 13:3.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man sits beneath a tree beside an empty basket, looking toward villagers gathering golden grain into full baskets in a sunny field, with a village and hills beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative harvest scene illustrates Proverbs 13:4's contrast between the lazy person's unfulfilled desire and the abundance of the diligent.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient marketplace, a man raises an open hand toward a downcast merchant holding a small weight behind his back. An uneven balance scale stands between them as several onlookers watch.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative marketplace encounter depicts a righteous person rejecting deceit and a dishonest person brought to shame, echoing Proverbs 13:5.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler walks on a sunlit stone path protected by a low wall, while another traveler stumbles on a loose rocky slope above a ravine; hills and a village lie beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts a guarded path with an unstable shortcut to suggest righteousness guarding the blameless and wickedness overthrowing the sinner in Proverbs 13:6.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a richly dressed man displays an empty purse beside an empty chest, while a man in a worn cloak sits beside a chest overflowing with gold and jewels.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating Proverbs 13:7's contrast between an appearance of riches with nothing and an appearance of poverty with great wealth.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient town, a richly dressed man holds out a coin pouch to a stern official while a plainly dressed man walks past; a guard stands behind the official.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting the contrast between riches as a ransom for a life and the poor person who does not hear rebuke in Proverbs 13:8.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a village courtyard at dusk, a smiling family shares bread with an older neighbor around a glowing oil lamp. Nearby, a solitary figure stands in a shadowed doorway beside an extinguished clay lamp with smoke curling from its wick.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 13:9’s contrast between the rejoicing light of the righteous and the lamp of the wicked being put out.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A tearful woman with a gentle smile sits with one hand over her chest in a sunlit stone courtyard among flowering plants, while a traveler walks away along the lane beyond the entrance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting the heart's private bitterness and joy, which a stranger does not share in Proverbs 14:10.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A ruined stone house lies among dry rubble beside an intact canvas tent surrounded by grapevines, flowers, garden plants, and a stream in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects the contrast in Proverbs 14:11 between the house of the wicked being overthrown and the tent of the upright flourishing.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling traveler with a staff walks a sunny, flower-lined path that winds toward a broken cliff above a dark ravine scattered with animal bones.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the way that seems right to a man but ends in death in Proverbs 14:12.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman sits with lowered eyes, a slight smile, and a hand against her chest while three companions laugh around a lamplit courtyard table.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the sorrow a heart may hold amid laughter, as Proverbs 14:13 describes.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man with a nearly empty basket stands amid a dry, thorny garden, while another sits beneath a fig tree beside a thriving garden, holding a basket of produce. Hills and a village lie in the sunlit distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative contrast between the consequences of the backslider’s ways and the satisfaction of a good man in Proverbs 14:14.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler gestures toward a rustic wooden bridge as a smiling traveler steps onto it; across the bridge, another traveler examines a loose plank above a rocky stream. Olive trees, wildflowers, hills and a village fill the sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts accepting another person’s direction readily with considering one’s steps, reflecting Proverbs 14:15.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A wary traveler turns away on a village road while an angry man raises a fist and strides toward a market stall, where another man seizes a bag of goods from a startled merchant.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting the wise person turning from evil and the fool raging with self-confidence in Proverbs 14:16.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient marketplace, an angry man gestures beside an overturned basket of spilled fruit while another man raises his hands. Nearby, a man holds a small purse behind his back as a woman and other villagers look toward him warily.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative marketplace scene illustrating the quick-tempered person's foolish action and the distrust directed toward a man with wicked intentions in Proverbs 14:17.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a puzzled young man holds a broken pot beside an open chest of broken objects, while a young woman wearing a leafy crown listens to an elder holding a blank scroll.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the contrast in Proverbs 14:18 between the simple inheriting folly and the prudent being crowned with knowledge.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men bow low on a stone path outside an open wooden gate, while four people stand inside a sunlit courtyard among olive trees and stone buildings.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Proverbs 14:19, showing the evil bowing before the good at the gates of the righteous.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village, a woman carefully places a stone on a wall beside her house while another woman pulls stones from a neighboring wall, which crumbles around her.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating Proverbs 14:1's contrast between a wise woman building her house and foolishness pulling it down with her hands.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, a man in worn clothing stands alone as a neighbor turns away and raises a hand toward him; nearby, a richly dressed man sits among several smiling companions.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Proverbs 14:20's contrast between the poor man rejected by his neighbor and the rich man with many friends.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling villager kneels to share a loaf of bread with a seated man in worn clothing beneath an olive tree. In the sunlit village behind them, another man raises a dismissive hand toward an older neighbor.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 14:21's contrast between despising a neighbor and the happiness of showing mercy to the poor.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman and man offer bread to a seated traveler beside a sunlit path, while two figures move through thorny scrub nearby; a village and golden fields lie beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 14:22 through an act of mercy and figures who have wandered from the path, suggesting the contrast between devising good and going astray through evil.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman harvests carrots beside a basket of vegetables in a lush village garden, while two men sit talking beside an empty basket and a dry, sparse patch of ground.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasts the fruit of labor with the want that can follow idle talk, echoing Proverbs 14:23.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a crowned man sits thoughtfully beside a basket of grain and an open chest of coins. Nearby another man struggles to hold a tall, unsteady stack of clay pots, with a broken pot on the ground.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating the wise person's riches as a crown and the folly of the foolish through a precarious stack of pots.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At a sunlit stone town gate, a man gestures as he speaks to three seated elders while a family embraces nearby. Another man stands apart by the wall, and guards watch at the open gate.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative town-gate hearing pictures a truthful witness and a relieved family alongside an uneasy figure, reflecting the verse’s contrast between delivering lives through true testimony and speaking lies.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man prays with bowed head beside three children sheltering under a rocky overhang as rain falls and sunlight reaches a distant hillside village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects the verse’s strong confidence in the fear of Yahweh and the refuge described for His children.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler kneels beside a clear spring in a sunlit rocky landscape, lifting his gaze with one hand over his heart and the other in the water. A rope snare lies on the darker path behind him, while green plants flourish around the pool.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene relating the fear of Yahweh to a fountain of life and turning away from the snares of death in Proverbs 14:27.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowned king stands among a large, joyful crowd in a sunlit ancient city, while a solitary prince sits downcast beside a quiet stone gate in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating the honor a multitude brings a king and the vulnerability of a ruler without people in Proverbs 14:28.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village courtyard, a seated elder listens to a kneeling young woman beside an overturned water jar, while an angry man gestures near a basket of spilled fruit.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts patient understanding with an impulsive, foolish response, reflecting Proverbs 14:29.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: On a sunlit hillside road, a traveler helps an older woman gather a bundle of firewood; farther up a winding path, another traveler turns away from a seated person reaching out to him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasting upright conduct with crooked ways, reflecting Proverbs 14:2 and its connection between a person’s walk and their regard for Yahweh.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A relaxed man reclines with grapes in a lush garden while another man sits on a broken wooden stool, looking toward him with a scowl; dry plants surround the seated man.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Proverbs 14:30: a sound heart is life to the body, while envy is like rottenness to the bones.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a woman offers a loaf of bread to a seated man in worn clothing. Behind them, a richly dressed man raises a hand toward another seated man who reaches out.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 14:31's contrast between oppression of the poor and mercy toward the needy, which honors their Maker.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man rests on a bed in a warmly lit stone shelter as a woman holds his hand. Beyond the open doorway, a man carrying a bundle walks away from a village gate toward a storm-darkened landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects the contrast in Proverbs 14:32 between the wicked being banished in his wickedness and the righteous having refuge in death.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village courtyard, a seated man rests a hand against his chest and watches two men argue beside an overturned clay vessel. Grapevines, stone houses, and distant hills frame the scene.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene relating a thoughtful person's quiet composure to wisdom resting in an understanding heart, while the arguing figures express what is within them.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At a sunlit ancient city gate, neighbors share grain with a family while an elder weighs grain on a balance. People walk up a stone path toward a hilltop city, and a downcast merchant sits beside spilled grain and weights.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene connects just dealings and care for neighbors with a nation lifted up, while the downcast merchant suggests the reproach of sin in Proverbs 14:34.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowned king gestures toward a servant beside orderly baskets of provisions, while another servant looks down beside an overturned basket and spilled grain in a sunlit palace courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting the king's favor toward a wise servant and the shame associated with the other servant in Proverbs 14:35.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a richly dressed man speaks with his chin raised as a thorny rod curls from his mouth. Nearby, a seated man speaks with open hands to a small group beneath a grapevine.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts the fool's rod of pride with the preserving speech of the wise in Proverbs 14:3.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A farmer guides a brown ox pulling a wooden plow through dark soil beside a clean, empty wooden manger; bundles of golden grain and a loaded cart stand in the sunny field beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative farm scene brings together the clean manger and the abundant increase associated with an ox’s strength in Proverbs 14:4.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At a sunlit stone town gate, two men address seated elders: one gestures openly with a hand on his chest, while the other points and gestures emphatically. Onlookers stand nearby, with a hillside town beyond the gate.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene expressing Proverbs 14:5’s contrast between a faithful witness and a false witness who utters lies.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a frustrated man peers into an empty clay jar while an older man points out a leafy plant to an attentive young learner.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting the contrast in Proverbs 14:6 between the scoffer who seeks wisdom without finding it and the understanding person to whom knowledge comes easily.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler walks away along a sunlit stone path, looking back at a seated man who speaks with animated, open-handed gestures in a village courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of leaving a foolish man's presence when his speech offers no knowledge, reflecting Proverbs 14:7.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A thoughtful traveler crouches on a rocky hillside path, while another traveler steps toward a shortcut covered with leafy branches above a dark gap. A sunlit valley and village lie beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts the prudent person's careful attention to his way with the deceit associated with folly in Proverbs 14:8.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, two men laugh and point while a man helps a kneeling woman up and another woman gathers fruit spilled from a basket.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative village scene contrasts mockery with the favor and kindness among the upright described in Proverbs 14:9; the spilled fruit is a visual situation, not a depiction of sin itself.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older guide reaches out from a sunny winding path as a traveler raises his hand and steps onto a thorny trail beside a steep cliff. An animal skull lies among the thorns, with hills and a village in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a traveler rejecting correction and leaving the way, with the dangerous cliff suggesting the warning of death in Proverbs 15:10.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Golden sunlight falls across a rocky hillside and into a dark cave while a man and a woman in ancient dress stand nearby with hands over their hearts. Fields, trees, mountains and a distant village fill the landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evokes Proverbs 15:11: the hidden depths and human hearts are open before Yahweh.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A young man walks through a sunlit stone village, raising a dismissive hand toward an older man who gestures to him. Two elders sit beneath an olive tree nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a scoffer dismissing correction and passing by the wise, inspired by Proverbs 15:12.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard beneath grapevines, a smiling woman plays a tambourine beside a musician and a clapping child, while a seated man nearby rests his head in his hand with his gaze lowered.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts a cheerful countenance with the downcast posture of a sorrowful spirit, reflecting Proverbs 15:13.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village courtyard, an older man points to a plant held by a young learner, while three people nearby eat dry weeds from a bowl.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasts seeking knowledge with feeding on foolishness, as in Proverbs 15:14.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A weary traveler sits beside his belongings in the shade of a stone courtyard while a cheerful group shares bread and fruit at a low table nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes Proverbs 15:15's contrast between the afflicted person's difficult days and the continual feast of a merry heart.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A family bows in prayer around a modest meal in a sunlit stone courtyard. Nearby, a richly dressed man sits worried beside an open chest of gold and jewels while two men argue behind him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Proverbs 15:16's contrast between a little with reverence for Yahweh and great treasure accompanied by trouble.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling family shares leafy herbs and bread at a low wooden table in a sunlit home. Through a doorway, two richly dressed diners turn away from each other beside a lavish roast.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating the proverb’s contrast between a simple meal shared with love and a rich meal accompanied by hatred.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man in red gestures angrily while a man between him and an older man holds up open hands to calm their dispute. Olive trees, grapevines, pottery, and distant hills surround them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Proverbs 15:18: anger stirs strife, while patience helps calm contention.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated traveler rests beside a narrow rocky path choked with thorny branches, while three travelers walk along a broad raised road through a sunlit landscape toward distant hills and a village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 15:19, contrasting the lazy person’s thorn-hedged way with the highway of the upright.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, a man in a blue shawl gestures calmly toward an agitated man, while a tense woman watches beside them. Clay jars, a basket of figs, vines and distant hills surround them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of a gentle answer meeting anger, with a tense onlooker suggesting the danger of harsh words.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit courtyard, a smiling son helps his father work on a wooden cart while another young man turns away from a saddened mother reaching toward him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene expressing Proverbs 15:20's contrast between a wise son who gladdens his father and a foolish man who despises his mother.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A laughing man tips clay pots and spills grain beside a stone-lined country road, while another man walks upright along the road. Golden fields, trees and a hillside village surround them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasts delight in folly with the steady walk of a person of understanding in Proverbs 15:21.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A thoughtful builder listens to four people gathered around a miniature stone bridge on a wooden table. Loose stones lie in the foreground, and a completed stone bridge crosses a stream beside a village in the background.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 15:22: plans can go awry without counsel, while many counselors help establish them.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men sit together in a sunlit stone courtyard beneath a grapevine. One smiles and gestures as he rests a hand on the other man’s shoulder; the other listens with his hands clasped. Pottery, a basket of grapes, and a hillside village surround them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a joyful answer and a timely word, reflecting Proverbs 15:23.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler with a staff climbs a sunlit stone path through wildflowers and olive trees toward a hilltop village, leaving a shadowed rocky descent behind him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the wise person’s upward way of life, turning away from Sheol below in Proverbs 15:24.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman stands in a sunlit vegetable garden enclosed by a sturdy stone boundary, while a grand stone house and its rich furnishings lie in ruins across the hillside.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting the contrast in Proverbs 15:25 between the proud person's ruined house and the widow's established boundary.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, a woman speaks warmly to a seated neighbor, while a man in the shade glances toward them with his hand poised over a basket.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts comforting speech with a suggested harmful intention, reflecting Proverbs 15:26’s contrast between pleasant words and wicked thoughts.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man raises his palm to refuse a pouch offered by another man while a woman and two children watch from a doorway beneath an olive tree.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene connecting the rejection of a bribe with the life affirmed in Proverbs 15:27, which also warns that greed troubles a household.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard beneath a vine, a seated man holds a hand to his chest and listens thoughtfully while an agitated man gestures and speaks to a concerned older man nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes Proverbs 15:28's contrast between considering an answer and pouring out harmful speech.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man kneels with raised hands beneath a tree as golden light breaks through clouds over a hillside village. Across the valley, a person walks away on a dark path while another kneels and reaches toward him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests Proverbs 15:29: Yahweh is far from the wicked and hears the prayer of the righteous.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, an elder shows seeds and a young plant to attentive listeners while a nearby man gestures broadly as puzzled listeners watch.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasting the wise use of knowledge with foolish speech in Proverbs 15:2.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a smiling traveler gestures as he speaks to an older man, who looks up at him joyfully with his hands clasped at his chest. Vines, clay vessels, greenery, and distant village hills surround them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of bright eyes and a welcome report bringing joy and renewed well-being, reflecting Proverbs 15:30.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A young man listens to an elder gesturing toward a repaired clay vessel as two companions sit nearby beneath an olive tree in a flowering village courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of someone receiving correction while sitting among wise companions, inspired by Proverbs 15:31.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit pottery workshop, an older potter points to a clay vessel held by an attentive young apprentice, while another young worker turns away with folded arms beside a cracked pot.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating Proverbs 15:32's contrast between refusing instruction and gaining understanding by heeding correction.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a young learner kneels with head bowed beside a seated teacher pointing toward the sky, while an elder stands nearby holding a leafy wreath. Olive trees, pottery and distant hills surround them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests reverent instruction in wisdom and humility preceding honor in Proverbs 15:33.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient village, a woman offers bread to a seated man in worn clothing while another man furtively takes a purse from a market table. Golden light falls across the people, stone buildings, and distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene relates the shared light over acts of kindness and theft to Proverbs 15:3, where Yahweh watches the evil and the good in every place.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman speaks gently to a tearful neighbor seated beneath a fruiting fig tree in a sunlit village garden; a dry broken branch lies in the foreground.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evokes wholesome speech as a tree of life and the hurt of perverseness as a broken spirit.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, an older man gestures toward a woodworking bench while a young man listens and rests his hands on the wood; another young man stands nearby with folded arms and looks away.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates Proverbs 15:5 through contrasting responses to a father’s instruction and correction.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A family tends baskets of grain and fruit outside a stone house, while a distressed merchant reaches for coins spilled from a torn sack in the village street.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative illustration of Proverbs 15:6, contrasting treasure in the house of the righteous with trouble in the earnings of the wicked.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village garden, an elder scatters seeds as he speaks to four attentive listeners; a man sits apart holding a closed pouch.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating the wise spreading knowledge through their words, contrasted with a person who does not share.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a richly dressed man tends a smoking sacrifice on an altar while a seated, needy man reaches toward him. In the foreground another man kneels in prayer with open hands.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 15:8, contrasting the sacrifice of the wicked with the prayer of the upright, which delights Yahweh.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: On a sunlit village road, a traveler helps an older man gather spilled grain beside a donkey; in a shadowed doorway, another man carries a sack away.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative contrast between a caring act and a dishonest way reflects Proverbs 15:9: the LORD loves the one who pursues righteousness and rejects the way of the wicked.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowned king seated in a sunlit stone court extends an open hand toward a man and woman standing before him; a guard stands behind the throne.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative court scene reflecting the verse’s concern with a king’s speech and faithfulness in judgment.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient marketplace, a merchant and customer look at a level balance holding grain in one pan and a stone weight in the other. An open cloth bag of stone weights rests on the counter.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative marketplace scene reflects Proverbs 16:11 and its image of honest scales and the weights in the bag belonging to the Lord.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowned king sits on a stone throne in a sunlit royal court, raising one hand as a petitioner speaks and a richly dressed courtier offers a purse; guards stand behind him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative royal hearing evokes the proverb’s contrast between wickedness and the righteousness that establishes a throne.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A simply dressed counselor gestures as he speaks to a smiling crowned king seated on a decorated throne in a sunlit stone courtyard, with guards standing behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative court scene illustrates the king delighting in a person who speaks what is right, as described in Proverbs 16:13.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowned king in purple robes sits scowling on a golden throne as a man in a head covering gestures toward him with open hands. Two armed attendants stand behind them in a sunlit royal court.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Proverbs 16:14, showing a wise man appealing to an angry king as attendants suggest the danger of the king's wrath.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling crowned king reaches from a sunlit stone terrace toward a man looking up at him, while rain falls from a dark cloud over green fields and a distant village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene relating the king's favorable face to life and his favor to a cloud of latter rain in Proverbs 16:15.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a young learner listens to an older teacher pointing to the roots of a plant. An open chest of gold and a bowl of silver coins sit beside them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the choice to gain wisdom and understanding as more valuable than gold and silver, echoing Proverbs 16:16.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler with a walking staff turns away from a rocky, thorn-filled path onto a sunlit stone road winding toward a village among trees and hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of turning from a dangerous path and carefully keeping to a safer way, reflecting Proverbs 16:17.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A richly dressed man walks with his chin raised along a high stone path as the edge crumbles beneath his leading foot, overlooking a sunlit hillside village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating the proverb that pride precedes destruction and a haughty spirit precedes a fall.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A simply dressed group shares bread and a meal beneath a tree in a sunlit village, while richly dressed figures divide golden vessels and jewelry on a raised terrace behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasts humble companionship with the lowly and the division of spoil among the proud in Proverbs 16:19.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man arranges smooth stones on a low wooden table while speaking to a woman who listens across from him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses the arranged stones and the spoken answer to reflect Proverbs 16:1: a person prepares the heart, while the answer of the tongue comes from Yahweh.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man speaks with an attentive, smiling younger man beneath a tree and grapevine. Fruit, flowers, stone houses and a winding path fill a sunlit hillside landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of attentive listening and quiet happiness evokes the verse's connection between heeding the word, finding good, and trusting in Yahweh.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling elder gestures as he speaks to adults and children gathered in a sunlit stone courtyard; one child examines a small plant, and a bowl of honey rests on a low table.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene relates the verse's wise heart and sweet speech to a teacher whose gentle words encourage learning.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler kneels to drink from a spring and guides its flowing water toward a young plant. Nearby, two villagers spill water from a broken clay vessel in a sunlit village landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting understanding as a wellspring of life and the folly associated with fools in Proverbs 16:22.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man sits in a sunlit stone courtyard, one hand over his heart and the other extended as he speaks to a group listening beneath leafy trees and vines.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the wise heart guiding speech and adding learning to the lips in Proverbs 16:23.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elder offers encouraging words to a younger man beside a bowl of honeycomb in a sunlit courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The verb and noun cues follow OSHB morphology. The scene illustrates the comparison in this verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling traveler walks along a sunlit, flower-lined path through olive trees; ahead, the path follows a crumbling cliff above a deep, shadowed ravine.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 16:25, depicting a path that appears appealing but leads toward danger and death.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A laborer in light linen cuts golden grain with a sickle beside an empty woven basket and a clay jug. Harvested sheaves, a village, and hills fill the sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative harvest scene evokes the laborer's hunger driving him to work in Proverbs 16:26.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man crouches beside a dug pit, holding tangled thorn roots with a shovel nearby. A symbolic flame emerges from his mouth as he speaks toward a worried man and woman. Olive trees, stone buildings and hills fill the background.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Proverbs 16:27: the unearthed thorns suggest digging up evil, and the flame represents words like burning fire.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man whispers into the ear of a frowning man while another man stands apart with his hands open. Olive branches frame the scene, with village buildings and hills beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating Proverbs 16:28's warning that a whisperer can stir strife and separate close friends.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: On a rocky hillside, a man in a red robe touches a hesitant neighbor’s shoulder and gestures toward a dark ravine path, while a sunlit village lies behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the violent man enticing his neighbor and leading him in a way that is not good in Proverbs 16:29.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling traveler in robes walks along a sunlit hillside path; nearby, a golden balance stands in a shaft of light with a white wisp curling above one pan.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative illustration of Proverbs 16:2: a person's ways seem pure in his own eyes, while Yahweh weighs the spirits.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village market, a winking man with pursed lips tips a basket of grain onto the ground while a nearby seller looks away.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene relates the man's wink and pursed lips to the verse's warning about devising and bringing about evil.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A silver-haired elderly woman offers a loaf of bread to a seated man beside a sunlit stone path, with olive trees, village houses, and distant hills behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene connects silver hair with honor and a compassionate act along a path with the way of righteousness in Proverbs 16:31.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A calm man raises an open hand toward an angry neighbor on a sunlit stone path; soldiers stand near a walled city in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts patient self-control with military might, reflecting Proverbs 16:32.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A thoughtful man seated beneath a tree lets small stones fall onto the fold of cloth spread across his lap, with sunlit hills, trees, and a village beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the lot cast into the lap in Proverbs 16:33; the verse says every decision comes from Yahweh.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A craftsperson raises open hands in prayer beside a wooden workbench covered with tools and shavings. A path winds through cultivated fields toward a village beneath a bright morning sky.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures a craftsperson entrusting his work to Yahweh; the firm table and path suggest thoughts being established.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A richly dressed man clutching a purse walks away from an overturned market stall as its seller reaches toward him. Beyond them, sheep graze in a sunlit valley near a village, while a dark rainstorm gathers over the road.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 16:4: Yahweh has made all for Himself, and even the wicked face a day of doom.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two richly dressed men clasp hands on stone steps in an ancient town, with crowns at their feet; a judge holding balanced scales and several townspeople watch.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of proud allies facing judgment illustrates Proverbs 16:5 and its warning that joining forces will not leave the proud unpunished.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A kneeling traveler reaches toward a small pouch offered by a man while another man holds his hand to help him rise. A dark, thorn-lined path lies behind him, and a sunlit path leads toward an ancient village and olive trees.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests mercy and truth, reconciliation, and a reverent turning away from evil in Proverbs 16:6.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Three men in ancient-style clothing extend open hands toward one another on a sunlit stone path among olive trees, with a shield and spear resting against rocks and a village in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of reconciliation reflects Proverbs 16:7: when a person’s ways please the LORD, He makes even that person’s enemies be at peace with him.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient marketplace, a grain seller weighs grain for a woman while, behind them, a wealthy merchant turns away a pleading man beside a tilted scale and heaps of grain and coins.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative marketplace scene contrasts an honest exchange with abundant wealth accompanied by injustice, reflecting Proverbs 16:8.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated traveler traces a curved line in the dust with a stick at a fork in a rocky hillside path. A sunlit road winds through trees toward a distant village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 16:9: the traveler's tracing suggests a planned way, while the sunlit path evokes Yahweh directing his steps.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, an older man points to a stone while a younger craftsman listens with a chisel in hand. Behind them, another man speaks to a man who stands with folded arms and turns away.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts a receptive listener with someone resistant to correction, echoing Proverbs 17:10's comparison of rebuke and blows.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a startled man pushes against a toppled wooden barrier while a stern man in a dark robe approaches carrying a staff.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of an evil man seeking rebellion and a cruel messenger sent against him in Proverbs 17:11.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A startled traveler on a rocky path looks back at a growling bear outside a dark den, while a smiling man behind him struggles with a teetering stack of fruit baskets in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasts a man encountering a bear whose cubs are gone with a fool acting recklessly, echoing Proverbs 17:12.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man recoils as a loaf falls between him and a scowling man who holds out his hand. A dark rain cloud hangs over the stone house behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of kindness repaid with harm and trouble lingering over the house, reflecting Proverbs 17:13.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two villagers face each other with open hands beside water pouring through a gap in an earthen irrigation bank, with trees, fields, and a distant village behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene connects the release of water through a bank with the beginning of strife and the choice to leave contention before a quarrel breaks out.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At a sunlit town-gate court, a seated judge waves one man away while pointing at another, who is held by guards and carries a bundle. An older man protests beside the departing man, a woman gestures toward the restrained man, and a tilted balance rests before the judge.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative courtroom scene reflects Proverbs 17:15's paired injustices: justifying the wicked and condemning the just, both abhorrent to the LORD.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit courtyard, a seated teacher offers a rolled parchment to a richly dressed young man who holds silver coins in one hand and admires a jeweled ornament in the other.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates the verse's question about having the price to acquire wisdom while lacking the heart for it.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man offers a bowl of food and puts an arm around a weary man seated beside a storm-damaged stone home, as sunlight breaks through clouds over a hillside village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts a friend offering comfort and practical help in adversity, reflecting Proverbs 17:17.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village courtyard, a smiling man clasps hands across a table with an older man while a concerned man watches behind them; a tied pouch rests on the table.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of the verse’s warning about a person lacking understanding who pledges surety for a friend.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two adults argue in a sunlit ancient village courtyard beside a tall stone gateway whose upper wall is breaking apart, with stones falling onto rubble.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene relating the verse’s strife and raised gate to the danger of destruction.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man and woman sit peacefully at a simple wooden table with bread, while people gesture in disagreement around a plentiful feast visible through an open doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasting a quiet meal of dry bread with feasting accompanied by strife, as in Proverbs 17:1.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man in ancient clothing lies in a muddy roadside ditch and points toward a startled traveler; a basket of fruit rests on the road above, with stone buildings and hills in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene connecting the fall into trouble and the fruit beyond reach to Proverbs 17:20, which speaks of a deceitful heart finding no good and a perverse tongue falling into evil.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man sits with his head in his hand in a sunlit stone courtyard while a younger man walks away, raising one hand dismissively.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting the sorrow of a father whose son is a fool in Proverbs 17:21.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a smiling woman offers a bowl of herbs and rests a hand on the shoulder of a downcast seated woman. A dry plant stands beside them, and a flowering green plant grows nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts the refreshment of a merry heart, likened to medicine, with the dryness associated with a broken spirit in Proverbs 17:22.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At a stone town gate, a man passes a small pouch to a seated judge while a worried man waits nearby. A balance on the judge’s table tilts to one side.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a secret bribe and tilted scales evokes Proverbs 17:23 and the perversion of justice.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Under a tree on a rocky hillside, a seated man listens closely to an elderly man while another man stands nearby, shading his eyes as he looks toward a distant sunlit valley and mountains.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasts wisdom close before a person of understanding with the wandering gaze toward the ends of the earth in Proverbs 17:24.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A sorrowful mother rests a hand on the shoulder of a grieving seated father as their adult son walks away with one hand raised. An overturned clay jar spills water across their stone courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene expressing Proverbs 17:25's grief and bitterness experienced by the parents of a foolish son.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a stern seated official points toward a calm, richly dressed man while a guard behind the man raises a staff. Concerned townspeople watch.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evoking Proverbs 17:26 and its warning against punishing the righteous and striking princes for their uprightness.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a seated man listens quietly with his chin resting on his hand while another seated man speaks with animated gestures. Pottery, flowering plants, olive branches and distant hills surround them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene relates to Proverbs 17:27 by portraying restrained speech and a calm spirit through attentive listening.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man sits quietly with his chin resting on his hand as four neighbors converse around him in a sunlit stone courtyard, with vines, pottery, and a village in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes Proverbs 17:28: a person who keeps silent can be regarded as wise and perceptive.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a plainly dressed man points toward a downcast man working beside baskets. Three men sit near an open chest of cloth and vessels, holding small bags and cups, with fields and a village beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Proverbs 17:2: a wise servant gains authority over a shameful son and shares an inheritance among brothers.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient workshop, a metalworker tends a pot of silver beside a glowing furnace holding gold, while a man nearby rests a hand over his heart and looks toward the light.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene relates the refining of silver and gold to Proverbs 17:3, which says Yahweh tests hearts.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man whispers into the ear of an eagerly attentive seated man while two villagers look on with concern in the background.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 17:4's picture of eager attention to false and spiteful speech.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler in worn clothing kneels beside a broken clay jar and spilled grain on a village street as a richly dressed man points and laughs; an older man watches the mocker with a stern expression.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a poor person's misfortune and another person's mockery, reflecting Proverbs 17:5's warning against mocking the poor and rejoicing at calamity.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a smiling child places a flower wreath on an elderly man's head while a younger man sits beside them, smiling. Vines, pottery and a distant hillside village surround the family.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative family scene reflects the proverb's picture of grandchildren as the crown of the aged and fathers as the glory of their children.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man in a cream tunic spreads his arms as he speaks to skeptical listeners, while a richly dressed, crowned prince gestures toward other men and crosses his fingers behind his back.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Proverbs 17:7's contrast between excellent speech from a fool and lying lips from a prince.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling traveler in ancient robes looks at a sparkling red gemstone in his open hand beside an open gate, with people and baskets of produce in a sunlit market beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evoking the present as a precious stone in its possessor’s eyes and the prosperity described in Proverbs 17:8.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a seated man draws a cloth over a broken clay vessel beside a downcast companion. Behind them, one person whispers to another while two men stand turned apart.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 17:9: covering a fault is pictured alongside seeking friendship, while whispering and separated companions suggest the harm of repeating a matter.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed traveler runs along a rocky path toward the warmly lit open doorway of a tall stone tower, with dark storm clouds behind it and a sunlit village in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a traveler seeking refuge in a strong tower, reflecting Proverbs 18:10's image of the righteous running to the name of Yahweh and being safe.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A richly dressed man sits beside gold coins and vessels, looking toward a vast walled city appearing among clouds above a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the rich man's wealth as a fortified city and high wall in his own esteem, as described in Proverbs 18:11.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a richly dressed man stands proudly on crumbling steps while a man kneels to help a woman gather spilled fruit, and another woman watches nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasts pride on unstable steps with humble help and the respect it receives, reflecting Proverbs 18:12.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village courtyard, a standing man raises his hand as he speaks to a seated man gesturing across a table, while three onlookers react nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts an interruption as a visual reflection on Proverbs 18:13, which warns of the folly and shame of answering before hearing.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man rests beneath woven blankets on a bed, gazing upward, while a woman sits nearby with her head bowed and her hands in her lap. An oil lamp glows beside the bed in a sunlit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting the contrast in Proverbs 18:14 between a spirit that sustains a person in sickness and the burden of a broken spirit.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a young learner leans toward an older man who holds a leafy sprig and gestures as he speaks. Potted plants, pottery and distant hills surround them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of attentive learning reflects the prudent heart acquiring knowledge and the wise ear seeking it in Proverbs 18:15.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man carrying an ornate gift walks through a crowd opening a path toward seated elders in a sunlit stone courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Proverbs 18:16: a person's gift makes room for him and brings him before great people.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At an ancient stone town gate, a seated man gestures earnestly toward a thoughtful elder, while a standing man gestures as he addresses them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of one person presenting his case and another questioning him, reflecting Proverbs 18:17.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, an elder casts small stones onto a low stone table while two richly dressed leaders stand apart on either side, smiling toward one another.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of casting lots to end contentions and keep the mighty apart, as in Proverbs 18:18.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man reaches toward another man standing with folded arms behind the heavily barred wooden gate of a stone city. Fortified walls rise beyond them in a sunlit, rocky landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating the proverb's comparison of an offended brother and contention to a strong city and the bars of a castle.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man seated apart on a rocky rise clutches a basket of fruit and turns away with one hand raised toward three villagers gesturing to him below. A sunlit stone village and hills stretch behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene relates to Proverbs 18:1 by portraying a man seeking his own desire in isolation and angrily turning away from counsel.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunny stone courtyard, a seated man with one hand on his belly speaks to a neighbor across a table of fruit and bread. An imaginative spray of flowering branches and figs flows from his mouth toward the food.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative picture of Proverbs 18:20, linking the fruit of a person’s speech with being satisfied by its produce.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man holding a bitten pomegranate gestures toward a woman listening beneath a tree with ripe fruit and a withered branch; hills and a village lie beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene connects the fruit and contrasting branches with the proverb’s picture of life and death in the power of the tongue and eating its fruit.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling husband and wife hold hands outside a stone home in a sunlit courtyard, with grapevines overhead, flowers, pottery, olive trees and distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the goodness of finding a wife and suggests the favor from Yahweh described in Proverbs 18:22.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man in worn clothes kneels with his hands extended toward a richly dressed seated man, who raises a hand dismissively and looks stern.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the contrast in Proverbs 18:23 between the poor man’s entreaties and the rich man’s rough answer.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated traveler and his friend sit closely together on a stone step in a sunlit hillside village. The friend puts an arm around the traveler's shoulders and offers him a cup, while villagers greet one another along the path behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of friendly community and a faithful friend staying close, reflecting Proverbs 18:24.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a smiling seated man points toward his chest and gestures outward while looking away from another seated man, who reaches toward him with open hands. A vine-covered pergola, pottery, fruit, and distant village buildings surround them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene portraying the contrast in Proverbs 18:2 between delighting in understanding and expressing one’s own heart.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A richly dressed man strides through a stone village gateway beside an overturned basket of fruit, looking disdainfully toward a distressed merchant as villagers react with sorrow and reproach.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative village encounter illustrates Proverbs 18:3, associating the arrival of the wicked with contempt, dishonor, and reproach.
